JOB DESCRIPTION:

MAIN PURPOSE OF ROLE 

 

Provide nutrition science expertise in product innovation, messaging development, and scientific substantiation of Abbott brand products, particularly those designed for diabetes management.

Partner with clinical scientists to conceptualize and design clinical studies to evaluate safety and efficacy of new ingredients and nutritional products, supporting product claims and regulatory submissions.

Educate both internal and external audiences on the science behind the products

 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

 

Provide nutrition science expertise for product innovation, including innovation pipeline, new product development and reformulations.

Responsible for the scientific substantiation of messaging and claims for Adult Nutrition (AN) products, ensuring accuracy, credibility, and global consistency.

Collaborate effectively within and between cross-functional teams, including Food Science,

Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, and Marketing to provide scientific and technical direction throughout product cycle

Stay current with the latest scientific literature and apply relevant findings to support product development, innovation as well as product messaging

Partner with clinical scientists to conceive, design and plan advanced clinical research in collaboration with cross-function teams to evaluate safety and efficacy of new ingredients or AN products. Interpret and report the results from these studies.

Engage in collaborative research with leading academic and medical researchers; maintain strong connections with professional organizations and key opinion leaders.

Apply advanced technical writing skills to produce reports and documents; write independently and evaluate the writing of others.

Publish research findings through the form of abstracts, presentations (poster or oral), peer-reviewed journal publications.

Represent the company as a subject matter expert in Nutrition Science expert at scientific conferences, educational programs and other scientific meetings.

QUALIFICATIONS 

PhD in Nutrition or related science discipline

Minimum 5 years of experience with in-depth knowledge of clinical nutrition principles, their practical applications, and clinical research.

Registered dietitian with clinical experience, especially in adult nutrition is strongly preferred.

Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to diverse audiences

Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and build relationships with both internal and external stakeholders, including key opinion leaders.

The Integrated Content & Media Manager is responsible for leads the end-to-end consumer content strategy and operations (60%) while orchestrating earned and paid media (40%) to deliver an integrated, omnichannel experience that increases engagement, customer acquisition, and conversion in a regulated healthcare environment.

• Translate content plans into amplification strategies across PR/earned, influencers/partners, paid social/search/video, and programmatic to drive full-funnel outcomes.
• Plan, activate, and optimize paid campaigns (briefs, flighting, audiences, creative rotations, budget pacing) with standardized measurement and conversion tracking.
• Integrate first/second/third-party data for planning and post-campaign evaluations; produce clear, actionable insights for stakeholders.
• Nurture relationships with media partners and creators; manage agency partners and contracts to scale performance efficiently.

C) Cross-Functional & People Leadership
• Act as the connective tissue between brand, content, media, CRM, eCommerce, and analytics teams to align roadmaps and KPIs.
• Lead rhythms (WBRs, campaign post-mortems, QBRs) and drive decision-making through performance storytelling.
• Mentor team members/agency counterparts; standardize playbooks, workflows, and approval processes suitable for a regulated environment.

KEY BUSINESS CHALLENGES
• Designing real-time, relevant content for evolving audiences across multiple platforms and brands—within a regulated context.

• Expertise with ad serving, tracking, attribution, and analytics suites (e.g., GA, Adobe Analytics); Salesforce experience is a plus.

COMPETENCIES
Insights-Driven

Brand Building & Strategy
• Translate science and product benefits into compelling propositions; align content and media with broader brand/ecomm priorities and multi-market needs.
Digital Engagement
• Use channel-specific best practices to tailor formats and hooks; manage real-time social interactions; scale test-and-learn across platforms and audiences.
Digital Project Management

Effective Communication & Collaboration

Commercial Acumen

TOOLS & PLATFORMS

Implement the MBSE vision, roadmap, and operating model in alignment with business needs – MBSE is an enabler of quality, speed, consistency, and predictability – not just a modeling exercise.

Perform product definition, system architecture, requirements management, risk analysis, hazard analysis, product test and evaluation, System V & V, and/or design control documentation.

Develop design processes.

Design and conduct system level characterization/verification of complex systems; collect, organize, analyze, and document test results.

Integrate analytical and performance related elements with software, hardware, and electronics system components.

Develop and execute model-based simulation tests in support of design characterization or product evaluation and testing.

Ensure traceability between requirements, architecture, risks, and verification & validation is robust, transparent, and auditable.

Communicate effectively and participate in cross functional development teams with good negotiating skills to direct multi-disciplinary teams toward solutions.

Responsible for utilizing and maintaining the effectiveness of the quality system.

Responsible for compliance with applicable Corporate and Divisional Policies and performing other duties as assigned by management.

Bachelor’s degree in engineering or physical science or related engineering field, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience

Minimum 6 years of product development experience

Strong knowledge of defined development process that is consistent with ISO, FDA design control standards or requirements. 

Experienced in one or more of the following: Electro-mechanical, software, mathematical, chemical or biochemical technologies as they pertain to the design, integration, evaluation and commercialization of diagnostic systems

Experienced in SysML, Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) methodology, and system modeling tools. Experience in MBSE deployment a plus. Proficient in MagicDraw modeling software a plus. Certification in INCOSE ASEP/CSEP and/or SysML a plus.

Ability to work on many subjects concurrently

The warehouse Specialist is responsible for having a thorough working knowledge of all Plant Material Control and Columbus Distribution Center job functions and applicable department equipment and system ie. Forklift, Cambar, HK Systems, TTMS, AMAPS, MITS, AES. The Warehouse Specialist is responsible for receiving, loading, unloading, cleaning, creating bills of lading (BOL's), casepicking, assuming computer room responsibilities as needed & performing full functionality in the Shipping Office while maintaining compliance to all GMP, Safety and Quality guidelines. Also will involve some performance of preventative maintenance. ie. monitor and respond to Columbus Distribution Center and Plant automation systems and equipment. Must meet all safety and housekeeping requirements.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Loading, unloading, case picking, barcoding, and palletizer operations:

Performs all tasks safely, assures accurate documentation, follows all procedures/guidelines, assures trailers are loaded to meet weight requirements, performs all tasks in an efficient and effective manner

Receiving Operations 

Creates very accurate & legible documentation, performs data entry accurately, maintains all applicable databases with needed information, efficiently process inbound pallets through the proper process and into the ASRS system.

Shipping/Receiving office functions:

Release orders in a timely manner, assure all documentation is accurate, address people in a professional manner, assure all databases are accurately maintained with timely entries, assure BOL’s are signed/dated by Common Carrier Driver and the Clerk during the shift

Must communicate safety and GMP concerns to Plant Material Control/Columbus Distribution Center leadership and follow up to assure the concerns are addressed

Must communicate via verbal and email with all parties of the business.

Accountable for personal safety and adhering to the safety guidelines.

Ability to make decisions based on awareness of the area operations is necessary.

Must be able to lift and maneuver objects of considerable weight (50 lbs).

This position is accountable for complying with applicable FDA (GMP), USDA, OSHA and Abbott Nutritional Supply Chain regulations, policies, procedures and guidelines.

SHIFT

1st shift, 12-hour rotating schedule

Example schedule:

Week 1: Sun, Wed, Thurs

Week 2: Mon, Tues, Fri, Sat

Week 3: Sun, Wed, Thurs

Week 4: Mon, Tues, Fri, Sat

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

High School Diploma or GED

This position requires excellent written/verbal communication skills, very good interpersonal skills, analytical troubleshooting skills, ability to multitask & a very good team player.

Forklift experience highly preferred

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

6+ months prior job experience within the Plant Material Control/Distribution Center is preferred.

The Opportunity 

This position works out of our Columbus, OH location in the Nutrition Division. In Research & Development, our ambition is to provide innovative high-quality products, creating sustainable value, delivering superior user experience, and enhancing health outcomes at all stages of life. 

Primary Job Function

The Microbiology Department within Abbott Nutrition’s R&D (Global Analytical and Food Safety) is responsible for conducting microbiological analysis of R&D project samples.

The Associate Scientist candidate is responsible for applying high quality laboratory techniques in the analysis of samples submitted for routine release testing of ingredients, in-process samples, finished products, and environmental monitoring samples. Additionally, support is provided to manufacturing sites for follow up studies, support of process system validation studies, and other requested special projects. 

The typical workload will include activities such as lab cleaning, preventive maintenance, media preparation, ordering supplies, pathogen screening tests, plate count tests, and genetic identifications.

This position will be accountable to the laboratory management and department management for outcomes related to assignments. The individual in this position is expected to organize time and means to accomplish the assigned tasks based on laboratory demands. 

What You’ll Work On

Implementing and maintaining the effectiveness of the quality system.

Conducting routine and complex microbiological procedures according to written and or verbal instruction with little direct supervision. Recognizes problems and errors and makes or seeks corrective actions.

Write technical reports.

Performing non-routine analysis when given direction.

Assisting in method validation and verification activities.

Reporting results according to documentation procedures and policies. 

Performing functions in compliance with relevant corporate and division procedures. 

Complying with laboratory safety practices.

Maintaining a clean, safe work environment.

Assist in training new microbiology lab personnel.

Act as liaison between lab and external parties.

Serving as a member of teams and committees as needed.

Required Qualifications

Required

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Microbiology or a life science discipline is required. Preference for Microbiology/Biology graduates.

The ideal candidate will have two to five years’ relevant work experience after completing a bachelor’s degree. Consideration may be given to less years of experience post-degree if experience is gained through internship or assignments in a related field.

Preferred:

At this level an individual will demonstrate a basic understanding of Microbiology and other scientific principles corresponding with an undergraduate degree level, gained through academic training or practical experience.

This position routinely communicates with laboratory co-workers and customers. 

Interpersonal relations skills are important. 

Problem solving skills are desirable for investigating or trouble shooting method related findings or any laboratory errors. 

 Ability to manage workload efficiently and with accuracy is critical.

Clear communication while working with co-workers, a high degree of motivation, and attention to detail is expected.

MISC:

This is an on-site role - not a remote role.

Sponsorship: we will not provide sponsorship of any kind for this role (including OPT).

Relocation assistance is not offered for this role.

THE OPPORTUNITY

This Staff Software Engineer, Mobile Applications position can work out remotely within the U.S.

Staff Software Engineer, Mobile Applications will work with a modern React Native and Golang-based tech stack on a mobile platform dedicated to improving the health and well-being of users in over 50 countries. The core mobile platform includes a system that interacts with a bio wearable sensor and is part of a large-scale environment responsible for processing billions of tasks daily. The candidate should possess strong leadership and technical skills and have a passion for software engineering to help guide the team's direction. Highly desirable qualities include versatility and a desire to continuously learn, improve, and empower team members. The candidate will support building scalable, highly available, efficient, and secure software solutions for medical devices.

Lead the design and delivery of complex, high-performance mobile applications using React Native and embedded Go modules.

Mentor and coach engineers, fostering technical growth and a culture of engineering excellence.

Partner with product, design, and architecture teams to align technical solutions with business goals.

Lead technical reviews, ensuring code quality, security, and adherence to architectural standards.

Identify and resolve systemic technical challenges, proactively addressing performance bottlenecks and scalability concerns in both React Native and Go code.

Contribute to the organization’s technical roadmap, influencing long-term technology choices and investment areas.

Required Qualifications 

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.

8 years of professional software development experience, with 3+ years building and shipping complex mobile applications at scale.

Expert-level proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and React Native.

Strong understanding of mobile architecture patterns, API design, performance optimization, and scalability.

Experience writing and maintaining either Swift, Kotlin, or C++

Proven ability to quickly learn and apply new programming languages, frameworks, and architectural patterns, maintaining effectiveness even when working outside of primary expertise.

Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications 

Experience with event-driven architectures

Hands-on experience with Golang in a production environment or a strong desire to learn it.

Knowledge of mobile security best practices and secure coding standards.

Experience with mobile CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and app store deployment processes.

Demonstrated ability to evaluate and adopt emerging technologies to drive innovation.

Preferred

Prior experience in the healthcare or other regulated industries

The Opportunity 

Our Minnetonka location is seeking a high caliber, motivated, self-driven leader to join our manufacturing engineering team for ablation catheter manufacturing in Abbott’s Electrophysiology business unit. In Abbott’s Electrophysiology (EP) business, we’re advancing the treatment of heart disease through breakthrough medical technologies in atrial fibrillation, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

Individuals in this role will work supporting the operations team within our injection molding engineering group as a front-line engineer working with assemblers and troubleshooting equipment and process issues. Additionally, this position will manage projects aimed towards designing and developing manufacturing processes, tooling, and fixtures to meet daily production schedules while enhancing productivity and product quality.

What You’ll Work On

Front line engineer supporting operations team

Individual should:

Be innovative, resourceful, and work with minimal direction

Have excellent organization, problem solving, communication, and team leadership skills

Work effectively with cross-functional teams

Manage projects which include new production equipment, process improvements and cost reductions while supporting new product introductions. Collaborate with peer engineers and technicians. Additional responsibilities include:

Conduct Process FMEAs and Process Validations (IQ/OQ/PQ)

Improve product quality, labor efficiency, and throughput through the use of Lean manufacturing concepts

Coordinate the design, procurement, build and debug of tooling, machinery and test equipment

Conduct investigations for Safety, Quality or Manufacturing issues, report findings and implement robust solutions

Work with Product Development to ensure Design for Manufacturability

Required Qualifications

Mechanical, Chemical, Biomedical or any engineering or technical degree or equivalent experience required

2-4 years manufacturing engineering experience with experience in injection molding.

Process validation experience (IQ/OQ/PQ)

Strong analytical, problem solving and project management skills

Demonstrated leadership capability in team settings

Ability to lead and motivate peers, drive change and problem solve with creativity.

Ability to travel approximately 10%, including internationally.

A fast-paced work environment where your safety is our priority

Production areas that are clean, well-lit and temperature-controlled

Health care and well-being programs including medical, dental, vision, wellness and occupational health programs

Paid time off

401(k) retirement savings with a generous company match

JOB DESCRIPTION:

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Abbott’s Nutrition Division develops science-based nutrition products for people of all ages, from helping babies and children grow, to keeping adult bodies strong and active. Millions of people around the world count on our leading brands – including Similac®, PediaSure®, Pedialyte®, Ensure® and Glucerna® – to help get the nutrients they need to live their healthiest life.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

The Maintenance Front Line Leader is a working supervisor who leads a small team of maintenance technicians and supports the ongoing production operation of an aseptic liquid nutritional manufacturing facility.

Maintenance:

Assist in development, planning, and execution of all plant-related maintenance activities including Preventative, Predictive, and Demand maintenance work.

Develop and refine detailed maintenance job plans and procedures.

Provide training, guidance, and mentorship to plant maintenance staff members.

Trouble-shoot and resolve equipment-related issues that impact ongoing production.

Work with the Operations, Engineering, and Quality teams to investigate, identify root cause, and implement corrective actions for equipment-related failures.

Able to work off shifts.

EHS: 

Model and promote the behaviors that support a continuously improving EHS culture by engaging with employees and other key stakeholders in ensuring all EHS requirements are met inclusive of internal and external regulatory objectives and direction. Coach and direct individuals in delivering EHS performance for themselves, their team and department.

Preparation and active participation in internal and external EHS audits and incident/accident investigation and reporting; coupled with timely implementation of corrective and preventative actions.

Quality: 

Model and promote the behaviors that ensure delivery of high quality products for our customers while maintaining compliance with Abbott policies and procedures, meeting all local and statutory requirements, and adhering to the regulatory requirements of countries to which products are shipped. Lead efforts required delivering quality and compliance performance for the shift/ line of accountability Initiate, manage, and make decisions which impact product quality.

Preparation and active participation in internal and external Quality audits and incident investigation and reporting; coupled with timely implementation of corrective and preventative action.

Finance / Business Acumen: 

Model and promote a thorough understanding of what drives product costs, profitability and cash flow for the shift and within the department, while operating within budget material utilization and Cost Improvement Program goals. Manage budget accountability for Headcount, Overtime, and direct expenses for a shift and/or line. Track, trend and continuously improve budgetary performance for direct expenses, headcount, overtime (OT), Operating Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), production (Unit/Hour, Pounds/Hour), Material Usage Variance (MUV) and Scrap and Cost Improvement Projects (CIP).

Understand financial statements, key performance measures, and provide input for all line budgetary decisions. Develop the skills necessary to manage financial budgetary line items involving headcount management, overtime, scrap reduction and material utilization variance (MUV). Share in the preparation of the annual budget and any updating reviews.

Direct Financial accountability up to $ 2MM USD.

Productivity:

Promote and drive continuous improvement programs utilizing common problem solving tools and methodologies in processes and procedures within the shift/ operating line/ department for root cause analysis and resolution of issues. 

Actively plan and organize the day to day manufacturing operations and schedules.

Anticipate and drive proper alignment and prioritization between production and support teams.

Drive OEE performance, understand the drivers, and develop and execute plans around improvement of line performance and quality metrics with support from the direct manager. Understand all key performance indicators, driving and executing plans for improvement through team engagement.

People:

Model and promote organizational values by providing effective leadership, direction, development and support to the team. Drive a culture of engagement through the High Performance Work Team. Directly supervises team and participates in performing repairs and staffing activities.

Assure team members are trained and understand duties, responsibilities, and performance against established expectations.

Provide timely coaching, counseling and feedback. 

Develop all line personnel by securing appropriate training, providing mentoring and assigning progressively challenging stretch responsibilities within the scope of the team and department accountabilities.

Engage in drafting own goals, lead the process of development of team goals and growth planning. Create a learning environment and support individuals learning and development plans.

Ensure delivery of effective performance management while establishing and sustaining a positive work environment.

Execution of on time performance reviews for direct reports

Establish a communications framework that assures timely and relevant transfer of information to and from all levels and functional areas of the organization.

Ensure compliance with all HR practices, policies and procedures.

Understand and effectively use the rewards and recognition programs. 

Champion positive employee relations by maintaining a high profile presence on the floor, direct engagement with employees, regular open communications and encouraging knowledge sharing and open exchange of ideas.

Scope & Accountability:

This position will require some general direction and supervision from direct manager; with key decisions being made in collaboration with direct manager and High Performance Work Team. The Maintenance Front Line Leader will initially be learning through the direct coaching of management the leadership requirements to become competent in delivering organizational results in all key performance areas. He/She will develop the competence to lead their shift team in consistently meeting all organizational expectations of a Front Line shift team. Works with their direct manager to identify change opportunities and effectively manage these to positive outcomes for individuals, team, line and the business.

Conduct preventative maintenance programs, inspects, lubricates, repairs, and overhauls a wide variety of mechanical, plumbing and electrical, but not limited to: fire protection systems, building HVAC, egress systems and exit lighting. Analyze equipment breakdowns to determine source of trouble or malfunction. Recommend and or perform repairs to equipment.

Leadership in this role will primarily be focused on the direct reporting group with support from the direct manager, as required. Focus is on day to day operations, with short term focus based on meeting requirements that are tactical versus strategic. 

Manage and guide the TPM team(s) to improve quality and increase productivity on the line. Communicates to line the High Performance Work Team daily while maintaining a constant floor presence. Maintains a safe work environment with 100% training and compliance to applicable procedures.

Coordinates activities related to shift starts and changes. Leads and coordinates daily activities of the shift team to meet daily requirements that positively impact the rest of the multi-shift line results. Working with their direct manager, other Front Line Leaders and other management, will establish the High Performance Work Team culture where people feel empowered, are accountable for the business and continuously improving the shift and the line. Communicates with other departments and functions as needed in support of meeting operational objectives.

Interprets and executes policies that affect work processes and personnel within the assigned organizational unit.

Manages personnel and processes to ensure production meets all associated quality standards.

Financial management for assigned Maintenance by managing headcount utilization, reducing line downtime and scrap. This list is not all inclusive.

Promote team, department and site goals through team communications and providing direction and guidance towards achievement.

Active participation in team and department projects including responsibility for execution of assigned actions. 

Track, trend & report on established KPI's; communicating to functional manager and site leadership team on accomplishments, opportunities for improvement and planned actions.

Follows escalation reporting process with inputs from peers/manager for decision making as required. Make and communicate decisions that are appropriate for level of accountability.

Budgetary accountability is limited – $2MM USD

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE YOU’LL BRING

High School Diploma or GED

Possesses a working technical knowledge and application of concepts, practices, and procedures within engineering discipline.

Bachelors degree in technical discipline preferred.

La Oportunidad

 Que harás

 Cualificaciones preferidas

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott 

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:

Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

Benefits such as Medical and Dental Assistance, Life Insurance, Private Pension Plan, Medication Subsidy, Discount on Abbott stock purchases, among others.

A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

We offer flexible work policies that allow a healthy balance between personal and professional life

We invest in the development of our employees through training and growth opportunities

We foster an environment where every voice is heard and valued

The Opportunity 

Abbott is recruiting a Senior Financial Analyst for our Neuromodulation division to be in São Paulo, Brazil. The FP&A team acts as the key business partner of the Regional commercial leader while ensuring financial compliance and growth. This position will be partnering with various levels of business teams to drive financial ownership, revenue and margin efficiency, and business excellence. Scope of responsibilities include financial planning, forecasting, and reporting for the commercial division, preparation of presentations for month-end and forecast results, strategic ad hoc analyses, accounting support for commercial operation.

What You’ll Do 

Perform monthly accounting responsibilities for month-end close including journal entry preparation, spend/headcount review, accounting reconciliation, cross charge, etc.

Managing the analysis and communication of financial results (Full P&L) for the division to commercial team & Management.

The Corporate Engineering (CE) organization is looking for an experienced and motivated individual to serve as Fire Protection Program Manager. This opportunity is for someone who wants to positively impact the organization in a meaningful role that applies advanced engineering knowledge and experience, combined with a disciplined project management approach, to deliver business solutions that span across divisions and regions. A part of Global Engineering Services (GES), Corporate Engineering exists to support Abbott’s businesses and help them drive sustainable growth and margin improvement. Corporate Engineering does this by planning, designing and deploying Facilities, Utilities & Infrastructure projects with excellence, by means of strong talent, best practices, resourcefulness, and experience. The GES/CE Fire Protection Program Manager role significantly contributes to that mission by leading and executing engineering activities across a broad set of responsibilities as outlined below.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Fire Protection Program Manager is an engineering professional who, working with little or no supervision, applies advanced scientific and engineering knowledge, mathematics and ingenuity to complete complex assignments related to the Fire Protection Engineering discipline. A Fire Protection Program Manager has full knowledge of other related disciplines beyond their own.

Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Technical / Design: Benchmarks internally and externally. Independently executes or directs others in the design of facilities/utilities/infrastructure systems, by applying novel and proven engineering concepts and techniques. Performs detailed analysis, communicates across functions and disciplines, and serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in design reviews.

Project Management: Identifies, plans and executes projects of varying degrees of complexity within engineering specialty, requiring custom risk-managed execution plans. Works with the client and cross-functional stakeholders to establish scope, cost and schedule on multiple projects. Independently performs economic analysis and feasibility studies related to complex and often multiple competing project alternatives. Manages multiple projects, often concurrently, maintaining project controls and reporting for scope, cost and schedule. Responsible for achieving the projects’ financial targets in support of business objectives.

Problem Solving / Innovation: Creates or coordinates design solutions for novel or complex problems focusing on cost-benefit, integrating regulatory needs (e.g. NFPA, Fire Code, Building Code, and Factory Mutual (FM) requirements) and operational needs (e.g. processes, materials, and people requirements). Structures studies to address cross-disciplinary and cross-functional issues and arrive at optimal solutions.

Organizational Interface: Mentors others by sharing technical knowledge and providing guidance. Where appropriate, provides tasks and project assignment opportunities for employee development and evaluates performance. Represents the organization as the prime technical contact, interacting with senior management and external parties on complex technical matters often requiring coordination between organizations. Conveys information effectively through formal and informal means including proposals, reports, design documentation, and presents to senior executive leadership. Submits articles for internal or external publication.

Compliance: Responsible for compliance with applicable Corporate and Divisional policies, procedures, and standards for Quality, Environmental, Health, Safety and Energy (EHS&E), Abbott Engineering Standards (AES), and other governance areas as applicable.

Additional Responsibilities May Include: Responsible for all matters pertaining the Fire Protection Engineering discipline as the global SME. Participates in internal cross-divisional teams to develop new, or revise existing, procedures and standards, and provides training. Directs the efforts of others such as engineers, technicians and outside resources. Crafts and submits Requests for Capital Expenditures (RCEs), safety/quality checklists, executive presentations, and projects financial reports. Resolves problems and crisis situations requiring assertive decisions and hands-on rapid implementation, by leveraging technical training and experience. Represents engineering on corporate and division initiatives.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE / SKILLS

B.S. degree in Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related discipline is required.

M.S. degree in Fire Protection Engineering is required if B.S. degree is not in Fire Protection Engineering.

Professional Engineer (PE) license is a plus.

Certifications: Certified Fire Protection Specialist (CFPS) is required.

Professional Affiliations: SFPE or NFPA membership is a plus.

Minimum of 12 years of experience in the design and deployment of fire protection solutions across building facilities and utilities systems.

Mastery of applicable codes, including NFPA (National Fire Protection Association), NEC (National Electrical Code), IFC (International Fire Code), IBC (International Building Code), and other local, national, and international regulatory requirements.

Experience with Fire Prevention/Detection/Suppression, Risk Management, and Loss Prevention.

Experience with fire protection systems including gas, water, pre-action, foam, and clean agent.

Experience with seismic bracing of fire protection systems.

Experience with underground fire mains, lead-ins, piping, and thrust blocks.

Experience with flammable liquids and hazardous materials storage, and maximum allowable quantities.

Experience with warehouses including flue spacing, high density storage, in-rack sprinklers, and commodity classifications.

Experience with Performance-Based Design (PBD) approach.

Experience with Life Safety and Egress analysis.

Experience with fire alarm, smoke detection, and smoke control systems.

Experience with Factory Mutual (FM) requirements, Plan Reviews, and inspection reports/responses.

Experience assessing the design and performance of fire protection and life safety systems on existing facilities, identifying gaps versus regulatory requirements and AES, and developing remediation plans.

We are committed to building a foundation for our people to be successful, investing in their development and growth, and creating a diverse, inclusive culture that welcomes different perspectives, experiences and backgrounds. 

What You’ll Work On

Working under general direction, provides engineering, sales, educational and technical support in response to field inquiries from physicians, health care professionals, patients, and field sales staff, involving EP products. Gaining foundational knowledge of EP through a structured training program with a strong emphasis on hands-on learning and practical application. 

Providing regional EP procedural case coverage in an Electrophysiology lab and/or operating room setting. 

Acting as a clinical interface between the medical community and the business. 

Demonstrating the ability to build and sustain credible clinical relationships with customers and sharing product expertise accordingly. 

Demonstrating a thorough command of all EP products, including technical details, software utilization, and capabilities. 

Providing engineering, sales, education, and clinical support on the safe and effective use of Abbott EP products, including cardiac mapping, diagnostic, and therapy systems. 

Supporting EP Sales Representatives in the following areas: 

Collaborating with sales personnel; 

Facilitating regional training seminars; 

Participating in clinical studies/data collection; 

Troubleshooting; and,

Continuously develops engineering, sales and technical skills aligned with the overall territory strategy, including learning from senior sales personnel and management.

EDTS – en del av Abbott

European Drug Testing Service (EDTS) AB startade sin verksamhet 1991 inom området slumpvisa drogtester på arbetsplatsen. Idag ingår EDTS i Abbott koncernen och vi är med våra fyra affärsområden ett ledande drogtestföretag i Norden. Förutom genomförande av drogtester på arbetsplatser, bistår vi vårdföretag med administrativa tjänster och digitala lösningar inom drogtestning och laboratorieanalyser.

Vi säljer och förmedlar även högkvalitativa produkter för drogtestning, bl.a. screeningstester (POCT) i saliv och urin, instrument för drogtestning, alkometrar samt reagenser.

Våra kunder finns bl.a. inom kommun och landsting, arbetsgivare och företagshälsovård, laboratorier, privata vårdgivare samt skolor. Vår företagskultur präglas av kvalitet, trygghet och innovation samt en fortsatt ambition att i nära samarbete med våra samarbetspartners och kunder driva utvecklingen i branschen.

EDTS växer och med ökat kundantal samt med utveckling av vårt tjänsteutbud behöver vi vara fler provtagare som fortsätter ge våra kunder bästa tänkbara service.

Just nu söker vi Provtagare i Stockholm med omnejd, med start under våren!

Som provtagare har du ett stort personligt ansvar och har nära samarbete med dina kollegor på huvudkontoret i Kista.

Introduction :
Chez Abbott, nous nous engageons à transformer la vie des patients grâce à des thérapies innovantes pour l’insuffisance cardiaque. En tant que Responsable Développement Thérapeutique, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la mise en place de parcours de soins optimisés et dans l’élargissement de l’accès à des technologies vitales. Cette opportunité vous permettra de combiner expertise clinique et développement stratégique, afin d’avoir un impact concret sur les patients et les professionnels de santé en région parisienne et dans le nord de la France.

À propos du poste :
Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les centres d’implantation et les sites de référence pour optimiser les programmes dédiés à l’insuffisance cardiaque et positionner Abbott comme partenaire de confiance à long terme. Notre portefeuille comprend des solutions avancées pour la prise en charge chronique et aiguë de l’insuffisance cardiaque, ainsi que CardioMEMS™, un système innovant de télésurveillance permettant aux cliniciens de gérer les patients de manière proactive.

Vos missions :

Favoriser l’adoption des thérapies : Accompagner les centres d’implantation et les sites de référence pour optimiser les programmes d’insuffisance cardiaque et renforcer le partenariat avec Abbott.

Assurer l’excellence clinique : Assister aux implants et suivis, dispenser des formations produits et résoudre les problématiques techniques sur l’ensemble du portefeuille.

Développer l’activité : Entretenir des relations solides avec les centres d’implantation, négocier les contrats et identifier de nouvelles opportunités de croissance.

The Opportunity 

This is a remote position

Qualified candidates must currently live in the Minneapolis territory.

Must be able to travel up to 95%

Must have a Valid Driver’s License.

We’re hiring a Field Service Engineer II within our Diagnostics Division. This is a field-based, remote role that covers the Minneapolis territory.

As a Field Service Engineer II, you’ll support customers as a trusted technical expert, responsible for installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting diagnostic instruments while ensuring compliance and customer satisfaction. You’ll manage your territory, resolve complex issues, and partner cross-functionally to deliver exceptional service and achieve business goals. Your work ensures reliable diagnostics that directly impact patient care.

What You’ll Work On

Install and Maintain Diagnostic Systems: Complete installations, preventive maintenance, and corrective repairs on assigned instruments to ensure optimal performance and compliance with quality standards.

Troubleshoot and Resolve Issues: Diagnose technical problems across multiple complex instruments, document resolutions accurately, and close service calls within defined timelines.

Own Customer Satisfaction: Manage customer issues from start to resolution or escalation, deliver superior service, and build strong relationships through proactive communication.

Manage Territory Effectively: Plan and prioritize service visits, maintain accurate inventory, and support on-call rotation, after-hour coverage, and travel for training or critical account support.

Ensure Compliance and Safety: Follow all regulatory, quality system, and laboratory safety guidelines during service activities; maintain accurate documentation for audits.

Collaborate and Mentor: Partner with cross-functional teams to meet business goals and provide guidance to other Field Service Representatives to strengthen team capability.

Achieve Business Metrics: Meet targets for service sales, cost of service, and key performance indicators (KPIs) for assigned accounts.

Continuous Improvement: Utilize remote support tools to maximize instrument uptime and maintain certifications through ongoing training and development.

Required Qualifications: 

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. 

2-5 years of experience in Engineering or Laboratory Technology. 

Ability to travel 25% within the assigned territory.

Experience Preferred: 

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with laboratory instrumentation

Ability to work independently and thrive in team environments

Proficiency in computer applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Internet) and remote computing tools (VPN, remote troubleshooting)

Effective communication and interpersonal skills.

The Opportunity 

Structural Heart Business Mission: Why we exist

Our business purpose is to restore health and improve quality of life through the design and provision of device and management solutions for the treatment of structural heart disease.

The field-based National Product Trainer – LAAO is responsible for enhancing Abbott’s ability to sell trans-catheter structural heart devices and procedures thru field and customer training to optimize procedural outcomes, efficiencies, and adoption. This position is geographically based and spends significant time in the field with customers. Strong leadership and teamwork skills are required. The position requires experience and knowledge to integrate with sales management, marketing, R&D, clinical science, clinical operations, and other cross functional groups. This position also requires project and program management skills for the development and execution of field and customer product training programs.

This position is accountable for US Amulet product technical training of field and customers to ensure optimal outcomes with appropriate compliance. In-depth product knowledge, program management, and commercial training skillsets are required. Ongoing cross-functional team partnerships with Commercial leadership, MD KOLs, Marketing, R&D, Clinical Engineering, Clinical Science, Quality, and others are also critical for successful plans and implementation. Field-based customer interactions for training and challenging case diagnosis/solutions will also facilitate optimal clinical outcomes & efficiencies. All locally learned training and best practices will be transformed into training curriculum.

Teamwork

Collaboration with Clinical as needed

Interpersonal, Presentation, and Implementation Skills

Present and train at Abbott field and customer educational programs

Product, procedure, and screening training content creation

Program Management

Analytics

Monitor product performance outcomes for additional training or product design input

Content Creation

Development of training curriculum for commercial devices. Working with KOL thought leaders, R&D, Training, Clinical Engineering to create new training content.

Ten years of relevant work experience.

Training experience preferred. 

Direct experience working with and training physician customers.

Program management experience. 

Strong communication skills, specifically an ability to deliver effective training to large and small audiences.

Ability to work with several levels within the organization and in cross functional teams.

Working knowledge of Microsoft office applications.

profiter de possibilités d’avancement professionnel au sein d’une entreprise internationale qui vous permettra de bâtir la carrière dont vous rêvez;

travailler pour une entreprise reconnue dans des douzaines de pays partout dans le monde comme étant un excellent milieu de travail et figurant parmi les entreprises les plus admirées dans le monde dans le classement Fortune;

Mener un processus de recrutement fluide

Développer des viviers de talents solides grâce à un sourcing proactif et à un réseautage stratégique, assurant un flux constant de candidats qualifiés pour les besoins actuels et futurs.

Exploiter les indicateurs et analyses de recrutement pour optimiser les stratégies de recherche et influencer les décisions d’embauche.

Interpréter des rapports clés en recrutement, en utilisant les données pour identifier des occasions d’efficacité et d’amélioration continue.

Développer une compréhension approfondie de chaque rôle — ses facteurs clés de succès, ses responsabilités et son impact — et utiliser ces connaissances pour attirer et engager les candidats.

Évaluer les candidats en examinant leurs compétences, leur expérience, leurs compétences comportementales et leur adéquation culturelle, tout en offrant de la rétroaction et une préparation de base aux entrevues lorsque pertinent.

Établir des relations significatives avec les candidats en comprenant leurs motivations, en communiquant la proposition de valeur employé d’Abbott et en veillant à ce qu’ils se sentent informés et soutenus tout au long du processus.

Être un agent de changement et un ambassadeur de la culture

Promouvoir l’utilisation des technologies et outils disponibles pour optimiser les façons de travailler et améliorer l’expérience d’embauche.

Faire preuve de curiosité et d’une approche axée sur l’amélioration continue, en remettant en question le statu quo pour améliorer la performance et les résultats.

Représenter l’organisation lors d’événements de recrutement, en mettant de l’avant nos opportunités auprès des talents potentiels.

Favoriser des relations positives et collaboratives avec les gestionnaires d’embauche, les candidats et les fournisseurs.

Diriger et soutenir des initiatives locales et régionales en acquisition de talents liées aux programmes pour jeunes talents, à la marque employeur et à la diversité.

Baccalauréat en ressources humaines ou en administration des affaires requis. Titre de professionnel en ressources humaines agréé un atout majeur.

Au moins 1-3 ans d’expérience dans la gestion du cycle complet de recrutement des professionnels dans un environnement où le volume et la pression sont élevés.

Expérience du recrutement dans un secteur lié aux soins de santé, pharmaceutique ou à la fabrication un atout majeur.

Succès dans la gestion de multiples demandes de recrutement dans divers secteurs d’activité.

Bonnes relations avec les chefs du recrutement, les candidats et les parties prenantes externes.

Esta posición está ubicada en Quinta Normal, en la división EPD. Como Programador de Producción, tendrás la oportunidad de la elaboración, actualización y control de los planes y secuencias de producción que aseguran la continuidad operativa del Site Carrascal. El objetivo del cargo es integrar y analizar información clave de demanda, capacidad, materiales y restricciones operativas para definir un programa de producción confiable, eficiente y alineado con los estándares de Abbott EPD. A través de la coordinación permanente con Producción, Logística, Calidad y Mantenimiento, garantiza que las actividades se ejecuten con el mejor aprovechamiento de los recursos humanos, materiales y de planta, contribuyendo al cumplimiento del servicio, los costos operativos y la calidad esperada. Asimismo, vela por que cada planificación se realice conforme a las políticas corporativas, promoviendo la estabilidad del proceso productivo, la disponibilidad de producto terminado y el logro de los objetivos operacionales establecidos.

Que harás

1. Desarrollar y mantener el Plan Maestro de Producción (MPS) y el Programa Semanal/Diario (detailed scheduling), asegurando alineación con el Plan de Ventas y Operaciones (S&OP) y con las restricciones de capacidad y materiales.

2. Ejecutar la programación fina de líneas y equipos en SAP, priorizando órdenes según cumplimiento de OTIF, políticas de inventario, fechas de vencimiento y campañas

3. Liberar, secuenciar y firmar órdenes de proceso y producción en SAP, asegurando disponibilidad de materiales, recursos y documentación GMP.

4. Monitorear en tiempo real el progreso de las órdenes (confirmaciones y consumo), gestionar desvíos y cuellos de botella, y proponer reprogramaciones para proteger el servicio y la eficiencia.

5. Coordinar diariamente la reunión de programación con Producción, QA, Mantenimiento y Logística para resolver restricciones, escalando riesgos críticos y acordando compromisos.

6. Analizar y optimizar tiempos de cambio, tamaños de lote y secuencias buscando minimizar mermas y maximizar la eficiencia de línea.

7. Asegurar la correcta gestión de materiales en SAP: reservas, transferencias, lotes, FEFO y ubicaciones, en coordinación con Bodega y Compras.

8.Generar indicadores de desempeño (KPI): OTIF, adherencia al plan, OEE planificado vs. real, backorders, niveles de inventario, y liderar acciones correctivas/preventivas.

9. Mantener maestros críticos (listas de materiales, hojas de ruta, work centers, calendarios, tiempos estándar) en coordinación con Ingeniería Industrial y Datos Maestros.

10. Asegurar el cumplimiento de normas de Seguridad, Calidad (GMP) y políticas corporativas en todos los procesos de programación.

11. Actuar como referente técnico de SAP para el equipo de Programación, entrenar a programadores junior y servir como backup del jefe de Programación.

12. Participar y liderar proyectos de mejora continua (Lean/AMS/Kaizen) orientados a capacidad, reducción de tiempos muertos, digitalización y automatización de reportes.

Cualificaciones requeridas

Formación académica en Ingeniería Civil Industrial, Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería en ejecución o carrera afín.

Experiencia: desde 3 años en programación de producción en empresas de consumo masivo o alta rotación, gestionando múltiples líneas. En negocios de alta regulación (manufactura de producto farmacéutico, alimentos, dispositivos médicos, etc.).

Deseable diplomado o certificación en Supply Chain/Planificación

Sistemas informáticos: dominio avanzado de SAP (PP, MM y WM; deseable QM/PM), Excel avanzado (Power Query/Power Pivot), y conocimiento de herramientas de visualización (Power BI).

每周至少50%时间同地区经理进行协访，并且对地区经理进行协访教导。

每月至少参加1-2次地区会议，并给予地区经理指导。

每季至少参加一次地区经理给代表所做的绩效评估并对地区经理给予反馈与指导。

每月同地区经理和区域市场经理进行生意回顾并讨论团队代表的报表，给予建议。

每月与中央市场部进行沟通，就大区相关问题进行讨论。

每月与大区商务经理、KA经理进行面对面沟通，就大区相关问题进行讨论。

每月与大区培训经理进行面对面沟通，就大区培训计划进行讨论。

每月至少同地区经理拜访重要客户10人。

每月检查代表/地区经理工作状况。

销售管理：

每半年根据公司下达的销售指标，根据指标分配程序及各地区销售情况，合理地将指标分配给地区经理。

根据地区经理所做的销售规划，每月进行跟踪，并及时修正、改进计划。

根据公司策略以及大区具体情况，制定出大区重点产品发育计划，并协助地区经理制定市场活动计划。

同商务部门加强合作，以保证销售渠道的畅通。

绩效发展：

每季初同每位地区经理进行一次全面绩效发展回顾及规划。（使用绩效发展及评估报告）。

每月同每位地区经理进行一次简要绩效评估。

财务管理：

每季初根据大区预算情况，按照预算费用管理程序及各地区销售情况、产品发育情况将预算分配给地区经理。

每月对费用进行分析和管理。

每季末对费用支出进行分析、总结。

培训与人员发展：

每季组织地区经理进行一次专业培训。

年初与直接下属讨论并制定个人的IDP （发展计划）。每半年根据下属绩效发展状况对下属提出相应建议。

Bring your passion, ideas, and purpose to life in a company that can help you shape your career as you shape the future of healthcare.

World Leader in Blood Glucose Monitoring, Abbott Diabetes Care designs, develops and manufactures glucose monitoring systems for use in both home and hospital settings.

We have a Centre of Excellence in Witney for the manufacture of electrodes and biosensors used by patients and healthcare professionals for the day-to-day management of diabetes. The Operations group is the largest team in the Witney facility, producing high volumes of test strips and biosensors each year to the stringent quality standards demanded by European and US authorities and our internal quality systems.

We have an opportunity for a Controls Engineer to join our Operations Group, working across all aspects of the manufacturing area of the business.

The role of the Controls Engineer is to provide an innovative approach to problem solving and stay abreast of current development in control systems technology to ensure the most effective solutions are applied to problems. Collaborating with engineering colleagues, you will be working on systems for motion control equipment, interpret PLC codes, debug issues and aid continuous improvement activities.

To be successful, you will need experience of working on automation projects and developing solutions to complex automation needs. You will be qualified to HNC level or higher in an Electrical, Electronic or Control Engineering discipline, however proven industry experience backed up by a recognised engineering apprenticeship will be considered. You need a track record of fault finding and modification to PLC, HMI, Motion Control for automated machinery, with exposure of Siemens S7/TIA Portal and Allen Bradley Studio 5000 being essential. Experience using Structured language in both platforms would be desirable. Furthermore, experience working with Oracle database knowledge would be advantageous. You will also need to be able to demonstrate a track record of accomplishing your objectives, working proactively, and managing your own time effectively. As we operate in a highly regulated industry, you must be able to demonstrate the ability to follow procedures and create accurate documents.

This is a fantastic opportunity to become a valued member of a highly skilled Engineering team working with brand new state-of-the-art automation in a fast-growing area of our business. Engineering skill is key to us, with members working in areas including projects, process, production, systems, software, R&D, and machine vision.

Abbott has health/wellness and financial benefits that help provide security for you and your family. As you’d expect from an innovative global health care company, we offer a competitive range of benefits including excellent salaries, a class-leading defined contribution pension scheme, private healthcare, life assurance, subsidised canteen and a flexible benefits scheme. Here at Witney, we also like to help our employees live life to the fullest, and therefore we offer a range of optional initiatives for you to get involved in, including couch to 5k campaigns,, yoga and more!

At Abbott, we’re committed to helping people live healthier, fuller lives. As part of our Corporate Finance Services (CFS) team based in Brussels HQ, you’ll play a key role in ensuring financial accuracy, compliance, and transparency across several EMEA entities within Abbott Medical Devices.

We’re looking for an Accountant – Entity Controller who enjoys ownership, cross-border collaboration, and working at the intersection of accounting excellence and business partnership.

Your role

In this position, you will act as Entity Controller for several EMEA legal entities, with end‑to‑end responsibility for accounting, statutory reporting, and audits. You’ll work closely with our Shared Service Organization (SSO), external accounting firms, and internal finance stakeholders.

Your key responsibilities include:

Drive and oversee the month‑end close for multiple EMEA entities (including HQ and operational entities)

Own and maintain US GAAP and Local GAAP books

Review and reconcile inventory and capital equipment

Manage and review complex journal entries (e.g. acquisitions, tax and restructuring adjustments)

Support the implementation of new US GAAP standards (e.g. leases, revenue recognition)

Act as Entity Controller for dormant entities and lead action plans toward liquidation

Ensure statutory compliance, including timely filing of financial statements in line with Abbott deadlines

Review balance sheet reconciliations and perform periodic financial reviews

Coordinate internal and external audits, ensuring smooth execution and no audit remarks

Serve as a key liaison between Accounting and Business Finance, providing clear insights and guidance

What you bring

A degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics

Solid experience in financial accounting, reporting, or controlling, ideally in an international environment

Strong knowledge of US GAAP; Local GAAP exposure is a plus

Experience working with shared service centers and external accounting providers

Comfortable handling complex accounting topics and multiple legal entities

Structured, detail‑oriented, and confident in taking ownership

Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across cultures

Fluent in English (French and/or Dutch are an advantage)

What we offer

A high‑impact role within a global, purpose‑driven healthcare company

Exposure to international entities and complex accounting topics

Strong collaboration with senior finance stakeholders across EMEA

Hybrid working model and a modern office in Machelen

Competitive compensation and benefits package

Continuous learning and career development opportunities

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, helping people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio spans diagnostics, medical devices, nutrition, and branded generic medicines, with more than 100,000 colleagues serving people in over 160 countries.

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:

Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

Our nutrition business develops science-based nutrition products for people of all ages, from helping babies and children grow, to keeping adult bodies strong and active. Main Purpose of Role:
Responsible for long-term growth of Abbott Nutrition products in territory by increasing awareness among Health Care professionals on the important role of nutrition in improving quality of life, and the superiority of Abbott products to competitor brands. Gain new business and grow existing business in customer accounts by building the confidence of HCPs in recommending Abbott brand products.

Main Responsibilities:

Drive impactful engagements with healthcare professionals (HCPs) through one-on-one consultations, highlighting the role of clinical nutrition in patient care and positioning Abbott as the preferred choice.

Build and strengthen relationships with HCPs across assigned accounts to boost brand visibility and influence product recommendations.

Gather market insights, including competitor activity and unmet needs, to develop targeted account plans that drive growth.

Deliver compelling product detailing to equip HCPs with the latest scientific knowledge and emphasize the clinical advantages of Abbott’s nutrition portfolio.

Address HCPs’ specific needs and objections with tailored messaging to gain their commitment to recommend Abbott products.

Collaborate with patient groups and stakeholders to support educational initiatives and raise awareness among patients and caregivers.

Track and report account performance against KPIs and take proactive steps to ensure targets are met.

Good organizational and time management abilities

Self-motivated, persistent, and goal-oriented

The Opportunity 

This position works out of our Plymouth, MN office, supporting our Electrophysiology Medical Device Division. In Abbott’s Electrophysiology (EP) business, we’re advancing the treatment of heart disease through breakthrough medical technologies in atrial fibrillation, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

This position will have overall responsibility for Operational Excellence work streams, including Front Line Excellence, Organizational Excellence, well as removing waste from the business. The Operational Excellence Leader will be responsible for leading and driving the principle-based behaviors within the plant which include: Creating value for our business and customers, accountability and ownership at all levels, integration and inclusiveness (within plant and outside of plant), focusing on the process, embracing data & facts, do it right the first time, leading by example and respect for all. It is through these pillars; the Operational Excellence Leader will be responsible for the identification, management and execution of projects within the plant which will deliver year-over-year improvements. The Operational Excellence Leader will be the catalyst within the site to appropriately, and respectfully, challenge status quo which will continually drive improvements via best practice replication (learning from within the network and externally), creative and innovative solutions, alignment of goals and objectives and resource planning to deliver results.

What You'll Work On

• Lead organization’s capability in knowledge and understanding of metrics and measurements which impact the total performance of the plant.

• Drive visual management and data understanding throughout the plant.

• Manage and facilitate continuous improvement projects in support of company objectives.

• Develops an implementation plan, conducts risk assessments and develops contingency plans to accommodate unforeseen events.

• Recognizes and removes barriers to project completion.

• Recognizes the broader implications of actions and proposals on the overall business.

• Mentor/train key stakeholders in the use and practice of continuous improvement methodologies and tools. (Lean, value stream mapping, six-sigma, Kaizen). Assesses current processes and standard work flow and identifies process improvement opportunities utilizing organizational, analytical, Lean and six sigma problem solving methodologies.

• Assist in selecting, scoping and prioritizing continuous improvement projects across the business ·Plans and facilitates the in the execution of various value stream mapping and Kaizen events.

• Estimates and verifies financial benefits from continuous improvement projects.

• Acts as a change agent by communicating the enterprise wide changes to the employees and helping them to learn, understand, adjust and grow within the continuous improvement culture.

• Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.

• Participates as a key business partner to the leadership team.

• Contributes to business strategy development and operational execution of business plans.

• Helps to create the future state as it relates to shortened value streams, manufacturing strategies, cross-functional processes, and the establishment of uniform policies and procedures.

• Develops programs and initiatives that support the business strategies and plans.

• Teams with Operations Leadership on organizational design and development to ensure appropriate results.

• Leads change to improve organizational effectiveness.

• Drives the change management necessary to implement effective programs.

• Thinks strategically to anticipate future issues and challenges and create appropriate plans now, using proactive approaches.

• Demonstrates analytical capability to find systemic issues to root cause, and crest actions plant to mitigate, close and/or eliminate.

Required Qualifications

Bachelors Degree (± 16 years); Engineering, Business, Operations, Science or related.

Minimum 8 years overall operations experience

2-4 years of demonstrated success in applying Continuous Improvement / BEx tools.

Minimum 2 - 5 years’ experience in manufacturing operations, business improvement, quality systems or other areas related to the project with an understanding of Abbott internal systems and procedures.

Certification or equivalent working knowledge of improvement tools and methodologies – Lean/Six Sigma; Black belt preferred.

Knowledge of applicable regulatory standards and requirements for FDA regulated environment.

Experience in operations management and knowledge of cost accounting/financial reporting systems.

Good functional computer skills (Microsoft Office programs, Excel, etc.) is required. Willingness to travel (to facilitate personal development and support of other sites).

Demonstrated diplomacy and effective functioning and communication in a matrix environment.

Ability to organize and lead cross functional teams and align team members to management's vision.

This position requires excellent interpersonal skills, demonstrated ability to effectively lead in a team environment, adaptable to change, able to manage competing priorities, excellent analytical and problem solving skills, excellent written and verbal communication skills and sense of business savvy.

Requires the ability to make critical decisions in a fast-paced production environment. Solicits the cooperation of a diverse group of disciplines and functions in a tactful and persuasive manner.

Reviews supplier quotes for accuracy and creates supplier comparison reports that include various factors such as price, performance, project costs, tooling cost, and other metrics that are needed to make key supplier decisions.

Lead special projects as requested to reduce cost, increase efficiency, etc.

Maintaining and enhancing relationships with user departments to implement improvements in the supply chain to reduce lead times, inventory and material liabilities.

Prepare detailed reports, both periodically and ad-hoc.

Serve as the owner of financial cost reporting and support Senior Management and key stakeholders to gain understanding of key revenue and cost drivers.

Provide value-added quantifications of purchase price variances and manufacturing costs.

Ensure costs and pricing within the cost tracking system are accurate and timely.

Provide analyses to support key business changes that impact the division.

Create cost models to help estimate and project future expenses.

Collaborate with category managers to maintaining visibility to materials costs and identify key business cost drivers.

The Opportunity

Develops, supports and approves acceptance criteria for materials and component qualification at the supplier including all applicable validation activities. Supporting improvement and corrective action in the quality of components sourced from outside suppliers. Provides quality input in the selection of suppliers. Provides technical and quality support to drive supplier corrective action, manufacturing yield issues and process improvements. Supports component risk management processes with suppliers.

What You'll Work On

Support New Product Introduction (NPI) and components projects, work with R&D and Global Engineering engineers and suppliers to optimize design drawings and supplier manufacturing processes so that high quality parts are consistently delivered.

Provide quality engineering oversight, support and consultancy to suppliers on process validations, design for manufacture (DFM), material selection, and process development.

Identify and prioritize parts (components and assemblies) requiring supplier development activities.

Review, understand and incorporate technical design risk assessments into the part evaluation process.

Support, develop and approves applicable Component Validation activities at suppliers, including but not limited to IQ, OQ, PQ, VMP and Test Method Validation

Support, develop, approves and owns Supplier Change Notification (SCN) for applicable component and supplier related changes. Ensures applicable evidence is reviewed and approved and CFT inputs to ensure changes are appropriately qualified.

Support the component quality aspects of Problem Solving, Failure Analysis, and Corrective and Preventative Actions with suppliers. Promote a culture of structured problem solving with suppliers.

Monitor and control the progress of supplier engineering projects to ensure sound application of quality and engineering principles are used and design intent is being followed. Assist Global Engineering and suppliers to develop Component Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (CFMEA).

Assist suppliers in developing Component Metrology and QC test requirements to ensure products meet specifications. Work with the applicable Incoming Quality Control departments to evaluate parts and resolve issues.

Provide quality support to supplier resilience, GMI, capacity expansion and continuous improvement initiatives.

Escalate potential supplier manufacturing and compliance issues. Travel to supplier sites as necessary.

Provide quality and technical support in failure analysis, re-design and drawing updates for discrepant production components, assemblies and field returns.

Abbott s’attache à développer le rôle primordial de la santé. Depuis plus de 125 ans, Abbott aide les gens à exploiter pleinement leur potentiel - car une meilleure santé permet aux personnes et aux communautés d’accomplir davantage. Grâce à un réseau mondial diversifié, desservant des clients dans plus de 160 pays, nous créons de nouvelles solutions qui couvrent tous les secteurs de la santé, partout dans le monde, et à toutes les étapes de la vie. Qu’il s’agisse de la prochaine génération d’outils de diagnostic, de dispositifs destinés à changer la vie, de nutrition reposant sur des fondements scientifiques ou de nouvelles reformulations, nous développons certaines des technologies les plus innovantes et révolutionnaires dans le domaine des soins de santé, en aidant les gens à améliorer leur vie grâce à une meilleure santé.

Objectif principal du poste:

Contribuer au développement et à la mise en œuvre du programme Environnement, Santé et Sécurité (HSE) pour les activités commerciales en France. Les éléments du programme HSE incluent la sécurité des conducteurs, l’enquête sur les incidents, la biosécurité et les agents pathogènes transmissibles par le sang, l’ergonomie, la préparation aux situations d’urgence, la communication des dangers, la radioprotection, la santé au travail.

Responsabilités principales:

Contribuer à la mise en conformité vis-à-vis des réglementations du Corporate, des divisions et de la législation française relatives à l’environnement, la santé et la sécurité.

Mettre en place et suivre les formations et les communications HSE.

Interagir avec les services du Corporate, les divisions et les organismes/agences française concernant les questions de sécurité, d’environnement et de santé.

Identifier et quantifier les risques HSE et leurs conséquences par rapport aux objectifs globaux de l’entreprise et recommander des actions appropriées. Reconnaître et répondre aux directions, aux conditions du marché, aux obligations réglementaires, etc., évaluer et intégrer les informations pour définir les effets bénéfiques sur l’entreprise.

Contribuer aux évaluations des risques et des réglementations HSE.

Aider les filiales à se préparer aux audits HSE (réglementaires, internes, etc.) et aux certifications HSE telles que l’ISO 14001.

Réaliser des revues pré-audit des normes HSE applicables.

Mettre en œuvre des programmes pour se conformer aux normes HSE applicables.

Présenter le programme HSE pour audit/inspection.

Aider à l’élaboration d’un plan d’action pour traiter les conclusions de l’audit.

Veiller à ce que les conclusions de l’audit soient résolues conformément au plan d’action.

Contribuer à la gestion accidents et maladies liées au travail.

Veiller à ce que tous les accidents soient signalés rapidement et fassent l’objet d’une enquête approfondie.

Veiller à ce qu’un plan d’action correctif soit élaboré pour prévenir la récurrence d’incidents similaires.

Contribuer à la gestion du programme de sécurité des conducteurs, y compris

Veiller à ce que les dossiers de conduite ou l’équivalent soient complétés pour tous les conducteurs éligibles.

Veiller à ce que les conducteurs à risque soient identifiés et que des formations prévention routière soient dispensées.

Veiller à la coordination de la formation pratique des nouveaux embauchés.

Veiller à la coordination et à la réalisation des formations de recyclage prévention routière.

Mettre en œuvre des initiatives pour améliorer et faire progresser continuellement la sécurité des conducteurs.

Contribuer à la remontée des données d’accidents de la route, des km et de la consommation de carburant

Veiller à ce que tous les accidents de la route fassent l’objet d’une enquête.

Contribuer à la mise en œuvre des programmes de radioprotection, de biosécurité, d’ergonomie, de préparation aux situations d’urgence, de communication des dangers et de santé au travail.

Idéalement Diplôme master ou licence en sécurité, santé, sciences de l’environnement, technique ou diplôme universitaire avec une appétence pour l’HSE.

The Role 

The Quality Operations Manager provides strategic leadership for all quality documentation, batch release, and compliance activities within the Casa Grande manufacturing site. This role ensures the integrity of the site’s Quality Management System (QMS) while guiding QA teams to deliver safe, compliant products that meet Abbott and regulatory standards. 

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

Manage QA teams responsible for quality documentation accuracy, batch record review, and product release within a manufacturing environment. 

Implement, maintain, and continuously improve the site Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure compliance with Abbott policies, divisional requirements, and applicable regulatory standards. 

Lead end to end batch documentation review, evaluating compliance, CAPA, interventions, and environmental monitoring data prior to batch release. 

Own the Batch Release process, managing nonconformances, initiating corrective actions, controlling product release, and coordinating quarantine of nonconforming product. 

Develop and monitor key quality metrics to track compliance, operational performance, and QMS effectiveness, using data to identify trends and drive continuous improvement. 

Review and approve site documentation change requests, assess corporate/divisional policy updates, and ensure aligned change control across impacted functions. 

Support new product introductions, ensuring documentation, label copy adherence, training, and certification requirements are met.

Serve as the site Quality System Management Representative and participate as a member of the site senior leadership team. 

Select, train, develop, and mentor QA staff to support current and future business needs and all elements of the QMS. 

Develop and maintain a culture where Health & Safety is an individual and collective responsibility; address H&S concerns and reduce risk within areas of responsibility. 

Manage CAPA processes including nonconformances, audit findings, and customer complaints; support field action activities when applicable. 

Ensure compliance with applicable local and international regulations for markets served, including evaluation of new regulations and their impact on the business. 

Lead QA personnel to achieve site and divisional objectives while upholding Abbott’s Code of Conduct and high standards of communication and professional behavior. 

Drive strong customer service within QA processes while maintaining regulatory and quality compliance. 

Support cost improvement initiatives and division driven programs without compromising quality or compliance. 

Manage QA resource planning and associated budget requirements (expense and capital). 

Partner with functional groups to ensure new products and changes deliver per agreed project timelines and quality expectations.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly at multiple levels in the organization.

Capable and willing to work an unpredictable schedule that may change on short notice

Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills with the ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels and to large groups within and outside the organization

Capable of managing multiple projects and accustomed to tight deadlines
