职位目标 Job Purpose:

In order to support the construction of the company's equipment maintenance management system, the digitalization of maintenance processes and the promotion of technology standardization, assist engineering and technical managers to carry out the technical management and on-site maintenance execution of the whole life cycle of equipment, and ensure the stable and efficient operation of production equipment; By implementing equipment inspection, preventive maintenance, fault handling, data recording and process execution, improve the comprehensive efficiency of equipment and reduce downtime losses; At the same time, it cooperates with the completion of spare parts management, instrumentation calibration, and new equipment maintenance system implementation, providing front-line technical implementation and support for the efficient operation of the company's equipment management system and the achievement of production and operation goals.

主要工作职责 Key Responsibilities:

Participate in the diagnosis, repair, and emergency handling of mechanical and electrical failures on production equipment, ensuring stable equipment operation. Execute routine maintenance tasks and strengthen on‑site operational maintenance fundamentals.

Support the Engineering & Technical Manager in building and improving the company’s equipment maintenance management system. Actively participate in the development, execution, and optimization of PM (Preventive Maintenance) plans, and facilitate the scientific transition from PM to AM (Autonomous Maintenance), ensuring the implementation of standardized maintenance workflows.

Participate in the company’s lean production initiatives, supporting the implementation and training of the Lean 14‑step methodology and the Six Systems. Provide lean improvement suggestions from the equipment maintenance perspective to enhance operational efficiency and management performance.

Support maintenance digital transformation, including equipment maintenance data collection, reporting, and analysis. Drive KPI tracking, spare‑parts digital management, and dynamic inventory control. Assist in defining and executing equipment failure classifications (Critical/Major/Middle/Minor).

Focus on key equipment maintenance performance indicators, monitoring and analyzing MTTR, MTBF, and repeat failure data. Identify weak components and establish targeted management strategies to develop data‑driven maintenance optimization solutions.

Take responsibility for the plant‑wide calibration of instruments and meters. Explore and apply digital methods for calibration process tracking, data retention, and issue closure, ensuring calibration accuracy and compliance.

Perform installation and validation tasks for replacement equipment, draft equipment maintenance SOPs, and develop maintenance documentation for new equipment/production lines. Contribute to the enhancement of the standardized maintenance framework and promote process standardization and traceability.

Support the department in consolidating maintenance experience and developing standardized documentation. About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader who is creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We always look towards the future, anticipating medical science and technology changes. We are dedicated to expanding access to our trusted medicines in some of the world's fastest-growing countries. Our extensive portfolio includes high-quality, differentiated branded generic medicines that cover various therapeutic areas, such as gastroenterology, women's health, cardiometabolic health, pain management/central nervous system disorders, and respiratory diseases.

Working at Abbott 

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self and live a whole life. You will have access to: 

Career development with an international company where you can grow your dream career.

A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies by Fortune. 

A company recognized as one of the best big companies to work for and the best place for diverse working mothers, female executives, and scientists. 

The Opportunity 

The Head of Trade is a key member of the leadership team in FAC , based in Algeria within the Established Pharmaceutical Division.

As the Trade head at Abbott EPD FAC, you will shape and execute our trade vision and strategy, leading the Trade teams across FAC . You will foster an integrated Trade , creating innovative value propositions and digital solutions to establish Abbott as the most reputable partner for trade customers and build strategic relationships with them.

You will be accountable for managing the financial objectives of the trade team, driving profitable growth, and enhancing brand visibility and recommendation rates by optimizing local trade structures, driving operational efficiency, adapting global projects, strengthening brand presence, implementing SOPs and best practices, coordinating with cross-functional teams, and overseeing inventory levels.

Additionally, you will identify new trade opportunities, monitor market conditions, and adjust trade strategies. Ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities: 

Operational Strategic Leadership:

Develop and implement a Trade strategy in the cluster to optimise trade in all channels, aligned with the Global Strategy, market dynamics, and local objectives.

Create value proposition projects to boost sell-out and drive profitable growth in Trade & e-commerce channels, cross-functionally aligned with the country’s vision and strategy across the FAC cluster 

Execute innovative Trade Marketing tactics such as merchandising recommendations, materials, and patient support programs to enhance Abbott’s brand availability, visibility, and recommendation rates.

Collaborate with local and regional Brand Marketing Teams, identify the brand's priorities, and bring field insights to translate brand strategy into Trade initiatives.

Enhance local trade structures to match market potential and optimize the route to market.

Adapt global projects to maximize brand performance across channels and build pharmacy advocacy.

Strengthen brand presence in all channels to increase brand and corporate SOV, improving visibility and monitoring progress.

Negotiate with key accounts to ensure trade support & customized offerings.

Map the pharmacy market landscape.

Coordinate locally with Marketing and Sales to roll out marketing initiatives such as new launches, new trade channels, and promotional campaigns.

Relationship Management across FAC Cluster 

Establish and maintain strategic relationships with key trade customers, distributors, wholesalers, and pharmacies.

Liaise with key purchasers in retail pharmacies and wholesalers, optimizing services to benefit Abbott.

Train and support pharmacy staff to enhance their capabilities and ensure consistent product messaging.

Conduct quarterly business reviews with key customers to assess performance and identify growth opportunities.

Financial and Performance Management:

Set and manage the annual budget aligned with sales and marketing for key accounts, ensuring expenditures stay within plan.

Establish and monitor KPIs for key activities, driving corrective actions to achieve financial objectives as needed.

Develop and manage the trade budget, ensuring efficient resource allocation.

Analyze sales data, market trends, and competitor activities to identify improvement areas and drive growth.

Prepare performance reports to senior management, providing actionable insights and recommendations.

Operational Efficiency and Inventory Management:

Optimize Trade operations using data analytics, automation & advanced technology solutions when applicable. 

Implement SOPs and best practices to enhance operational efficiency, reduce costs, and improve performance metrics.

Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless operations and alignment with objectives.

Oversee inventory levels to ensure timely product availability, collaborating with distributors and stakeholders to optimize supply chain operations, minimize stockouts, and manage inventory costs.

Develop and implement a demand forecasting model to maintain safe inventory stocks.

Compliance and Quality Assurance:

Ensure compliance of all trade activities with relevant Acts, legal demands, trade standards, and Corporate Business and Safety procedures.

Address and resolve compliance issues promptly to avoid supply chain disruptions.

Market Research Strategy:

Conduct market research to identify new trade opportunities, emerging trends, and competitive landscapes.

Monitor market conditions and adjust trade strategies to maintain a competitive advantage

Team Leadership:

Play a crucial role in shaping Abbott FAC's trade vision, strategy, and leadership as an integral member of the country's leadership team.

Oversee, coach, and develop the Abbott-EPD Trade teams (Sales, Marketing, and E-commerce when applicable ) across FAC, ensuring they achieve their professional development goals. Foster seamless and integrated business planning while promoting a culture of continuous improvement and high performance.

Cultivate and enhance the trade marketing mindset and capabilities of the Abbott-EPD Trade sales team to build strong relationships with key customers.

Customer Satisfaction:

Ensure timely and accurate order fulfilment to meet customer expectations.

Promptly resolve pharmacy-related issues to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction.

Implement customer feedback mechanisms to improve service quality continuously.

Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor's degree in pharmaceutical Science, Business or a related field.

Advanced degrees or certifications in business administration, Marketing, Sales, public health, health economics, or health policy are advantageous.

Experience

Must have experience managing trade/ channel management with Distributors across North and west Africa market.

Extensive experience and leadership positions in managing sales, marketing (at least 2 years), Customer excellence, or logistics, preferably Trade marketing and OTC management experience within the pharmaceutical industry, and expertise in inventory systems.

In-depth industry knowledge gained from experience in a multinational company.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Kom bij ons team als Allround Monteur in een 5-ploegendienst!

 

Wat ga je doen?

Stap in een technisch uitdagende en complexe omgeving binnen onze fabriek, waar je nauw samenwerkt met collega-monteurs en operators. Jij bent dé specialist van de productieploeg voor preventief en correctief onderhoud aan de lijn. Jouw bijdrage is cruciaal voor de betrouwbaarheid van onze technische bedrijfsinstallaties.

 

Past jouw profiel niet helemaal bij wat wij vragen? Geen probleem! Solliciteer toch, zodat we jou kunnen helpen met jouw ontwikkeling!

Wat worden je belangrijkste taken en verantwoordelijkheden?

Preventief onderhoud uitvoeren aan bedrijfsinstallaties tijdens geplande stilstanden.

Verstoringen verhelpen in zowel mechanische als elektrotechnische disciplines na melding van de interne klant, en aangeven hoeveel tijd nodig is om de problemen op te lossen.

Dagelijks storingen en onderhoudswerkzaamheden registreren in het onderhoudssysteem en benodigde onderhoudslijsten uitdraaien.

Communiceren met lijnoperators en ploegenmonteurs over lopende zaken en de Technical Specialist ondersteunen bij Rootcause Analyse op technisch vlak.

Aanbevelingen doen voor Demand Maintenance of optimalisatie aan de Technical Specialist op basis van analyses van technische storingen.

Samenwerken met andere monteurs en zorgen voor een goede werkverdeling en overdracht van taken.

Initiatief nemen en voorstellen doen voor verbeteringen van apparatuur of onderhoudsprogramma’s ten behoeve van kwaliteit en efficiency.

Contractors en externe specialisten begeleiden.

Toezicht houden op de naleving van bedrijfs- en veiligheidsvoorschriften.

Actief de tijd benutten om machines en apparatuur te observeren met als doel optimalisatie.

 

Wat zoeken wij?

Een MBO-opleiding richting Elektronica/Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare opleiding op niveau 4.

Ruime ervaring binnen een productieomgeving, bij voorkeur in de voedsel- en/of farmaceutische industrie.

Ruime kennis en werkervaring op een van de technische vakgebieden (mechanisch, elektrisch of besturing (PLC)) en in staat om vrijwel alle complexe storingen zelfstandig op te lossen. VCA-gecertificeerd.

Een echte vakman/vrouw die zich bewust is van de hoge eisen die aan onderhoud worden gesteld in deze industrie.

Open en duidelijke communicatie, leergierig, flexibel en stressbestendig.

 

Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?

Een goed salaris.

Een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) met vakantietoeslag, 13e maand, bijzonder verlof en extra vakantiedagen.

 

Hoe solliciteer je?

Ben je geïnteresseerd in deze vacature en herken je jezelf in het bovenstaande profiel? Solliciteer dan met je CV en motivatie via onze website. Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met Meltem Cakir, Recruiter, via recruitment.netherlands@abbott.com. Onderdeel van onze selectieprocedure is het nagaan van referenties en het overleggen van een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag. Daarnaast kan een assessment center onderdeel uitmaken van het sollicitatieproces.We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie!

Job Description

GIỚI THIỆU VỀ ABBOTT

Abbott là công ty chăm sóc sức khỏe toàn cầu, tiên phong trong nghiên cứu khoa học và tạo ra những đột phá trong công nghệ chăm sóc sức khỏe để giúp mọi người sống khỏe mạnh hơn. Chúng tôi luôn hướng tới tương lai, dự đoán và đáp ứng những thay đổi trong khoa học và công nghệ y khoa. Những công nghệ mang tính thay đổi cuộc sống của Abbott trải dài nhiều lĩnh vực từ dinh dưỡng, chẩn đoán đến thiết bị y tế và dược phẩm.

LÀM VIỆC TẠI ABBOTTTại Abbott, bạn có thể làm công việc tạo ra giá trị và ý nghĩa cho cộng đồng. Bạn được trao cơ hội để học hỏi và phát triển, chăm sóc bản thân và gia đình, đồng

thời thể hiện và phát huy tối đa tiềm năng của bản thân trong cả sự nghiệp và cuộc sống. Bạn sẽ có cơ hội:

Phát triển sự nghiệp tại một công ty toàn cầu, nơi bạn có thể hiện thực hóa ước mơ nghề nghiệp của mình.

Làm việc tại một môi trường được công nhận là “Nơi làm việc tốt nhất” tại nhiều quốc gia và được tạp chí Fortune (Mỹ) vinh danh là một trong những công ty được ngưỡng mộ nhất thế giới.

Trở thành một phần của doanh nghiệp hàng đầu, được công nhận là nơi làm việc tốt nhất với môi trường tuyệt vời cho sự đa dạng và hòa nhập.

Địa điểm: Thanh Hóa

Mô hình tập trung vào quản lý nhân sự Field Trade đẩy Sell-Out tại điểm bán. tập trung vào trưng bày, quà tặng khuyến mãi, PG, trải nghiệm người tiêu dùng tại điểm bán (Key shop) - quản lý 20-35 Key Shop và chương trình khuyến mãi

1. Triển khai hoạt động tiếp thị tại điểm bán – Hỗ trợ Sell-out Theo dõi và triển khai các chương trình tiếp thị dành cho cửa hàng và người tiêu dùng. Quản lý quà tặng: phân bổ, theo dõi và thống kê tồn kho. Cập nhật và báo cáo các hoạt động của đối thủ cạnh tranh tại thị trường. 

2. Quản lý đội ngũ PG (Promotion Girls) – 20-35 người tại các Key Shops Sắp xếp lịch làm việc, phân công khu vực và giám sát hiệu quả làm việc của PGs. Đề xuất tuyển dụng, đào tạo và huấn luyện PGs mới. Kiểm tra định kỳ hoạt động của PGs tại điểm bán, đảm bảo tuân thủ quy trình và hình ảnh thương hiệu. 

3. Hỗ trợ kinh doanh và báo cáo Phối hợp chặt chẽ với đội ngũ Sales để triển khai các hoạt động thúc đẩy bán hàng. About The Role and What we Look For

 The Field Service Engineer (FSE) delivers exceptional customer support by performing on-site installations and managing all aspects of system diagnostics, troubleshooting, servicing, and repairs for complex equipment and systems. The FSE ensures operational quality by inspecting and approving system performance.

This role also trains customers on system operation and maintenance while acting as the primary liaison between the company and the customer for both technical and administrative matters related to assigned projects.

The FSE interprets customer needs and determines whether issue resolution should involve sales personnel, customer support representatives, or engineers. Responsibilities may encompass all facets of field support, including but not limited to system hardware and software, PCs, and networking/wireless networking.

To qualify for this position, candidates must be able to furnish proof that they are authorized to work in the country they are applying on a permanent basis without sponsorship.

Job Description

LOCATION: This role will be remote out of the Memphis, TN area or close proximity

The Field Service Engineer (FSE) provides highly visible customer support through the performance of on-site installation, as well as overseeing any necessary diagnoses, troubleshooting, service, and repair of complex equipment and systems. Checks out and approves operational quality of system equipment. This role instructs customers in the operation and maintenance of the system and serves as company liaison with customer on administrative and technical matters for assigned projects. The FSE will interpret customers’ needs and clarifies if the responsibility for problem resolution falls to sales personnel, customer support reps, or engineers. This job may include any aspect of field support, and is not limited to system hardware and software, PCs, and networking/wireless networking. 

 

 ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

PRODUCT SUPPORT

 Provide installation, repair, upgrade, and maintenance support for TomoTherapy and CyberKnife systems located at assigned customer sites

Promote customer satisfaction through the timely response to customer calls, clear and effective communications with internal and external customers, professional appearance, and efficient repair/maintenance activities

Maintain regular communication with direct manager, peer field personnel, and commercial team members for any customer matters requiring attention

Self-manage schedule and work priorities to ensure that urgent customer requirements are addressed appropriately, and customer satisfaction is optimized

Support is provided to the customer remotely by phone, internet and by onsite visits, as determined by the machine status or customer requirements Maintain complete and timely documentation of work activities

Initial review of customer issues, such that customer concerns with product performance and safety are quickly communicated to Accuray for appropriate review and handling

Assist in the training of other Customer Support staff, and customer or site personnel with respect to maintenance and service activities, as required

Work with other FSEs and/or Customer Support Staff on CyberKnife or TomoTherapy products as required

Responsible for the proper management of parts inventory and the timely return of replaced parts in accordance with Accuray return requirements.

Ensure timely and accurate submission of expense reports related to field service activities, customer support, and required company travel or training.

Assist in the review and development of service documentation

Assist in identification and development of field support tools and test equipment

Maintain company vehicle (if provided) in accordance with Accuray fleet vehicle policy, including safe operations, vehicle cleanliness and vehicle maintenance

Willing to travel up to 25% outside of assigned service area, sometimes with little notice

 

PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

Provides feedback for service-related product improvements

Assist in the development, documentation, and testing of service tools and design updates to the product

Support project team activities, with attendance at team meetings, representation of field service requirements

QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

Minimum 5 years’ experience in field service, installation, and troubleshooting complex electronic equipment or bachelor’s degree in with less field experience considered

Successful candidates will demonstrate an ability to be a self-starter and have the ability to work without close supervision, be able to successfully schedule, organize and conduct field service activities in assigned territory

The demonstrated ability to communicate complex information to a wide range of audiences including executive level management

Strong system level troubleshooting skills

Strong computer skills with an understanding of basic networking

Strong interpersonal and presentation skills

Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and work in a physically active environment

Preferred or Desired:

 Previous experience in large medical device field service strongly preferred

Former military experience a plus

Bachelor’s degree in engineering

Knowledge of medical linear accelerator or microwave RF systems and computer networks preferred

Robotics and or electro-mechanical systems service experience preferred

To qualify for this position, candidates must be able to furnish proof that they are authorized to work in the country they are applying on a permanent basis without sponsorship.

SUMMARY:

Their primary focus is new vault sales for break-in accounts. The Regional Sales Director role is pivotal in driving the growth and market share of the company's systems within the assigned market.

REPORTING TO/DEPARTMENT: 

Reports to the Vice President of Sales

Knowledge of Accuray product portfolio.

Well-established relationships across key hospitals, medical centers and key physicians across the market.

BA/BS.

Proven track record of selling at both the clinical and C-suite levels.

Experience in the radiation oncology and/or medical industry.

A minimum of 5 years of sales experience with the ability to manage a large market.

Job Description

Field Service Engineer - EIMEA – India – Coimbatore

SUMMARY:

Accuray EIMEA is searching for a Field Service Engineer, home-office based in Coimbatore region (India).

The person in this position has front-line responsibility for installations, remote and on-site diagnostics prior to repair services as well as preventive maintenance visits on Accuray systems, primarily to Accuray customers located regionally but occasionally throughout all EIMEA Region.

The successful candidate must have proven ability to diagnose and resolve problems on highly sophisticated software, electronic and mechanical robotic devices at clinical sites and major hospitals. Applicants must have the ability to work independently and have effective communication skills.

Field Service engineers may also work hours other than a traditional daytime shift and may also work weekend days as part of their normal workdays with limited notice due to the emergent nature of service work. Regular work schedules are determined by a combination of Accuray’s service obligations and customer service needs and are subject to change as needs arise.

REPORTING TO/DEPARTMENT: 

Deputy Service Manager India

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 

PRODUCT SUPPORT 

Provide installation, repair and maintenance support to Accuray systems.

Support is provided to the customer remotely by phone, internet and by on-site visits, as determined by the machine status or customer requirements.

Promoting the highest level of customer satisfaction through the timely response to customer calls, clear and effective communications, professional appearance, and efficient repair/maintenance activities.

Self-management of schedule and work priorities to ensure that urgent customer requirements are addressed timely and customer satisfaction is optimized.

Accurate and clear documentation of work activities are to be completed within the Accuray Customer Management software program, such that these records provide appropriate documentation of the product service history for Device History File records.

Appropriate care of parts inventory and prompt return of replaced parts that are required to be returned to the Accuray stock for processing.

Appropriate management and timely completion of Timesheets and expense reports incurred in the field service of Accuray systems.

Assist in the development of service documentation, in conjunction with the Accuray Customer Service team.

Assist in the training of further Customer Support staff and customer on site personnel with respect to maintenance and service activities, as required.

Assist in identification and development of Field Support tools and test equipment.

Follow Company training as needed. (e.g., basic technical training of 6 weeks at Accuray Headquarters in the US).

Learn and apply all Accuray internal policies and processes.

Follow local regulations (such as radioprotection rules – attends and runs TUV Audits at customer).

PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT 

Provides feedback through the Madison Customer Service group for service-related product improvements that could improve Mean Time to Access (MTTA) and Mean Time to Repair (MTTR), or improvements in mean Time Between Failures (MTBF).

Assist in the development, documentation, and testing of service tools and design updates to the product.

Works effectively with other engineers, scientists, subcontractors, and consultants.

Support project team activities, with attendance at team meetings, representation of Field Service requirements, and provision of documentation as required.

SAFETY 

Observe Accuray Safety Program requirements and work practices.

Help ensure that safety requirements and quality considerations are pro-actively addressed and implemented in the design of the product.

Communicate to the Accuray corporate, or where possible directly address, quality issues raised by customers, in a timely fashion.

Supports the Accuray Quality System and Safety and Health Program by following procedures and mentoring others.

Takes ownership of individual safety to maintain a safe work environment.

The incumbent may be asked to perform other function-related activities in addition to the above-mentioned responsibilities as reasonably required by business needs.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum 3 years’ experience in field service, installation, and troubleshooting complex electronic equipment or bachelor’s degree in with less field experience considered. A basic understanding of medical physics is desirable.

Previous experience in large medical device field service strongly preferred.

Be a self-starter and work without close supervision, be able to successfully schedule, organize and conduct field service activities in assigned territory

Hands-on experience with electronic test equipment.

Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Good H/W and S/W computer skills, including network knowledge. Ability to quickly learn to use new software tools.

Excellent customer relations skills and strong service orientation.

Team player - ability to work well in a close team environment.

Fluent reading, writing and speaking in local language and English.

Must be comfortable with extensive travel (up to 50% travel time), sometimes on short notice, and occasional after-hours support requirements.

Represents Accuray effectively and professionally to the market.

Drives qualitative and quantitative performance of indirect channel partners including channel optimization and adequate coaching.

Supports the indirect channel partners to ensure successful product positioning and competitive offering.

Establishes robust business plans and accurate sales forecasts.

Develops account specific sales strategies and applies sales tactics to meet the company’s regional objectives.

Builds-up and maintains an in-depth, comprehensive knowledge and expertise on Accuray’s product portfolio.

Expands collaborative network of KOL advocators.

Creates, maintains and nurtures relationships with key accounts, ensuring highest satisfaction levels and fostering long-term partnerships with Accuray users, customers and prospect including radiation oncologists, radiation therapists, medical physicists and healthcare executives.

Ensures compliance with company policies and procedures in all channel partner activities.

Represents Accuray at relevant exhibitions and congresses.

Minimum bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Engineering, or in a related field.

Around 7 years’ working experience in both direct & in-direct sales in the medical device industry in ASEAN – ideally in capital equipment business such as radiology, radiation therapy or a similar therapeutical medical discipline.

Hands-on expertise with SalesForce CRM, sales reporting and ERP systems.

Excellent interpersonal, organizational and presentation skills including the ability to present complex technology to healthcare professionals.

Guardrails Platform Architecture

The Adobe Firefly Applied Science & Machine Learning team is building next-generation multimodal guardrail systems for building safe and compliant image, video, and audio generative models powering Firefly.com. Our goal extends beyond reactive blocking; we are developing model-level guidance mechanisms that proactively steer generation away from IP-violating concepts while preserving creative intent and usability. 

We are seeking a P40 Applied Scientist with strong multimodal depth and research instincts to help define and develop the frontier of IP-aware generative modeling. This role sits at the intersection of generative model alignment, multimodal reasoning, and large-scale inference systems. 

 

Research Areas You Will Drive 

Inference-Time Alignment & Optimization 

Research and implement inference-time control techniques (guided decoding, constrained sampling, classifier guidance, reward-based steering). 

Optimize large multimodal systems for low-latency, production-scale deployment without sacrificing alignment quality. 

Identify and mitigate failure modes in generative pipelines at scale. 

Rapid Scientific Experimentation 

Develop and implement rigorous experiments to evaluate trade-offs between creativity, fidelity, and IP safety. 

Develop new evaluation methodologies and benchmarks for multimodal IP compliance. 

Contribute novel technical insights that may lead to publications or internal intellectual property. 

Vision-Language & Multimodal Reasoning 

Advance the use of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and multimodal foundation models for semantic IP understanding. 

Explore joint reasoning between perception and generation systems to enable real-time steering. 

Experiment how various techniques, e.g. multimodal embeddings, cross-attention mechanisms, etc., can be used for safety-aware inference. 

Multimodal IP-Aware Generative Modeling 

Develop novel approaches for integrating IP constraints directly into generative model behavior. 

Investigate controllable generation techniques that shift models from post-hoc blocking toward guided, alignment-aware synthesis. 

Develop training and fine-tuning strategies that embed guardrail signals into model representations. 

 

What You’ll Do 

Architect and evolve the Firefly IP Guard pipeline across first-party and third-party generative models. 

Collaborate with research scientists, ML engineers and other key partners like applied ethics, legal etc., to translate scientific advances into deployed systems. 

Communicate with other non-technical collaborators to help drive awareness about the implemented technologies. 

Drive end-to-end experimentation, from hypothesis formulation through model implementation and large-scale evaluation. 

Contribute to the broader research strategy around generative AI alignment and safety within Adobe.

Research & Technical Depth

The success of generative AI guardrails is not determined solely by model architecture; it is defined by the quality of the concepts we protect, the robustness of our detection science, and the realism of our evaluation methodology. 

The Adobe Firefly Applied Science & Machine Learning team is expanding its IP guardrail systems for building safe and compliant image, video, and audio generative models. A central challenge is long-tail IP coverage: foundation models cannot internalize every protected concept. Advancing our guardrails therefore requires principled approaches to multimodal knowledge integration, detection modeling, and real-world evaluation science. 

We are seeking a P40 Applied Scientist to drive the scientific development of IP concept modeling, detection strategies, and evaluation frameworks that determine the robustness ceiling of our guardrail systems. This is a research-oriented role focused on advancing multimodal detection and evaluation methodologies at production scale. 

 

Research Areas You Will Drive 

Multimodal Concept Modeling & Knowledge Integration 

Develop principled methods for representing and organizing large-scale IP concept spaces across text, image, and audio. 

Study how retrieval-augmented systems (RAG), embedding alignment, and structured knowledge can complement multimodal foundation models. 

Investigate strategies for improving long-tail concept coverage beyond what VLMs inherently encode. 

Design concept modeling techniques that meaningfully influence downstream guardrail decisions. 

Data Acquisition & Curation for Detection 

Develop scalable approaches for acquiring and curating high-quality multimodal datasets that improve detection coverage for IP-sensitive concepts. 

Drive long-tail expansion through targeted data collection, web-scale sourcing, and synthetic data generation. 

Analyze failure cases in generative outputs to inform targeted data acquisition and dataset refinement. 

Design efficient data curation and labeling strategies that improve signal quality and robustness of downstream detection systems. 

 

Evaluation Methodology & Benchmark Design 

Define evaluation frameworks that reflect real-world Firefly usage patterns. 

Design multimodal benchmark datasets that stress-test guardrails under realistic and adversarial scenarios. 

Develop metrics that capture over-blocking, under-blocking, semantic similarity, and near-miss generation. 

Establish statistically rigorous offline and online evaluation strategies that guide research prioritization. 

Study how evaluation quality constrains and enables system-level progress. 

Scientific Iteration Guided by Input 

Leverage large-scale product feedback signals to identify systematic weaknesses in guardrail behavior. 

Translate real-world interaction patterns into structured evaluation hypotheses. 

Build reproducible experimental pipelines that enable continuous scientific iteration. 

 

What You’ll Do 

Lead scientific design of IP concept expansion and detection methodologies. 

Formulate hypotheses around long-tail coverage, detection robustness, and evaluation gaps. 

Run rigorous experiments to quantify performance ceilings and identify high-leverage improvements. 

Partner closely with generative model scientists to ensure alignment between detection, guidance, and evaluation systems. 

Contribute to intellectual property and potential publications in multimodal learning, evaluation science, or AI safety. 

 

What You’ll Need to Succeed 

Research & Technical Depth 

PhD or MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or related field. 

5+ years of experience in applied ML, multimodal systems, or evaluation research. 

Strong understanding of Vision-Language Models, multimodal transformers, and embedding-based retrieval systems. 

Experience designing and analyzing large-scale benchmarks and evaluation datasets. 

Solid background in statistical analysis, experimental design, and performance trade-off evaluation. 

Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch). 

Scientific Approach

Job Details

We are seeking a highly skilled Information Retrieval Engineer to lead the development and optimization of retrieval systems that power context-aware large language models (LLMs). This role focuses on building robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ensure AI agents and applications have access to the most relevant, timely, and high-quality information.

You'll work at the intersection of data engineering, machine learning, and knowledge management—enabling better reasoning, accuracy, and performance for enterprise-grade AI systems.

Key Responsibilities

RAG System Design:

Architect and deploy scalable retrieval pipelines using vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Weaviate, Pinecone, Qdrant)

Implement semantic search infrastructure and hybrid retrieval systems (semantic + keyword)

Data Processing & Ingestion:

Build ingestion pipelines for both structured and unstructured data sources

Implement document chunking strategies, embedding generation (e.g., OpenAI, Cohere, HuggingFace), and metadata tagging

Retrieval Optimization:

Fine-tune relevance scoring, reranking algorithms, and query understanding mechanisms

Develop techniques to improve precision/recall for specific business domains or user tasks

Knowledge Enhancement:

Create and maintain knowledge graphs to support context linking and disambiguation

Manage data freshness and version control to ensure consistency and reliability of retrieved content

Reasoning Support:

Design and iterate on context window strategies that improve LLM reasoning (e.g., adaptive injection, task-based retrieval)

Collaborate with prompt engineers and model developers to align retrieval outputs with downstream model behavior

Performance Monitoring:

Track key retrieval metrics such as accuracy, latency, and fallback rate

Implement caching, prefetching, and deduplication strategies to optimize system responsiveness

Qualifications

Required:

4+ years in data engineering, ML infrastructure, or information retrieval

Experience building and deploying RAG pipelines or semantic search systems

Strong Python skills and familiarity with retrieval libraries (e.g., Haystack, LangChain, Elasticsearch, Milvus)

Proficiency with embedding models, vector similarity search, and document indexing

Familiarity with cloud platforms and MLOps tooling (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Docker)

Preferred:

Knowledge of graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, TigerGraph) or knowledge graph design

Experience optimizing retrieval for LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral)

Background in IR/NLP, Search Engineering, or Cognitive Computing

Bachelors or Masters Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field

Success in This Role Looks Like:

High-recall, low-latency retrieval pipelines that enhance LLM outputs with accurate, relevant context

Modular, reusable RAG components that can be applied across use cases and domains

Continuous improvement of retrieval relevance and reasoning alignment through experimentation and monitoring

Strong collaboration with AI engineers, prompt engineers, and data owners to maintain data quality and user trust

The Opportunity 

Adobe’s products empower people everywhere to imagine, create, and transform how the world works. Our Solutions Consultants are the trusted guides who bring that power to life for customers—turning possibility into clarity, and vision into measurable impact.

We are seeking a Director, Global Solutions Consulting to lead well-established teams across North America and EMEA. This leader will set the vision, standards, and operating model for our world-class team. The role spans both Creative Cloud and Document Cloud solution areas while remaining product-agnostic enough to flex with evolving portfolio needs. The Director will define excellence in discovery, value storytelling, demo execution, Proof of Value (PoV) methodology, and cross-functional execution.
 

What You’ll Lead

You will lead well-established Solutions Consulting teams across North America and EMEA. You will craft a unified standard of excellence for both Creative Cloud and Document Cloud solutions. With you on the team, we will ensure consistent execution, seamless cross-regional collaboration, and strong alignment with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Marketing partners!
 

What You’ll Do

Set strategic direction and operating standards for the Global Solutions Consulting organization.

Drive revenue impact by elevating discovery, solution mapping, proof of value rigor, and storytelling

Partner closely with regional Sales leaders and Sales Operations to influence pipeline, forecast accuracy, and deal strategy.

Build and mentor a strong management bench, creating a high-performance culture rooted in accountability, curiosity, and growth.

Lead cross-functional collaboration with Product, PMM, Customer Success, and Professional Services.

Work with leadership team to establish global standard methodologies, demo frameworks, reusable assets, and enablement programs.

Represent Solutions Consulting as an executive sponsor with key customers.
 

What You’ll Bring

10+ years of Solutions Consulting, Pre-Sales, or related experience, with 3–5+ years leading multi-region teams.

Deep proficiency in consultative discovery, value storytelling, enterprise architecture, and executive communication.

Experience with both Creative Cloud and Document Cloud workflows, or comparable enterprise solutions.

Creative approach to solving tough problems, operational rigor, and experience partnering across Sales, Product, and Customer Success.

Ability to foster an inclusive, high-trust, high-accountability team culture.
 

How You’ll Measure Success

Conversion rate improvement, Average Deal Size growth, and sales cycle efficiency.

Demo and PoV quality benchmarks and adoption of standards across regions.

Team engagement, leadership strength, and talent development.

Operational benchmarks including coverage ratios and capacity utilization.
 

How You’ll Partner
 

You will work seamlessly with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Product Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services, RevOps, and Alliances to ensure alignment, consistent go-to-market execution, and a frictionless customer experience across all regions.
 

Team & Culture
 

We thrive when our team is invested in winning together. We're proud of the culture we're building and want to bring in a leader that makes us all better. You will nurture a culture of customer-centricity, innovation, curiosity, craftsmanship, and cross-team collaboration. As leaders, we model the behaviors we expect—clarity, empathy, execution excellence, and continuous improvement.
 

Location & Travel
 

This role leads distributed teams across North America and EMEA. Travel is required for leadership meetings, customer engagements, team events, and cross-functional alignment.

Convert the success roadmap created during pre-sales into a comprehensive, managed transition plan featuring clear sequencing, decision points, and risk controls.

Foster and maintain trust in architectural direction, serving as a strategic advisor to senior business and technology collaborators.

Proven experience providing enterprise architecture leadership across transformation programmes, from early visioning and pre-sales through delivery, adoption, and platform evolution.

Broad understanding of digital marketing, data, and activation ecosystems.

The ability to craft compelling narratives that translate architectural choices into business-relevant results

Experience operating as a trusted architectural advisor

Strong understanding of AI, automation, and emerging agentic models, and their implications for enterprise platforms.

Experience working closely with delivery teams, partners, and vendors to maintain build integrity.

A collaborative, outcome-focused leadership style, with a relentless focus on value and adoption.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior ML Engineer to join the Firefly team within Adobe's Applied Science and Machine Learning (ASML) organization. Firefly is Adobe's family of creative generative AI models that power next-generation creative experiences across Adobe's products. In this role, you will work at the frontier of multimodal AI by starting from foundational models and adapting them for various real-world use cases and products. You will develop and build innovative generation pipelines, bring powerful research into production, and collaborate closely with research, product, and infrastructure teams to invent the future of AI-powered creativity.

What you'll Do

Foundational Model Development & Adaptation

Engage with large-scale pretrained models for multimodal generation (image, text, video, and beyond) and tailor them to support Adobe Firefly products and features.

Research, prototype, and integrate brand-new techniques from the latest literature into production-grade generation pipelines.

Construct and refine innovative end-to-end pipelines for multimodal generation, balancing quality, performance, and scalability.

Data Strategy & User Workflows

Work alongside data and research teams to review, modify, and recommend improvements to data strategies that support model training and fine-tuning.

Analyze and iterate on user-facing workflows, translating product requirements into model and pipeline build decisions.

Contribute to dataset curation, annotation strategy, and evaluation frameworks for generative models.

Technical Excellence & Collaboration

Participate in build reviews and code reviews, upholding high standards for code quality, architecture, and reproducibility.

Build and maintain robust technical documentation, design documents, and engineering standards.

Collaborate with partner teams across ASML and contribute actively to technical roadmaps and cross-functional planning.

Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge through pairing, code review, and internal technical talks.

What you need to succeed

Technical Depth

5+ years of industry experience in machine learning engineering, with a strong focus on deep learning for computer vision or multimodal generation.

Practical experience handling extensive, intricate ML codebases and current ML frameworks like PyTorch or Tensorflow in live settings.

Demonstrated experience in constructing and refining ML pipelines on a large scale — covering model training and fine-tuning all the way through inference and deployment.

Solid understanding of generative model architectures (e.g., diffusion models, transformers, GANs, VAEs) and experience adapting or training them for applied use cases.

Strong Python proficiency and software engineering fundamentals, including system build, testing, and debugging.

Experience in distributed training or inference on GPU clusters; knowledge of frameworks like Slurm or similar is an advantage.

Domain & Collaboration

Extensive knowledge of multimodal generation workflows — especially image or video generation — and the capability to quickly adopt new methods from research.

Demonstrated experience collaborating cross-functionally with research scientists, product managers, and infrastructure engineers.

Ability to communicate technical trade-offs clearly and contribute meaningfully to roadmap discussions and architectural decisions.

Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to thrive in a fast paced research and product environment.

Experience contributing to technical documentation, development proposals, or engineering standards.

Nice to Have

Experience with controllable generation, LoRA / fine-tuning workflows, or RLHF-based alignment techniques.

Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and MLOps tooling.

Prior experience working in a creative AI or media technology domain.

Contributions to open-source ML projects or peer-reviewed publications.

Education

A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience, is required.

Master's degree or PhD, or equivalent experience, preferred.

As a Senior Partner Manager at Adobe, you will take ownership of one of our most strategic Global System Integrator (GSI) partnerships, with primary responsibility for Germany and an additional overlay role across Adobe Central Europe, working closely with regional Partner Alliance Managers.

This role sits at the heart of Adobe’s growth strategy, with a clear mandate to scale partner-led pipeline, revenue, and customer impact across the Adobe Digital Experience Cloud. You will define and execute the joint strategy with a top-tier global partner, aligning Adobe’s technology, industry solutions, and go-to-market motions with the integrator’s consulting, delivery, and services capabilities across the German market, while ensuring regional consistency and leverage across Central Europe.

Operating in a complex, matrixed environment, you will engage with stakeholders ranging from alliance leaders and solution architects to senior executives and C-level decision-makers. Your success will be measured by your ability to translate strategic alignment into tangible business outcomes—accelerating partner-sourced and partner-influenced deals, driving customer adoption, and building a scalable, high-impact partnership model across the region.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will act as the primary relationship owner and trusted advisor for a global systems integrator in Germany, while collaborating with other Partner Alliance Managers to support and extend the partnership across Central Europe. You will shape joint priorities, lead executive alignment, and ensure disciplined execution across sales, marketing, and delivery teams.

You will develop and own Joint Business Plans that define shared objectives, investment areas, and success metrics, covering pipeline creation, bookings, customer adoption, and services attach. Working closely with Adobe Sales and Customer Success teams, you will ensure partner opportunities are identified early, properly registered, and executed seamlessly through to customer success.

A key part of the role is driving go-to-market impact. You will collaborate with Marketing, Product, and Partner Solution Consulting teams to design joint industry plays, solution offerings, and demand-generation initiatives. This includes sponsoring and shaping executive events, campaigns, and thought leadership activities that deliver measurable pipeline and revenue growth in Germany, while aligning with broader Central Europe priorities.

As a senior leader within Adobe’s partner ecosystem, you will bring a strong point of view on digital experience transformation, advising partners and customers on market trends and how Adobe’s full Experience Cloud portfolio can address their most critical business challenges. You will also play an important role in fostering a culture of accountability, ambition, and continuous improvement across the partnership and the wider regional partner community.

What You need to succeed

You bring extensive experience in enterprise sales and strategic partnerships, with a proven track record of delivering results through large, complex partners. You have spent several years working directly with Global System Integrators or major consulting firms, ideally with strong exposure to the German market and experience operating across multiple countries or regions.

You combine strong commercial acumen with executive presence, enabling you to influence senior leaders and drive alignment at the highest levels. You are experienced in building and scaling partner businesses, developing joint value propositions, and translating strategy into execution that delivers measurable outcomes across both local and regional contexts.

Success in this role requires excellent communication and presentation skills, a proactive and resilient mindset, and the ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments. A bachelor’s degree is required; a master’s degree or equivalent professional experience is preferred.

The Adobe Digital Imaging Data Science Team is looking for a Data Scientist passionate about data and delivering an outstanding product experience. We use extensive product usage data and work closely with product managers, marketing managers, and software engineers to derive insights and build a foundation for reliable data-driven decision-making. You will focus on initiatives like product analytics, dashboards, data engineering, GTM analytics, growth and more. Your main role is to develop and maintain a strong data architecture that enhances reporting, analytics, and experimentation. Over time, you will apply predictive modeling and machine learning to help the organization improve customer experiences. Join us and drive meaningful change in Adobe’s most exciting areas!

Responsibilities:

Partner with product and engineering teams to understand existing product instrumentation and help bridge gaps in data streams to assist data science initiatives.

Analyze product usage patterns to better understand customer behavior including acquisition, engagement, conversion, and retention.

Proactively identify user trends and communicate relevant insights to assist product decision-making.

Automate and optimize data pipelines using SQL and/or Python-based ETL Frameworks.

Build and maintain various dashboards to inform the team about the state of the business, as well as to alert business partners when issues occur.

Architect and implement models to recommend personalized in-app content.

Drive A/B and multivariate tests and build feature-level experiments to validate hypotheses and influence product development decisions.

Requirements:

MS or Ph.D. in data science, computer science, statistics, applied mathematics, engineering, or economics, or equivalent experience.

3 - 5+ years of relevant data science experience.

Experience translating business questions into data analytics approaches.

Strong proficiency in querying and manipulating large datasets using SQL-like languages (Hive, Spark, etc.).

Experience developing and operationalizing consistent approaches to experimentation, using appropriate statistical techniques to reduce bias and interpret statistical significance.

Proficiency with descriptive and inferential statistics (i.e., t-test, chi-square, ANOVA, correlation, regression, etc.) to understand customer engagement and generate hypotheses.

Experience crafting data visualizations and storytelling to efficiently communicate analysis results to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Knowledge of relevant tools in this field such as Hadoop, Hive, Splunk, Spark, Tableau, Excel (Charting and Pivot-Tables), and Power BI.

Experience in product instrumentation is a plus.

Possess natural curiosity and technical competence, being capable of asking critical questions and always ready to address any challenges.

Experience addressing an executive level audience.

Excellent communication, relationship skills, and a strong teammate.

The Acrobat Product Marketing team is seeking a strategic Director of Product Marketing, Engagement to lead our Value Discovery team with a focus on delivering meaningful impact. This leader will shape how customers discover, adopt, and build lasting habits around our most important capabilities.

They will define the strategy that connects product innovation to sustained customer value, ensuring new and existing capabilities are clearly positioned, prioritized effectively, and reinforced across the full customer lifecycle. This role owns the narrative and sequencing of key experiences so what we build is not only understood, but consistently used.

Working cross-functionally with teams such as Product, Growth, Lifecycle, GTM, and others, this leader will drive adoption, increase repeat engagement, and translate product improvements into measurable, long-term impact for the business.

What You’ll Do

Define and lead the Value Discovery strategy, shaping how customers discover, adopt, and build lasting habits around our most important capabilities.

Design and operationalize a cross-channel engagement framework that ensures new and existing capabilities are introduced, reinforced, and re-surfaced at the right moments across the customer lifecycle.

Develop engagement messaging framework for key capabilities grounded in user value and existing workflows

Build an always-on content strategy that employs trends, cultural moments, and seasonal events to promote new and existing value

Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Design, Growth, Lifecycle to align engagement strategy with roadmap priorities and business goals.

Embed audience expertise, behavioral insights and adoption data into strategic decision-making to influence product direction.

Drive measurable improvements in feature adoption, depth of usage, and multi-tool engagement.

What We’re Looking For

A strategic product marketing leader who drives behavior change—not just awareness.

A builder of scalable engagement systems, not one-off campaigns.

A strong cross-functional operator who can influence Product, Growth, Lifecycle, Design, and GTM partners and align teams around shared adoption goals.

A problem solver with a customer-first approach who translates workflows and user insights into clear, compelling value narratives.

A data-driven operator who uses adoption metrics, usage patterns, and experimentation to continuously refine strategy.

A leader who can balance long-term critical thinking alongside hands-on execution and operational excellence.

A compelling storyteller who can articulate value in a way that drives clarity, urgency, and action internally and externally.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

10+ years in Product Marketing, Engagement, Lifecycle, or a related field in a subscription-based business, with clear ownership of adoption and engagement metrics.

Proven track record of increasing feature adoption, usage depth, retention, or multi-product engagement.

Experience building cross-channel engagement strategies (in-product, email, paid, owned).

Comfort working closely with Product & Design teams, shaping roadmaps through customer insight, influencing prioritization, and embedding go-to-market thinking into product development.

Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to inform decisions and prioritize investments.

Experience building and leading high-performing teams and influencing senior partners.

Excellent communication skills with the ability to drive clarity and alignment across functions.

A passion for modernizing a legacy product with a clear vision for how AI can drive everyday utility, prove ongoing value, and unlock Acrobat’s next phase of growth.

The Opportunity

Firefly Enterprise is bringing generative AI into real creative workflows—directly inside the tools customers already use. The Extensibility team builds and evolves GenStudio plugins (e.g., for Figma and other creative hosts) that connect in-product experiences to Firefly imaging workflows (generate image/similar, generative expand, remove background, etc.) and GenStudio enterprise workflows (templating/mapping, iteration, governance handoff).The problem we’re solving: enterprise creative teams want the speed of generative AI without leaving their native tools or rebuilding complex templates elsewhere. Today, moving between tools and web apps can break pixel-perfect designs, fragment iteration history, and make it harder to enforce enterprise guardrails. GenStudio plugins solve this by enabling in-tool generation and editing, mapping content to structured fields/roles (headline/body/CTA/on-image text), and handing off outputs to GenStudio for governance and activation—all while integrating with the right APIs and enterprise constraints.This role is frontend-first with basic full-stack expectations: you’ll mainly build UI and client architecture, and you’ll also be comfortable debugging service integrations, collaborating on API contracts, and making small backend contributions when needed.

What you’ll do

Build and ship GenStudio plugins using modern JavaScript/TypeScript and a contemporary frontend framework (React/Web Components or similar).

Own user-facing workflows end-to-end: UI implementation, interaction design fidelity, state management, performance, accessibility, and reliability.

Integrate deeply with APIs (REST/GraphQL): handle auth flows, async job orchestration (polling), retries, error states, and instrumentation-friendly patterns.

Design for extensibility: implement flexible UI patterns and plugin architecture that can grow to new workflows, new hosts, and enterprise requirements.

Work closely with Product and Design: clarify requirements, surface edge cases early, and iterate quickly with high-quality execution.

Champion engineering quality: unit/integration testing where appropriate, code reviews, build/release hygiene, and pragmatic tech debt management.

Mentor and support junior engineers through reviews, pairing, and design discussions.

What you need to succeed

6–8+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong frontend focus.

Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern component-based UI development.

Proven experience integrating with APIs and building robust client-side systems around asynchronous workflows.

Strong CS fundamentals and practical software design skills.

Excellent communication skills; ability to collaborate across functions and time zones.

Nice to have

Experience building embedded/plugin UIs (Figma plugins, UXP panels, add-ins, extensions, or other constrained runtimes).

Basic backend experience (Node.js/services) and comfort working with logs/metrics and debugging cross-service issues.

Familiarity with LLMs/GenAI concepts and integrating AI capabilities into products.

Experience with build systems, CI/CD, and release processes (marketplace-style or enterprise deployments).

We are seeking a Staff Engineer - AI for Engineering to design and build the next-generation AI systems that bring intelligent, adaptive, and agentic experiences to Adobe Express.

This role is ideal for an engineer who deeply understands how modern LLMs and generative models behave in real-world systems — including reasoning patterns, tool use, prompt dynamics, failure modes, and orchestration strategies — and can translate that understanding into scalable, production-ready platforms.

You will define and build the end-to-end architecture that enables Agentic AI solutions solving real engineering problems— spanning model orchestration, tool integration, memory systems, inference services, data flows, evaluation loops, and real-time decision systems.

This is a systems-first AI role focused on building intelligent platforms.

What You’ll Do

A core part of this role is building scalable Agentic AI platforms that empower developers, significantly boost engineering productivity, and accelerate AI adoption across the organization.

Architect and evolve the AI platform powering Adobe Engineering — with a strong emphasis on Agentic AI systems and LLM-native architectures.

Design and implement scalable orchestration layers that coordinate LLMs, tools, APIs, memory stores, and multi-step reasoning workflows.

Build production-grade agent frameworks that support planning, task decomposition, tool invocation, multi-agent collaboration, and persistent memory.

Develop high-performance inference and runtime systems with strong guarantees around latency, reliability, observability, and cost efficiency.

Design evaluation and feedback systems that measure reasoning quality, task success, hallucination rates, and agent behavior — enabling rapid iteration and continuous improvement.

Integrate first-party and third-party foundation models into cohesive, adaptive systems using routing, model selection, guardrails, and fallback strategies.

Design data flows, session-level intelligence, and contextual memory systems that allow agents to operate coherently across interactions.

Partner with applied research, product, and platform teams to bring intelligent agentic capabilities into real developer-facing experiences.

Drive architectural strategy for AI for Engineering — connecting models, reasoning engines, tools, and data streams into adaptive AI systems.

Mentor senior engineers in modern AI system design, LLM orchestration patterns, and agent platform architecture.

What You’ll Bring

10+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems, AI platforms, or intelligent service architectures.

Deep understanding of how LLMs behave in production environments — including prompting strategies, reasoning chains, tool usage, grounding techniques, hallucination mitigation, guardrails, and evaluation patterns.

Strong experience building AI-powered systems using LLM orchestration frameworks, model routing strategies, and multi-model pipelines.

Hands-on experience designing agentic systems — including reasoning loops, memory persistence, tool integration, state management, and multi-agent coordination.

Proven expertise in building scalable, cloud-native, microservices-based architectures with strong observability and reliability.

Experience designing evaluation systems for generative AI quality, task completion, and behavioral robustness.

Proficiency in TypeScript, Python and at least one systems language (Java, Go, C++), with experience building production AI services.

Strong systems thinking — ability to connect model capabilities, runtime constraints, and product requirements into coherent architectures.

Excellent multi-functional communication skills, with experience influencing architectural direction across research and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience architecting AI assistants, copilots, or agent platforms in production environments.

Experience working with multimodal generative systems (text, image, video, motion).

Familiarity with tool-augmented LLM systems, RAG architectures, vector databases, and contextual memory systems.

Exposure to evaluation frameworks for generative AI quality and safety.

Experience contributing to open-source AI frameworks or publishing technical thought leadership.

As a Senior Customer Experience Orchestration Data Architect at Adobe, you will lead the development of advanced, secure data solutions for our innovative digital marketing platforms. We craft data strategy, architecture, SQL and governance for customer solutions, including end-to-end profiles, segmentation, journeys, and campaigns!

What You’ll Do

Provide deep experience to build data solutions across multiple Adobe products and cloud platforms aligned with enterprise data strategy.

Engage closely with customers and Adobe team to facilitate data discovery by evaluating systems and business processes. Analyze customer sources, data movement, data granularity, relationships, data format, etc.

Unify disparate data (e.g., sales, CRM, analytics data, etc.) to meet customers’ digital marketing use cases. Lead and develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models for multi-solution delivery.

Establish frameworks for data quality, define standards, master data management, data services, data governance, data modeling, tools, data security, privacy, and compliance with industry regulations (PII, PCI, HIPAA, GDPR, etc.).

We develop and champion data architecture guidelines via detailed documentation. These encompass architectural blueprints, ERDs, data flow diagrams, source-to-target mappings, data dictionaries, metadata catalogs, governance frameworks, guardrails, and security and compliance protocols.

We engage with cross-disciplinary groups and Adobe professionals to identify customer demands. We provide data layout and strategic blueprints, advocating for scalable, secure resolutions. Assume the role of a liaison to promptly tackle technical obstacles.

We develop strategies for growing data volumes, tools, and integrations, while aligning with customers’ objectives.

We deliver mentorship on data architecture to customers and consultants to align work with targets.

We deliver Adobe platform data lake and real-time customer profile to get ready for data ingestion and activation. Employ REST APIs, Postman, and basic scripting to automate and streamline the implementation and setup.

Develop and construct data ingestion solutions for streaming and batch processing, online and offline data within AEP. Collaborate with data engineers to develop and implement ETL/ELT pipelines for data collection and extraction.

We improve data query performance across platforms by tuning models and adhering to guidelines and ensure product guardrails are followed and deployed in solutions

Requirements

Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field or equivalent experience.

10+ years of data architecture, modeling, SQL, and working with customers!

Expert proficiency in crafting customer-centric database models, datasets (e.g., CRM, Call Center, Marketing, Offline, Point of Sale, etc.) with relational, hierarchical (e.g., RDBMS, Columnar, Data Warehouse, BI, Document, Semantic layer modeling, Data Lakes, OLTP & OLAP, etc.).

Advanced skills in SQL development (e.g., functions, data transformations, arrays, joins details, stored procedures, data analysis).

Deep experience in translating business requirements into scalable data architecture by conducting structured analysis of data workflows and processes

Demonstrate outstanding organizational skills and ability to balance customer projects concurrently with strong verbal, written communication skills and previous experience with customer-facing engagements

Special Consideration given for

Hands-on use or administration of Adobe Experience Platform (AEP)

Deep domain expertise in one or more industries (Retail, Telecom, Healthcare, Automotive, Cloud and Streaming platforms, etc.)

Experience with programming languages (e.g., Python or Bash scripting)

Adobe is seeking a visionary Director of Global Enterprise Events Narrative to redefine how we tell our AI story across global events, where strategic, high-impact conversations happen with global brands, C-suite decision makers, and industry thought leaders. This is a high-profile, strategic role that plays a critical part in advancing Adobe’s enterprise narrative and strengthening executive relationships across industries.

In this role, you will craft and steward the overarching story that connects Adobe’s innovation, vision, and technology at key events globally. You’ll collaborate closely with global and regional stakeholders to bring Adobe’s innovation and impact to life through compelling, customer-centric keynotes, breakouts, and event presence.

The ideal candidate combines strategic storytelling expertise with a strong executive presence, thrives in high-visibility environments, and brings a track record of building and scaling events with professionalism, clarity, and impact.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Define, own, and evolve the global enterprise events narrative. Define a clear, compelling overarching event narrative that elevates Adobe’s presence across all global enterprise events, ensuring consistency, clarity, and strategic alignment, while enabling flexibility for regional, industry, and audience-specific relevance.

Translate enterprise strategy into event storytelling. Partner with enterprise marketing, product marketing, sales, and executive leadership to translate Adobe’s enterprise vision, AI innovation, and customer value into powerful event moments (keynotes, sessions, panels, exec engagements, booth experiences, and more) for key customer groups

Lead keynote development and narrative strategy across the enterprise events ecosystem. Help write and shape high-impact keynote narratives and speaker briefs, ensuring narrative cohesion across the full event ecosystem (flagship events, industry trade shows, regional forums, executive roundtables, speaking opportunities to name a few), ensuring every moment ladders back to the same story.

Partner closely with regional and industry teams. Collaborate with regional marketing, industry marketing, and field teams to adapt the global narrative for local markets, balancing global consistency with cultural, industry, and audience nuance.

Scale storytelling excellence globally. Create repeatable narrative frameworks, templates, and enablement tools that empower teams worldwide to execute consistently and with high quality at scale 

Measure and refine narrative impact. Partner with analytics and marketing teams to assess narrative performance and audience engagement, using insights and feedback to continuously evolve the story.

QUALIFICATIONS

12+ years of experience in enterprise storytelling, event strategy, brand narrative, or executive communications, with a strong focus on global and large-scale events

Proven experience owning and scaling event narratives globally, including adapting a core story across regions, industries and audience types

Demonstrated expertise in writing executive keynotes and shaping key speaking moments for senior leaders

Deep familiarity with the full event ecosystem: flagship conferences, industry trade shows, executive forums, panels, speaking engagements, and more

Exceptional storytelling, writing, and presentation skills, with proven ability to simplify complex technology and business value into compelling narratives that resonate with key customer groups

Strong executive presence and comfort with working in highly visible, fast-paced, ambiguous environments

Proven experience working closely with cross-functional teams across regions and industries

Build and maintain scalable processes to support security compliance across the APAC region, ensuring alignment with global standards and unified compliance strategies.

Machine Learning Engineer

Focus: From Research to Product | Digital Video & Audio

Location: Noida / Bengaluru

The Opportunity

Adobe’s Digital Video & Audio group develops some of the most innovative and popular creative tools worldwide. These include Premiere, After Effects, and Audition, available on desktop, mobile, web, and cloud.

AI is fundamentally transforming how creators imagine, produce, and share content. We’re looking for a passionate Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about turning innovative research into intuitive, reliable product experiences used by millions of creators worldwide.

In this position, you will work closely with senior engineers, applied researchers, and diverse collaborators to turn experimental ML prototypes into scalable, production-ready systems. If you enjoy tackling complex machine learning problems in video, audio, and multimodal media — and feel driven by having your innovations incorporated into real products — this is an outstanding chance to create meaningful impact.

You will gain hands-on exposure to production-scale ML systems while directly crafting how AI powers Adobe’s creative ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

Drive the development of ML-powered features from early-stage research prototypes to robust production deployments.

Compose, build, and optimize scalable ML pipelines for video understanding, multimodal intelligence, and generative AI applications.

Implement, experiment with, and fine-tune brand new deep learning models across Computer Vision, Video AI, and Generative AI domains.

Solve real-world creator challenges involving spatial, temporal, and multimodal data.

Lead model evaluation, benchmarking, validation, and performance optimization to ensure high quality and reliability.

Optimize and deploy models across heterogeneous environments (CPU/GPU/NPU), including ONNX and CoreML workflows.

Improve model efficiency through quantization, pruning, distillation, and inference acceleration techniques.

Write clean, modular, maintainable, and well-tested production-quality ML code.

Collaborate cross-functionally with researchers, product managers, designers, and platform engineers to deliver impactful roadmap-aligned features.

Remain updated on emerging ML techniques and actively integrate innovations into video and media workflows.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

5+ years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, or related domains.

Proven experience building, scaling, and deploying ML models in production environments with measurable impact.

Strong proficiency in PyTorch (preferred) or TensorFlow, and Python-based ML development.

Solid foundations in mathematical modeling, including Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, and optimization theory.

Deep understanding of core ML principles: model training, validation, generalization, and performance trade-offs.

Strong grasp of deep learning architectures including CNNs, RNNs, Transformers, and multimodal models. Clear understanding of when and why to apply each architecture for spatial, temporal, or cross-modal tasks.

Practical experience in computer vision tasks such as object detection, segmentation, tracking, video understanding, or temporal modeling.

Familiarity with model optimization and deployment techniques including pre/post training quantization, ONNX, CoreML, and edge deployment.

Understanding of software engineering guidelines including version control (Git), testing frameworks, CI/CD, and code review processes.

Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving ability, and curiosity to learn in a fast-evolving AI landscape.

Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within diverse, high-performing teams.

Why You’ll Love This Role

Develop AI systems that support millions of creators around the world.

See your ideas move from research to real-world impact.

Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers.

Address significant, large-scale ML challenges in video and media.

Grow in an environment that values innovation, ownership, and continuous learning.

Contributions to open source projects
