Foster and maintain executive trust in architectural direction, serving as a strategic advisor to senior business and technology collaborators.

Collaborate with licensing and services sales teams to improve major sales initiatives.

Coordinate architectural efforts among delivery teams, subject matter experts, and partners to ensure build integrity and alignment during execution.

Establish and lead architecture governance and assurance forums.

Partner closely with pre‑sales teams to ensure lessons learned, build patterns, and reference architectures continually improve future pursuits and delivery outcomes.

Proven experience providing enterprise architecture leadership across large-scale transformation programmes, from early visioning and pre-sales through delivery, adoption, and platform evolution.

Strong grounding in TOGAF principles and lifecycle-based architecture governance, applied pragmatically in complex enterprise environments.

Broad understanding of digital marketing, data, and activation ecosystems.

The ability to craft compelling narratives that translate architectural choices into business-relevant results and messages suitable for executives.

Experience operating as a trusted architectural advisor to senior executives.

Strong understanding of AI, automation, and emerging agentic models, and their implications for enterprise platforms.

Experience working closely with delivery teams, partners, and vendors to maintain build integrity.

Ability to apply structured change and adoption approaches (including ADKAR) to support the human and organisational aspects of architectural evolution.

A collaborative, outcome-focused leadership style, with a relentless focus on value and adoption.

We are seeking a Principal Designer to define the future of human–AI collaboration across Adobe’s ecosystem. This role focuses on agentic systems operating across complex creative and enterprise workflows. You will shape the interaction paradigms that govern delegation, control, evaluation, and trust.

This is a systems design role focused on AI behavior, orchestration, and adaptive interfaces. We are looking for a designer who works directly with models, prototypes in code, and treats AI systems as a design material.

What you’ll do

This role demands a systems thinker operating across strategy and implementation. You will define interaction paradigms, prototype AI behaviors, and align research, engineering, and design around a coherent vision.

Define New Interaction Paradigms for Agentic Systems

Establish mental models for delegation, collaboration, and control between humans and AI agents.

Design interaction frameworks for multi-step workflows and tool-using systems.

Define how users inspect reasoning, guide autonomous behavior, and balance prompt-based and structured interaction.

Design for Trust, Transparency & Evaluation

Create mechanisms that make AI reasoning legible, including confidence indicators, provenance, and evaluation UX.

Design failure recovery and escalation models.

Contribute to guardrails that balance capability with safety.

Prototype AI-Native Experiences

Work directly with large language models and agent frameworks.

Write and refine prompts, skills, system instructions, and behavioral constraints to shape system behavior.

Prototype using code, scripting, or AI tooling.

Rapidly iterate through build → test → refine cycles in close partnership with research and engineering.

Shape Context-Aware & Brand-Aware Systems

Design systems that understand creative context, enterprise constraints, memory, and personalization.

Contribute to the evolution of AI-native components within Adobe’s design system.

Drive Strategic & Org-Level Impact

Influence senior leadership through compelling system visions and working prototypes.

Align cross-functional teams around AI interaction strategy.

Mentor designers working in emerging AI spaces and elevate the craft of behavior design across the organization.

What you'll bring

We are redefining what it means to be a designer at the Principal level in the age of AI.

Core Experience

10+ years of experience in product, systems, or interaction design.

Demonstrated experience defining and shipping AI-native or agent-based systems.

Experience designing for creative tools or deep familiarity with creative workflows and processes.

Deep systems thinking with experience designing platforms or complex workflows.

Hands-on experience working with large language models and designing adaptive or generative interfaces, including dynamic UI, tool selection, and orchestration layers.

Comfort prototyping in code and contributing production-quality implementations alongside engineering teams.

Experience driving cross-functional alignment on ambiguous, emerging technology initiatives.

Additional Depth

Experience designing enterprise AI workflows.

Familiarity with multi-agent orchestration patterns.

Experience integrating first- and third-party AI systems.

Background in automation design, developer tooling, or platform ecosystems.

Accessibility expertise in AI-driven interfaces.

Preferred Accessibility Design Skills:

Experience designing accessible and inclusive interfaces for people with disabilities.

Understanding of applying WCAG conformance criteria in design, specifically testing comps, wireframes, and prototypes for accessibility standards.

Accessibility certifications CPACC, WAS, CPWA, or ADS from the IAAP preferred.

You think in behaviors, systems, and capabilities, not just screens, flows, and features.

You treat AI systems as a design material. You’ve built AI workflows or agent prototypes and understand how model behavior shifts under constraint, how tools are invoked, and how memory and guardrails shape outcomes.

You are energized by ambiguity. Designing agentic systems means working with emergent behavior and evolving systems. Rather than waiting for clarity, you create it through prototypes and collaboration with research and engineering.

You are opinionated about the future of AI-native workflows and excited to help shape new ways of working. Most importantly, you believe AI should expand human creativity and capability. You design systems that empower people, not replace them.

How to apply

To be considered for this role, please submit your resume and portfolio. We’re especially interested in systems you’ve defined, AI workflows you’ve built, and evidence of working directly with intelligent systems.

As a Firefly Product Specialist at Adobe, you will support and sell Adobe Firefly Enterprise Solutions across Enterprise accounts. This role will partner with Account Directors (ADs) to help grow the existing business through identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities. This role requires solution selling capabilities, experience selling value to customers, strong business and selling instincts, and direct, in-person consultation with customers. The Firefly Product Specialist is responsible for guiding and navigating through an enterprise organization to ensure a successful sales cycle, start to finish. As Product Specialist, you will play a crucial role in pushing the boundaries of digital creativity and empowering artists and designers to build awe-inspiring content.

Responsibilities:

Sales Field Alignment – Work with Adobe Sales Team across the Digital Media (DMe) and Digital Experience (DX) to support Multi-Product Enterprise Solutions, Strategic Firefly-only Solutions or as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for general Firefly sales engagements. Be the Firefly and GenAI expert for your area, improving scale and sales efficiency in creative GenAI projects.

Account Planning – Develop targeted account strategies and tactical penetration plans.

Relationship Management – Develop and maintain relationships at the “C-Suite” and “VP” levels within targeted accounts. Relationships will be with both IT and Business segments of the enterprise.

Build & Develop Pipeline – Identify cross-sell opportunities through targeted whitespace analysis, partner with pre-sales to drive maturity and sales stage progression in preparation for in-quarter execution.

Deliver Product Presentations – Understand customer needs and solution fit by delivering effective product demonstrations, use cases, positioning differentiated value/vision, and sales pitches. Develop Arguments – Develop strong Creative GenAI arguments that emphasize compelling differentiated value proposition, thought leadership, and return on investment cost/benefit analysis.

Coordinate Resource Expertise – Own coordination of pre-sales, product and commercial expertise in the sales cycle while project managing key deliverables to an established timeline.

Close Sales – Build proposals, negotiate contract pricing & contractual agreement to close sale.

Minimum 7+ years proven track record of enterprise-level, technical solution direct sales expertise within a more sophisticated sales model is required. 10+ years of experience highly preferred.

Proven experience consulting and selling digital transformation and enterprise solutions to “C-Suite” executives and overachieving on quotas is required.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, capable of working effectively in cross-functional teams and explaining technical concepts to non-technical collaborators.

Experience working with Adobe Creative Cloud products (i.e., Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and After Effects) or Adobe Experience Cloud products (i.e., AEM, AEP) is a plus.

Knowledge of generative AI technologies, including deep learning, neural networks, and generative models would be great!

Proficient in creative workflows and the design process, capable of seeing opportunities for integrating generative AI techniques.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to develop innovative solutions to complex challenges.

Ability to travel upwards of 50%.

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.

If you are passionate about the intersection of AI and creativity, and you thrive in a dynamic and innovative environment, we encourage you to apply. Join our team and help **craft** the future of digital creativity with Adobe's generative AI capabilities.

The Opportunity

Join a team that works across Sales and GTM, to operationalize promotional and pricing initiatives, globally, across all offerings, for all of Adobe’s routes-to-markets. Lead a versatile team to develop, improve and maintain Promotional and Pricing programs supporting Adobe and its RTM/GTM teams. Support the team in addressing technical issues with promo offer creation, and delivery workflows, through outstanding mentorship. Guide the team to enhance processes and infrastructure.

What you’ll do:

Manage an independent team supporting Adobe Sales and Marketing delivering promotional and pricing initiatives across different routes-to-market and offerings. This includes Adobe.com, ICX/Phones, Channel and Corporate.

Partner with the Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product teams, Engineering, Fraud and Legal, to understand the promo and pricing delivery requirements.

Own the end-to-end intake and governance pathway for promotions (from request intake through approvals), ensuring requests are complete, compliant, and ready for execution

Run the cross RTM promo planning cadence (Promo Pod): consolidate promo asks, drive alignment, and operationalize outcomes into an executable promo plan and schedule.

Partner with Analytics to enable evidence-based challenge/adjudication of promo proposals (e.g., cannibalization / switching insights).

Guide Sales/GTM requester teams on requirements, documentation, and approval routing for the PAR (Pricing Action Request) process to reduce rework and prevent last‑minute issues.

Ensure end-to-end operational readiness for promos across surfaces (e.g., Adobe.com + other routes-to-market), including workflow testing and dependency management.

Coordinate all aspects of the key promotional initiatives globally to consistently achieve results in an ambiguous and changing environment. This includes large scale initiatives such as Black Friday/Cyber Monday, Back to School, etc.

Be a major player in process improvement and a motivator for building mature processes. Build and maintain a central repository for planning and execution documentation including Confluence/Wiki, SharePoint, etc.

Lead standardization and reusability efforts (templates, briefs, documented SOPs) to reduce cycle time and improve global consistency.

Sponsor/drive automation initiatives (RPA/AI/API-first where applicable), translating operational problems into clear requirements and measurable benefits.

Manage demand and prioritization across promo asks, balancing speed, risk, and value; establish visibility through simple dashboards/operational metrics.

What you need to succeed:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Outstanding collaboration skills and ability to work across various business units and job levels to complete on a project with tight deadlines.

Project / Program Management experience

Strong program management rigor (plans, achievements, alignment) to deliver complex initiatives consistently.

Strong understanding of various business process improvement methodologies. An appreciate of how Automation / RPA / AI can be used to improve processes, and where ‘keeping humans-in-the-loop’ is required

Demonstrated controls approach (risk, audit readiness, governance), with ability to run structured approval workflows and ensure compliance requirements are met.

Change Management: a strong Change Manager with tenacity to follow through till closure.

Leadership: outstanding leadership and communications skills required to manage multiple teams, routes-to-market and programs simultaneously.

Experience leading globally distributed teams and partners; strong global/cultural awareness.

Technical expertise: Knowledge of Adobe systems and platforms required to operationalize promotional workflows and customer journeys for the individual and B2B businesses, across both direct and indirect routes-to-market, an advantage.

The Challenge

The Senior Project Manager leads client-focused initiatives to implement Adobe Marketing Cloud solutions. Collaborating at multiple levels with the Adobe Global Services and Field Sales teams and various key customers and partners, this strategic role leads every phase of project planning. This covers defining the project scope, planning, monitoring timelines, and prioritizing resources. The position partners closely with the Adobe Delivery team to coordinate the technical implementation. The Senior Project Manager directly impacts revenue from Adobe customers and will collaborate as required to maintain a positive customer experience. This role requires strong multi-tasking ability, proactive and efficient communication, and the skill to bring up critical issues while providing solutions to customers.

This role is preferred to be filled from an Adobe office. Desired locations include San Jose, San Francisco, and New York. There is some flexibility to also consider Chicago, Austin, Seattle, or McLean, VA.

What You'll Do

Work with customer(s) and Adobe Field and Services Sales teams to clearly define project scope, requirements, and integration points. Document these details as they relate to solution implementation.

Coordinate project delivery process with key contributors to help manage scope and prepare change requests - including tasks, deliverables, achievements, resources, and estimated costs. Act as primary point of contact for the client(s) throughout the project lifecycle.

Achieve customer happiness through successful delivery of defined project scope. Coordinate and communicate critical issues across Adobe – including Field Sales, the Services Customer Engagement, and Product teams.

Manage administrative portions of project delivery from inception to closure.

Collaborate with third-party subcontractors, vendors and technology partners as needed.

Capture and communicate experiences in formal retrospectives - relaying guidelines, customer experience, and resource feedback to the larger Adobe Services Customer Engagement practice.

Coordinate critical issues across Adobe including sales, custom services, and product organizations.

Accurately forecast revenue, profitability, margins, bill rates and utilization across projects.

Identifies partnership opportunities and capitalizes on “add-on” sales opportunities across projects.

What You Need to Succeed

Minimum 8 – 10 years of previous experience in a client-facing project management position, preferably within the Digital Marketing Cloud domain. This encompasses familiarity with Web Content Management, Rich internet applications, Web & Social Analytics, online Ad Targeting, and content Personalization solutions.

8 – 10 years of demonstrated achievement in a software-focused PM position is strongly preferred. Previous experience as a project manager in a SaaS setting is required.

Proven ability to understand the impact of technical changes and to articulate high level technical solutions to address business problems.

Excellent problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to identify issues, resolve them quickly and know when to rely on internal resources to assist.

An innovative thinker, collaborative business partner, who is well-organized and detailed with strong presentation and reporting skills is required.

Professional demeanor, ability to interact with and lead diverse teams throughout Adobe, and communicating with client managers, directors, and VPs including CMOs and CXOs.

Strong verbal, presentation and written communication skills as well as strong conflict resolution and negotiation skills.

Deep understanding of custom software development processes and engagement strategies. Hands-on experience managing agile development projects is beneficial.

Ability to manage in an environment of ambiguity with diverse collaborators.

Ability to build positive relationships and generate opportunities for repeat business.

Willingness to travel up to 60%.

BS/BA degree required and MS/MBA or equivalent experience is a plus.

Highly Desired

Experience as Consulting Manager in a large consulting organization or Agency.

Experience coordinating Agile development projects.

Previous experience with Adobe Digital Marketing Solutions.

Previous experience with Financial Force.

Proven experience managing off-shore teams.

PMP certification and Certified ScrumMaster is preferred.

Adobe is seeking a Software Development Engineer to join our innovative team in Lehi. This outstanding opportunity gives you the chance to collaborate with world-class professionals, using the latest technology to achieve outstanding digital experiences.

Great teammate who thrives under pressure.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly experienced and innovative Staff Software Engineer to join the GenStudio Engineering team. This role is ideal for a technical leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about building scalable, high-impact software solutions. You will drive architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and influence the technical direction of GenStudio.

What You’ll Do

Design, build, test, and maintain AI/ML-based systems and applications that serve as the backbone of scalable, production-ready technology stacks.

Frame product features as ML tasks (e.g., classification, recommendation, context engineering).

Analyze trade-offs across cost, latency, and accuracy while ensuring compliance with UX, privacy, legal, and security constraints.

Assess data distribution (variance, sampling, drift) and manage data labeling workflows involving LLMs, SMEs, or user-generated activity.

Organize datasets for training, validation, and testing, and engineer high-quality features using normalization, smoothing, and weighting techniques.

Implement and adapt techniques from academic research and industry papers; evaluate algorithmic trade-offs considering data requirements, latency, and runtime.

Handle cold-start scenarios and mitigate overfitting/underfitting challenges.

Define offline benchmarks and metrics; design and analyze A/B tests to validate online performance.

Architect scalable ML systems (e.g., multi-agent, recommender, active learning, multi-stage model training, enterprise search) for both offline and online workflows.

Optimize model development and deployment in GPU/TPU environments using PyTorch.

Work cross-functionally with data, research, and product teams to translate models into production-ready services.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

10+ years of experience in software engineering, with a strong track record of technical leadership.

Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Deep understanding of front and back-end development technologies, including JavaScript library like React, Java and NodeJS

Proficiency in Python (especially for data workflows) and experience with ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, CUDA, Hugging Face, and JAX.

Proven expertise in Machine Learning and Deep Learning, including model design, optimization, and fine-tuning.

Strong understanding of transfer learning principles and their application in production settings.

Experience designing and deploying scalable AI/ML systems optimized for GPU/TPU environments.

Solid grasp of data engineering concepts—including dataset management, feature engineering, and handling data drift.

Ability to balance theoretical ML knowledge with practical, high-performance implementation.

Strong understanding of how to transform models into reliable, production-grade services.

Preferred Attributes

Recognized as a leader with vision within and beyond the organization.

Experience mentoring senior engineers and shaping engineering culture.

Demonstrated ability to drive innovation and evangelize new technologies.

Experience with building GenAI-first applications.

Contributions to industry forums, conferences, or open-source communities.

Adobe Real-Time Customer Data Platform (RTCDP) enables enterprises to unify customer data and activate it in real time across digital experiences.
The RTCDP Collaboration team builds the systems that allow organizations to securely share and activate data across companies while maintaining strong privacy, governance, and performance standards.
The team builds services responsible for secure data sharing, real-time data processing, and orchestration across enterprise data platforms.
As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will design and build the distributed services that power this capability — including Java-based backend systems, event-driven pipelines, and cloud-native platform services.

What You’ll Work On

Design and build Java-based backend services and microservices

Develop event-driven systems and data pipelines using technologies such as Kafka

Build and evolve workflow orchestration services coordinating cross-system processes

Design reliable APIs and backend services used by multiple Adobe products

Contribute to architecture and system design decisions

Improve system reliability, observability, and performance

Own services through the full lifecycle — from design and implementation to production operations

Collaborate with engineers and product teams across multiple regions

Technology Stack
Examples of technologies used across the platform include:

Java / JVM ecosystem

Kafka and event-driven architectures

Snowflake and modern cloud data platforms

Workflow orchestration 

Kubernetes and containerized services

Cloud infrastructure (AWS and Azure)

Observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Splunk

What We’re Looking For

9+ years of backend engineering experience

Strong expertise in Java and microservices architectures

Experience designing and operating distributed systems

Experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar technologies)

Experience building data processing pipelines

Experience working with cloud-native environments

Strong understanding of system design, reliability, and performance

Nice to Have

Experience with Snowflake or modern cloud data warehouses

Experience with workflow orchestration systems (Temporal or similar)

Background in distributed data platforms

Experience contributing to architecture decisions or mentoring engineers

Demonstrated impact in mentoring senior engineers and influencing architectural direction.

Practical experience using AI tools and agentic workflows to enhance engineering productivity.

Why Engineers Join This Team

Work on core platform services within Adobe Experience Platform

Build systems enabling secure enterprise data collaboration

Solve distributed systems and data platform challenges

Collaborate with experienced engineers across Adobe’s global engineering teams

This role is for engineers who want to understand not only how systems work — but why they matter.

In RTCDP Collaboration, you won’t just move data.

You will help enterprises connect, collaborate, and unlock value from their data in ways that directly impact their business success.

The Opportunity 

The Adobe Document Cloud organization is looking for a talented and highly motivated Software Engineer to help build and deliver our next-generation Adobe Acrobat Sign service.

Adobe Acrobat Sign is the fastest, easiest way to get contracts signed, tracked, and filed. Unlike virtual fax or e-signature software, Adobe Acrobat Sign offers an end-to-end solution by automating the entire contracting process from the request for signature to the distribution and filing of the executed agreement.

Adobe Acrobat Sign revolutionizes the way the world signs documents. We are looking for an engineer with a real passion for innovation and learning to join the Adobe Acrobat Sign team.

We are a dynamic software development team passionate about producing scalable and high-quality enterprise solutions.

You will be working on different technology stacks for front-end and back-end solutions of Adobe Acrobat Sign. You will have a rare opportunity to learn and grow integrating a team of experienced engineers.

What you'll do

Work hand-in-hand with, engineers, user experience designers and product managers to prototype and build a next-generation web application

Provide technical leadership to solve ambitious design problems to deliver best-in-class user experience

Design, deploy, and support secure, efficient, containerized software for Adobe Acrobat Sign

Design & develop key user-facing features, collaborating with the product and the design teams to work on the most optimized and delightful user experience.

Work with other Adobe teams to explore diverse technologies and embrace cross-team standards

What you need to succeed

B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science or equivalent

0-3 years of professional experience developing interactive web applications

Ability to work independently and strong communication skills within and across teams

Ability and willingness to learn new technologies quickly with a strong interest in full track development.

High proficiency in developing software solutions using web application client-tier technologies, including HTML and typescript/JavaScript, ReactJS,/Web components and React Native

Strong knowledge of server-side Java/J2EE technologies, including Spring, NodeJS, Hibernate, JSP, JNDI, JDBC, JMS, Servlets, and XML

Ability to perform independently in a hybrid work environment supported by competent written and verbal communication skills

Experience with microservices infrastructure (e.g. Docker, Container Orchestration [ideally Kubernetes]), Amazon Web Services (AWS) and/or Microsoft Azure

Role Overview

We are looking for a Quality Engineering Lead to drive quality strategy and execution for a Adobe Express Photos(Windows based photo viewing/editing and screen capture app). The individual will own the end-to-end quality architecture for a complex, multi-process system with deep OS integrations. The candidate will combine strong engineering rigor, automation-first thinking, and experience leveraging modern AI/agentic frameworks to build scalable quality systems that keep pace with accelerated development cycles.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Strategy & Ownership

Define and drive the quality strategy for a large Windows desktop application with complex architecture, multi-process interactions, and deep OS-level integrations.

Establish measurable quality benchmarks across reliability, performance, memory, crash stability, and release readiness.

Lead quality initiatives for complex Windows platform scenarios including multi-process orchestration, IPC communication, system resource management, and OS integration behaviors.

Ensure stability across diverse hardware environments, graphics stacks, and Windows configurations.

Partner closely with engineering and product teams to ensure quality is built into the development lifecycle rather than validated post-development.

Automation & CI/CD Excellence

Architect and scale an automation-first testing strategy covering unit, integration, UI, performance, and system-level testing.

Build and maintain robust automation pipelines integrated with CI/CD systems to enable reliable regression detection and faster release cycles.

Improve signal quality from test infrastructure by reducing flakiness, improving test reliability, and enforcing strong quality gates.

AI-Driven Quality Engineering

Design and implement agentic AI frameworks that automate aspects of testing, defect detection, regression analysis, and release validation.

Build well-orchestrated AI agents capable of running automated validation workflows while maintaining high standards for reliability, explainability, and reproducibility.

Define governance and validation frameworks to ensure AI-assisted quality workflows remain deterministic and trustworthy.

Operational Excellence

Establish strong quality dashboards and metrics to monitor system health across builds and releases.

Drive continuous improvement in test coverage, build stability, and production quality signals.

Mentor engineers and cultivate a culture of engineering excellence around automation and quality ownership.

Required Qualifications

9+ years of experience in software quality engineering, with demonstrated experience leading quality initiatives for large-scale desktop or system-level applications.

Strong experience testing complex Windows applications involving multi-process architectures, IPC, graphics pipelines, and OS-level integrations.

Proven track record of designing and implementing scalable automation frameworks integrated with modern CI/CD systems.

Deep understanding of reliability engineering principles, performance testing, and regression prevention strategies.

Hands-on experience building or integrating AI/agentic automation frameworks to improve development or testing workflows.

Strong programming skills (e.g., C++, C#, Python, or similar) with the ability to contribute directly to automation infrastructure.

Experience working with large codebases and collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams.

The opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Staff Designer to lead the design and delivery of intelligent agentic systems across complex creative and enterprise workflows. This role focuses on building and shipping AI-native capabilities that enable users to delegate, steer, and evaluate intelligent systems with confidence.

This is a systems design role focused on AI behavior, orchestration, and adaptive interfaces. We are looking for a designer who works directly with models, prototypes in code, and treats AI systems as a design material.

What you’ll do

You will lead major initiatives within our agentic systems work, translating emerging AI capabilities into production-ready interaction patterns and driving a coherent vision across research, engineering, and product.

Design and Ship Agentic Interaction Systems

Establish mental models for delegation, collaboration, and control between humans and AI agents.

Design interaction frameworks for multi-step workflows and tool-using skills.

Design mechanisms that make reasoning legible, including confidence indicators, provenance, and evaluation UX.

Build patterns that balance prompt-based and structured interaction.

Prototype and Deliver AI-Native Capabilities

Work directly with large language models and agent frameworks.

Write and refine prompts, skills, system instructions, and behavioral constraints.

Prototype in code and contribute to production implementations alongside engineering.

Rapidly iterate through build → test → refine cycles in close partnership with research and engineering.

Adapt AI Systems to Creative Contexts

Design systems that understand creative workflows, enterprise constraints, memory, and personalization.

Ensure agent behaviors align with real creative processes and tooling needs.

Contribute to the evolution of AI-native components within Adobe’s design system.

Drive Cross-Functional Execution

Partner closely with engineering, research, and product to deliver production systems.

Influence stakeholders through working prototypes and clear system articulation.

Contribute to shared best practices for AI interaction and behavior design.

What you'll bring

We are redefining what it means to be a designer in the age of AI.

Core Experience

8+ years of experience in product, systems, or interaction design.

Demonstrated experience designing and shipping AI-assisted or agent-based systems.

Experience designing for creative tools or deep familiarity with creative workflows.

Hands-on experience working with large language models and designing adaptive or generative interfaces.

Comfort prototyping in code and contributing production-quality implementations alongside engineering teams.

Strong systems thinking and experience working within complex, cross-functional environments.

Additional Depth

Experience designing enterprise AI workflows.

Familiarity with multi-agent orchestration patterns.

Experience integrating first- and third-party AI systems.

Background in automation design, developer tooling, or platform ecosystems.

Accessibility expertise in AI-driven interfaces.

Preferred Accessibility Design Skills:

Experience designing accessible and inclusive interfaces for people with disabilities.

Understanding of applying WCAG conformance criteria in design, specifically testing comps, wireframes, and prototypes for accessibility standards.

Accessibility certifications CPACC, WAS, CPWA, or ADS from the IAAP preferred.

You think in behaviors, systems, and capabilities, not just screens, flows, and features.

You treat AI systems as a design material and have built workflows or prototypes that explore model behavior under real constraints.

You are energized by ambiguity and motivated to shape how AI becomes a practical, trusted collaborator in creative work.

Most importantly, you believe AI should expand human creativity and capability, not replace it.

How to apply

To be considered for this role, please submit your resume and portfolio. We’re especially interested in systems you’ve defined, AI workflows you’ve built, and evidence of working directly with intelligent systems.

Job Title: Principal Value Consultant

Job Summary

We are seeking a strategic Value Consultant dedicated to advancing the development of our Value Consulting organization at Adobe. This role emphasizes building compelling arguments to demonstrate the value of Adobe Firefly Services and solutions to prospective clients while driving sales and customer adoption. The ideal candidate will possess a solid grasp of software sales processes, value-based selling, and have experience translating technical features into business benefits. They will also have a solid understanding of go-to-market and business skills to help customers understand how to use Adobe software to drive business outcomes and present to influencers as well as executive decision makers.

Key Responsibilities

Develop Business Cases: Work with sales teams, including Account Executives, Solution Consultants, and Solution Architects. Build detailed arguments to demonstrate the return on investment and value of our software solutions. 

Design Value Frameworks: Refine frameworks for value consulting that can be consistently applied across different products and client scenarios.

Client Engagement: Work directly with clients to understand their needs and challenges, in order to articulate how Adobe solutions can create measurable value for their business.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product management, marketing, and leadership to ensure alignment on value messaging and capability. Gather insights that inform argument development.

Training and Enablement: Create and deliver training sessions for sales teams to enhance their understanding of Value Consulting methodologies and to equip them with tools for effective client engagement.

Metrics and Reporting: Help develop and support objective and key results to measure the effectiveness of value consulting initiatives and provide data for regular reports to senior management on progress and outcomes.

Market Research: Stay updated on industry trends, competitive landscape, and customer needs to continuously refine value propositions and argument strategies.

What you need to succeed:

Masters in Business Administration (MBA), Marketing, or a related experience.

5+ years of experience in a consulting, sales, or product management role within the software industry.

Strong understanding of case development and value-based selling principles.

Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information in a clear and compelling manner.

Proven track record of collaborating with cross-functional teams and getting results in a fast-paced environment.

Analytical approach with the ability to interpret data and insights to inform strategic decisions.

Familiarity with financial modeling and analysis.

Experience in customer engagement and relationship management.

Knowledge of software solutions and technology trends relevant to our industry.

Join our team at Adobe, where creativity and innovation blend with collaboration, and legal minds lead the way in shaping the future. Seeking an Associate Legal Counsel who is sharp, savvy, and prepared to excel in our dynamic team.

We are looking for a recently qualified or early-career lawyer (0–2 years PQE) admitted to the Bar Association, eager to build their in-house career and make a meaningful contribution to our operations within the Central (Eastern Europe) and Iberia (Spain and Portugal) regions. You will be supported and mentored by the Managing Counsel and the wider legal team as you develop your in-house expertise.

Why Join Us?

A Legal Team Like No Other: Supportive, encouraging, and—above all—friendly. We lift each other up, share knowledge freely, and always find time to celebrate wins (big or small).

Diversity & Inclusion: We champion every voice, celebrate every background, and believe that brilliant ideas come from everywhere.

Work/Life Balance: We know life is more than work. Flexible schedules and hybrid options are here to keep you energized.

Competitive Salary & Benefits: A comprehensive compensation package intended to support and reward employees.

Growth & Opportunity: Adobe is rapidly growing, and so can you. Structured mentoring and a clear development path are built into this role. Get involved in crafting new systems (think: AI chatbots, CLM, knowledge sharing, automation) and work processes.

The challenge 

Build your in-house legal career by supporting our dynamic sales team and working alongside colleagues in marketing, finance, procurement, and beyond. Under the guidance of our Managing Counsel, you will develop into a trusted legal partner for the Central and Iberia Regions.

What You’ll Do

Draft, Review & Negotiate: Work and negotiate on a variety of agreements—license, professional services, consulting, statements of work, resale, distribution, sales, and licensing. You’ll keep us covered and keep deals moving.

Commercial Legal Support: Partner with our business units, providing timely, commercial advice and delivering in-house training on the legal topics that matter most. Help demystify law for your colleagues!

Compliance Monitor: Monitor and flag relevant regulatory and legal developments — particularly in technology, AI, intellectual property, and data privacy — and support senior counsel in analysing their impact on Adobe.

Drive Process Improvement: Dive into knowledge management and help evolve our legal processes. Lead departmental projects that make us better, smarter, and faster.

Embrace Legal Technology: Use AI-assisted tools for contract analysis, research, and document drafting as part of your day-to-day workflow. Develop hands-on fluency in the technologies that are reshaping how legal services are delivered — no prior experience required, just a genuine curiosity about what’s coming next.

Project Legal Support: Join working groups as new projects and business practices are developed, bringing your legal and business perspective where it’s needed most.

Ongoing Training & Risk Management: Carry out internal training sessions, and offer continuous support on key risks—building a culture of compliance and confidence.

What you need to succeed

Qualified Lawyer: Admitted to the Bar Association with 0–2 years PQE. In-house or law firm experience is welcome; we are equally open to recently qualified candidates who are the right fit.

Commercial/IT/IP Interest: You have foundational knowledge or a strong interest in commercial, technology, or IP law — gained through studies, internships, or early practice. You have an appetite to deepen your understanding of the complexities of software, technology, and data protection in a fast-moving tech company.

Business and Risk Savvy: You see the bigger picture and understand how legal matters fit into business objectives, assess, and manage risks across multiple matters at once.

Communication Skills: You have strong drafting ability and good attention to detail, and you can translate complex legalese into everyday plain language.

Languages: Proficient in English and Romanian (required). Spanish or Portuguese is a genuine advantage given the Iberia scope of the role.

Flexible & Adaptable: You’re quick on your feet, ready to adjust when the business demands change.

What Makes This Role Fun & Cool?

Build the Future: Play a key role in Adobe’s evolution, especially in this fast-paced tech and AI culture.

Tech Meets Law: Dive into brand new systems and technology incorporating AI, CLM, and automation—assist us in scaling smarter!

Room to Grow: Take on new challenges, lead projects, collaborate with a distributed team, and develop your own expertise as Adobe expands.

Fun Perks: Celebrations, creativity challenges, and team-building events—plus some of the best colleagues in the business.

Solid system build and debugging skills; comfortable with ambiguity.

CI/CD experience and infrastructure knowledge (Docker/Kubernetes preferred).

Strong communication skills and ability to work together across various functions.

Exposure to GenAI/LLM evaluation techniques, timely testing, or RAG validation.

Experience with Langfuse, LangSmith, or AWS Bedrock evaluations.

Observability/telemetry and experiment analytics experience.

Prior work on internal developer platforms or tooling.

About the Role

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe's all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We are seeking a motivated Engineering Manager to lead our engineering team in building and scaling an internal advanced benchmark and analytics platform. This high-impact platform delivers real-time insights, customizable dashboards, interactive visualizations, and robust reporting—empowering data-driven decisions and unlocking new levels of innovation across the organization.

This role involves direct management and growth of a cross-functional engineering team. The current team comprises Frontend UI/UX Engineers using Vue.js and Backend Engineers with Node.js and Fastify, utilizing ClickHouse, Redis, and Azure Container Apps. You will balance hands-on technical support with leading the team and overseeing delivery. You will collaborate closely with product, design, data, and business team members. It is a great chance for a strong full-stack engineer ready to transition into management. You will gain support and mentorship while building key leadership skills and advancing the platform into a stable, high-performance base for Adobe's internal users.

The ideal candidate has solid full-stack expertise (frontend + backend) and experience with data-intensive applications. They are eager to grow into people management and employ modern AI coding tools to increase team productivity.

Key Responsibilities

Lead, mentor, and support a high-performing engineering team. Participate in hiring, onboarding, performance discussions, and career growth conversations. Build a collaborative, inclusive team culture with guidance from senior leadership.

Guide technical architecture and design decisions for the platform tracking critical metrics. Stay hands-on when necessary with frontend (Vue.js), backend (Node.js + Fastify), data layer (ClickHouse, Redis), and deployment (Azure Container Apps).

Partner with product managers to define and complete the engineering roadmap. Prioritize features, address technical debt, improve performance and scalability, and enhance reliability to deliver business value.

Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, design sessions, and technical planning to uphold high standards of code quality, maintainability, security, and performance.

Champion guidelines in software development, including testing, CI/CD, observability, and secure cloud deployments (e.g., VNet integration in Azure).

Support and exemplify efficient use of AI-based coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude/Claude Code) to hasten development, refactoring, and innovation—while reviewing outputs carefully.

Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners (product, UX/design, data analysts, DevOps, business collaborators) to turn requirements into engineering plans, remove blockers, and deliver iteratively.

Track team velocity, quality metrics, and system health; facilitate retrospectives and drive continuous improvement with support from leadership.

Handle sprint/quarter planning, resource coordination, risk identification, and delivery commitments for platform work.

Remain informed about progress in Vue.js, Node.js/Fastify, analytics databases (ClickHouse), caching (Redis), container platforms (Azure Container Apps), AI-assisted development, and data trends to support team decisions.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong hands-on work in frontend and backend technologies (e.g., Vue.js or similar modern JS frameworks + Node.js/TypeScript).

Prior technical leadership experience (e.g., tech lead, project lead, mentoring juniors, or owning major features/systems), with readiness and enthusiasm to transition into direct people management.

Experience contributing to full-stack delivery in production, ideally with data-heavy or analytics applications (e.g., dashboards, important metrics, observability tools). Familiarity with high-performance APIs, analytical databases (e.g., ClickHouse or similar OLAP), caching (e.g., Redis), and container platforms (e.g., Azure Container Apps or Kubernetes concepts) is a plus.

Practical experience working with AI-driven coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude/Claude Code) in everyday tasks, and enthusiasm for supporting the group in integrating them efficiently.

Solid understanding of contemporary software approaches: agile methods, CI/CD, testing (unit/integration/E2E), observability, and secure cloud deployments (Azure preferred).

Strong communication and collaboration abilities; capable of working alongside product, design, and non-technical colleagues to align engineering with business objectives.

Demonstrated potential for people leadership: mentoring others, giving feedback, and contributing to team culture.

Solid problem-solving skills and comfort navigating ambiguity in evolving, data-focused platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with internal tools, enterprise analytics/benchmark systems, or B2E platforms.

Familiarity with real-time data, event streaming, or OLAP workloads.

Exposure to Azure services (Container Apps, VNet, Monitor) and IaC (Bicep/Terraform).

Background in frontend data visualization, backend optimization, or AI-assisted workflows.

Previous mentoring or informal leadership in scaling features or small projects.

What We Offer

Leadership of a high-visibility internal platform that influences organizational decisions.

Opportunity to grow as a manager in a supportive, innovative environment with mentorship from senior leaders.

Hands-on technical involvement while developing people-leadership skills.

Competitive salary and benefits packages.

We value diverse perspectives and encourage all qualified individuals to apply—especially those excited to take their first step into engineering management.

This role is ideal for a technical leader passionate about data platforms, full-stack development, and people growth. It requires guiding a dedicated team to deliver a world-class platform focused on important metrics. Job Description- Enterprise Architect

Position Summary

As an Adobe Enterprise Architect, you will define and deliver enterprise scale digital

experience architectures that leverage Adobe Experience Cloud, AI/ML capabilities, and

modern cloud platforms. You will partner with senior business and technology leaders to

shape strategy, architecture roadmaps, and operating models that drive measurable customer

and business outcomes.

You will combine deep enterprise architecture expertise with AI, data, and cloud-native

experience to design future-ready solutions: from customer data foundations and decisioning

to personalized, omnichannel experiences. As a trusted advisor, you will guide clients through

digital, data, and AI transformation, ensuring alignment between business goals, technology

investments, and delivery teams.

Success in this role is measured by customer value and adoption, quality and feasibility of

architectures, clarity of roadmaps, impact on KPIs, and depth of trusted relationships rather

than billable hours alone.

The Opportunity

Digital is disrupting traditional business models and reshaping every stage of the customer

lifecycle. Leading organizations are turning to Adobe Experience Cloud and AI-powered

experiences to stay ahead.

Adobe’s Enterprise Architecture team is a dynamic group of senior consultants who:

• Partner with executives to define digital, data, and AI strategies.

• Design integrated architectures that connect content, data, insights, and activation.

• Help clients adopt cloud-native, API-first, and event-driven patterns on platforms such

as Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Cloud solutions, and public cloud

providers.

As an Enterprise Architect, you will use your knowledge of digital marketing technology,

AI/ML capabilities, and enterprise architecture to:

• Create strategic roadmaps for digital experience and AI innovation.

• Lead clients as a subject matter expert.

• Serve as a trusted advisor across business, data, and technology stakeholders.

What you'll Do

• Shape digital, data, and AI strategy

o Partner with executive and senior client stakeholders to define digital experience,

customer data, and AI/ML goals.

o Translate business vision into actionable multi-year architecture roadmaps

encompassing Adobe solutions, data/ML platforms, and cloud services.

o Identify key business drivers, KPIs, and value hypotheses to prioritize use cases

(e.g., personalization, journey orchestration, next-best action, marketing

optimization).

• Design enterprise and solution architectures

o Design end-to-end architectures across Adobe Experience Cloud and client

ecosystems.

o Define AI- and data-centric architectures, including: Customer data platforms,

identity, and profile management.

o Data ingestion, quality, governance, and activation patterns. Recommend futurestate

technology architectures using cloud-native principles (API-first,

microservices, event-driven, serverless) across Azure, AWS, and/or other public

clouds.

o Define reference architectures and patterns for secure, scalable cloud

deployments. Zero-trust, identity, and access management. Observability and

reliability.

• Drive alignment and governance

o Ensure alignment between business strategies, enterprise architecture, and

delivery teams across marketing, product, data, and IT.

o Define governance, operating models, and ways of working (e.g., architecture

review processes, decision forums, standards) to support sustainable adoption of

Adobe capabilities.

o Act as a liaison between Adobe teams, client business owners, IT, data/analytics,

and external partners for the full lifecycle of the engagement.

• Communicate and evangelize

o Communicate architecture options, trade-offs, and recommendations to C-level

and senior leadership using clear narratives, visuals, and value framing.

o Lead workshops, visioning sessions, and roadmap presentations that evangelize

AI and data driven digital experiences.

o Advocate for the Enterprise Architecture function and your work within the larger

Adobe Consulting organization and with clients.

• Contribute to practice growth

o Capture and codify reusable assets (reference architectures, patterns, templates,

accelerators).

o Mentor other architects and consultants on enterprise, AI, and cloud architecture

best practices.

o Support pre-sales activities (e.g., solutioning, estimations, proposals, executive

presentations) to position Adobe and EA services.

o

What you need to succeed

• proven record to develop enterprise architecture models.

• Validated experience with architecture frameworks such as API, SOA, and TOGAF

• Understanding & experience with public cloud architecture and services (Microsoft

Azure / Amazon AWS).

• Experience designing or integrating AI-powered customer experiences, including

working with LLM-based services and understanding core concepts such as prompt

design, RAG, and model evaluation strategies.

• Ability to collaborate with data/ML teams to define AI solution patterns and

guardrails, including basic awareness of agentic workflows and tool using agents, and

how they impact reliability, observability, and governance in enterprise environments.

• Experience from working with the Adobe Experience Cloud or at least one of its

solutions & Previous experience with other Digital Marketing platforms. (Good to

have).

• Experience communicating across senior leadership.

• Ability to intake client business vision and translate to technical solution and

architecture requirements.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills communicating deliverables, sharing

information, and leading meetings.

• Ability to communicate and lead execution of architecture vision across multifunctional

technical and strategy teams.

• Experience working with software engineers, data architects, application developers &

data scientists to plan out end-to-end solutions

• Understanding the solutions and systems that support it.

• Ability to communicate technical and business strategy optimally to audiences of

varying levels of experience, background, and seniority.

• Ability to travel a minimum of up to 50%.

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized

throughout the world on Best Companies lists. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who

are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where

ongoing feedback flows freely.

If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees

are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful

benefits we offer.

Job Title: Enterprise Deal Strategy Consultant – Finance

Role Summary

As an Enterprise Deal Strategy Consultant, you will be the decisive authority on deal approvals within the EMEA region. Your role will be pivotal in ensuring that customer proposals and contracts align with our strategic goals and financial principles. You will coordinate and manage the Enterprise C&P business, providing senior leadership with valuable insights and analysis on customer trends, deal structures, and product information. This is an outstanding opportunity to significantly influence Adobe's financial strategy while collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Deal Review, Approval & Rejection

Serve as the primary EDS approver for EMEA Enterprise deals.

Review deal structures for compliance with pricing, discounting, margin, and booking policies.

Approve or reject deals based on strategic alignment and commercial viability.

Document decisions and provide clear rationale for approvals or rejections.

Advance deals that exceed authority thresholds with detailed recommendations.

Governance & Decision Quality

Enforce consistent application of approval policies across EMEA.

Ensure decisions protect long-term revenue integrity and customer value.

Balance sales objectives with risk management through effective decision-making.

Maintain comprehensive documentation for all deal approvals.

Deal Desk Team Partnership

Partner with the Deal Desk to deliver timely and accurate assessments on customer proposals

Ensure high-quality information, analysis, and documentation is maintained observing best practises.

Review and provide feedback to ensure decision quality for output.

Quarterly Deal Analysis & Executive Reporting

Provide and present quarterly insights on EMEA deal activity, including trends and risk analysis.

Leverage data and formulate actionable reports for leadership.

Identify and recommend adjustments to policies and pricing based on recurring issues.

Strategise go-to-market with future requirements.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Communicate approval outcomes and rationale with Sales leadership.

Collaborate with Finance, Legal, and Revenue Operations on critical issues.

Ensure regional consistency in deal governance by aligning with global leadership.

Required Qualifications

Degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field.

7–10+ years of background in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, or Finance.

Demonstrated experience in roles with deal approval responsibility.

Strong understanding of complex deal structures and EMEA commercial practices.

Preferred Experience

Experience working within global or matrixed organisations.

Knowledge of revenue recognition principles.

Proficiency with Dynamics and CPQ tools.

key Skills & Proficiencies

Decisive judgment and ability to challenge where necessary.

Strong financial competence and risk assessment skills.

Executive-level communication with data storytelling.

Attention to detail and a strong governance approach.

Ability to influence and initiate discussions.

Success Metrics

Uniformity and excellence in approval decisions.

Clear reasoning behind deal approval and rejection.

Reduction in policy deviations.

Punctuality and standard of Deal Desk deliverables.

Influence of quarterly deal insights.

Leadership confidence in EMEA deal governance.

What You’ll Do

· Own the JAPAC number. Carry full responsibility for revenue, bookings, pipeline coverage, and forecast accuracy for ALM and AEM Guides

· Build a world-class sales organization. Hire, coach, and scale a high-performance JAPAC team with a strong succession bench

· Operate with precision. Instill disciplined pipeline rigor, CRM excellence, and MEDDICC-driven execution to deliver predictable outcomes

· Create demand at the top. Leverage deep CXO relationships to unlock net-new pipeline and sponsor enterprise-wide learning and publishing transformations

· Win big and expand fast. Deliver consistent net-new and expansion growth through value-led, outcome-based selling

· Move faster with AI. Apply AI-driven insights to territory planning, content creation, and forecast accuracy

· Lead with trust. Champion governance, ethical AI, and data responsibility across all engagements

What You Need to Succeed

The Project Graph team is looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of our Graph platform, a core, highly technical product used to design, visualize, execute, and share complex workflows through graph-based systems. Project Graph powers both an advanced node-based editor and downstream, simplified experiences built on top of those graphs.

This role sits at the intersection of UX, systems design, AI-enabled workflows, and platform thinking, and requires deep empathy for advanced users such as developers, technical artists, ML practitioners, and designers.

As a principal-level PM, you will define long-term direction, tackle ambiguous problems, and work closely with engineering, design, and leadership to scale a powerful, performant, and extensible graph authoring and execution platform.

What you’ll do

Define the long-term vision and roadmap for the Graph platform, including the editor, execution model, plugins, APIs, extensibility, and interoperability across products and surfaces.

Define what “great” looks like for graph-based authoring across beginner, advanced, and expert users, including transitions between power-user tooling and simplified downstream experiences.

Lead discovery efforts to deeply understand user workflows, pain points, and mental models in graph-based and automation-driven systems.

Translate complex user needs into clear product requirements, PRDs, and success metrics across both authoring and execution.

Collaborate with design to shape interaction patterns for node creation, connections, layouts, debugging, inspection, and working at scale.

Partner closely with engineering to break down large, ambiguous problems into shippable increments without losing architectural coherence.

Work with engineers on architecture-level decisions affecting performance, data models, rendering, and execution to ensure the system performs well with large graphs and real-world workloads.

Understand and influence systems such as graph execution models, state management, serialization, versioning, and reproducibility.

Define platform primitives that enable reuse, sharing, and distribution of graph-based workflows in different contexts.

Act as a bridge between user needs and technical realities, setting clear outcomes while avoiding prescriptive implementation decisions.

Strong systems thinking with the ability to reason about interconnected components, constraints, and emergent behavior.

Deep empathy for power users and creators who rely on precision, speed, debuggability, and flexibility.

Ability to operate independently at a principal level while influencing cross-functional partners.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially for complex and abstract concepts.

Background in developer tools, creative tools, game engines, VFX pipelines, ML tooling, data platforms, or automation systems.

Familiarity with graph concepts such as DAGs, execution graphs, dependency graphs, and scheduling.

Experience with extensible platforms, plugin systems, SDKs, or scripting environments.

Experience shipping products that combine authoring tools with runtime or execution environments.

Exposure to AI-driven workflows, generative systems, or model orchestration tools.

Security is foundational to Adobe’s product development and operational excellence. We are seeking a Senior Director of Security India to lead and expand Adobe’s global security engineering capabilities, with a strong focus on our India operations. This executive will play a critical role in shaping Adobe’s security strategy, driving innovation, and building trust with our customers by ensuring their data is protected and privacy is preserved.

Role Summary 

As a Senior Director, you will be responsible for the strategic leadership and operational excellence of Adobe’s Security organization in India. You will collaborate closely with the CSO, global engineering leaders, and cross-functional partners to shape and drive enterprise-wide security initiatives, in addition to engaging externally with CTO/CIO/CISOs of our APAC customers. This role requires a visionary leader with deep technical expertise, strong people leadership, and a proven track record of influencing at the executive level.

What You’ll Do 

Strategic Leadership: Define and implement the long-term vision for Adobe’s security engineering function in India, aligned with global security priorities.

Site Presence: Continue to build the security brand and presence in India with leaders across Adobe.

Customer-Facing: Engage with CTO/CIO/CISOs of our APAC customer to help build trust in our products, build relationships and help answer their security related questions, and in case of a security incident, quickly come up to speed to lead customer confidence calls.

Global Collaboration: Partner with the CSO and senior leaders across engineering, legal, and cloud infrastructure to drive cohesive security strategies.

Operational Excellence: Oversee delivery of high-impact security services, ensuring operational efficiency, scalability, and continuous improvement.

Innovation & Engineering: Lead teams in developing innovative solutions for application security, cloud security, and cyber defense.

Risk Management: Champion enterprise risk mitigation strategies, including threat modeling, vulnerability management, and incident response.

Talent Development: Build and mentor a high-performing team of security engineers, researchers, and ethical hackers. Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and inclusion.

Stakeholder Engagement: Establish trust and influence with senior executives, internal partners, and external vendors to advance Adobe’s security posture.

Compliance & Governance: Ensure adherence to global security standards, regulatory requirements, and internal policies.

Thought Leadership: Represent Adobe in industry forums, contribute to security research, and drive awareness of emerging threats and standard processes.

Complexity: Navigate a highly matrixed organization, building on strong partnerships across regions to shape security strategy, execution, and long-term Adobe success and reputation.

What You Need to Succeed 

B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Security Engineering, or related field.

15+ years of progressive experience in security engineering, including 10+ years in leadership roles with global scope.

Proven success leading large-scale security programs across cloud, application, and enterprise environments.

Deep expertise in cybersecurity frameworks, threat intelligence, and secure software development practices.

Strong understanding of infrastructure as code, security automation, and compliance as code.

Experience managing cross-functional teams, building strong partnerships across regions, influencing senior partners, and building customer relationships.

Recognized as an influential, innovative, and collaborative leader in the industry.

Certifications such as CISM, CISA, or CISSP are a plus.

Exceptional communication, critical thinking, and executive presence, both internally and externally.

Demonstrated commitment to inclusive practices.

The Opportunity
The Adobe Security Engineering Partnerships (SEP) team is seeking a Senior Product Security Engineer to scale security capabilities across our software Supply Chain, Kubernetes deployment environments, and cloud-native systems.
We're looking for a candidate that is passionate about securing the software
development lifecycle (SDLC), strengthening software supply chain integrity, and
embedding security into modern delivery pipelines using automation-first, secure-by-default approaches. You will operate as a security expert, influencing engineering organizations and key stakeholders, designing scalable security solutions, and independently managing risk across complex, cloud-native systems.

What you'll Do 

Develop and implement security controls across CI/CD platforms including GitHub workflows, Jenkins, and internal build systems.

Establish secure-by-default pipeline standards covering build isolation, artifact integrity, secrets management, and least-privilege access.

Identify systemic supply chain risks and build scalable mitigations that prevent entire classes of vulnerabilities.

Secure Kubernetes-based platforms across multi-cloud environments.

Define security baselines for clusters, workloads, container runtimes, admission controls, and network segmentation.

Perform security architecture reviews for complex CI/CD, cloud, and Kubernetes environments.

Independently manage security risk by making defensible, risk-based decisions balancing business velocity and security posture.

Recognize capability gaps and design new security solutions that increase coverage and effectiveness across multiple product areas.

Serve as a trusted security advisor and technical lead within your domain.

Establish yourself as a domain expert in CI/CD, supply chain, and cloud security.

What you need to succeed 

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field of study.

6+ years of experience in Product Security, Application Security, Cloud Security, or a related field.

Experience threat modeling for CI/CD and cloud-native systems.

Deep expertise in CI/CD systems such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar platforms.

Strong experience securing Kubernetes and containerized workloads in cloud-native environments.

Hands-on knowledge of software supply chain security, artifact signing, and open-source risk management.

Experience implementing GitOps workflows and securing infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.).

Strong programming or scripting ability (e.g., Python, Go, Bash) with experience building automation and security tooling.

Demonstrated ability to identify systemic risks and design scalable, automation-first mitigations.

Strong understanding of Secure SDLC practices and how security solutions reduce risk across large organizations.

Proven ability to influence engineering teams and serve as a technical leader without formal management authority.

The Opportunity

Strategic Program Manager leading complex, cross-functional programs that directly support business objectives and long-term organizational goals of the Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration organization. Responsible for structuring and managing multiple programs simultaneously, ensuring initiatives are coordinated, aligned, and delivering measurable impact across the enterprise.

Self-starting critical thinker who combines strategic clarity with operational rigor, proactively identifying risks, driving alignment, and ensuring accountability across diverse teams and interested parties. This program manager must demonstrate standard Program Management methodology, ensuring efficiency, scalability, and consistency.

What you'll Do

Design, structure, and manage 2–4 programs at a time.

Translate high-level goals into coordinated program roadmaps, governance models, and measurable outcomes within the Objectives/Key Results (“OKR”) framework.

Build and maintain a program life cycle based on tangible progress points and deliverables that act as health indicators and allow you to “look around the corner” and identify risks and dependencies on or over the horizon.

Drive relentless accountability and prioritization by aligning all program activities to defined picture of success, assigning clear ownership and accountability, and subsequently leading and supporting all participants and owners to deliver expected results.

Use data, team feedback, progress tracking, performance indicators, personal experience, and instincts to monitor program health and progress. Identify early signs of slowdown or drift, investigate root causes, and implement corrective actions that balance speed, quality, and sustainability.

Who you are:

Confident, articulate, cross-functional collaborator with the ability to prioritize and multi-task in a fast-paced environment to deliver customer-centric results.

Inventive problem-solver who can lead and influence with various partners.

Possesses strong EQ, meticulous attention to detail, excellent verbal, written and interpersonal skills to successfully interact with individuals of varying levels.

Dedicated team member that is casual in tone but serious about impact. Conversations are human. Humor is welcome. Hierarchy does not dominate the room. People can speak plainly and be themselves.

What you'll need:

8+ years of experience in program or portfolio management, preferably in complex, cross-functional environments.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Ability to land in a fluid environment and immediately collaborate with SMEs to establish high- to mid-level delivery targets, and build or reshape the roadmap to balance expectations and reality.

Experience with Project Management Tools (Workfront, Jira, etc) and virtual collaboration tools (SharePoint, Wiki, Miro, etc); Workfront certification a plus.

Certification in project/program management (e.g., Project Management Institute’s PMP) a plus.

The Opportunity

As a Value Engineer within the JAPAC Ultimate Success team, you will partner closely with Value Advisors and Account Teams to build rigorous, defensible financial models that quantify the measurable business impact of Adobe’s solutions.

Your mandate is to ensure that every value claim — from revenue uplift to retention improvement and operational efficiency — is supported by structured assumptions, credible benchmarks, and CFO-ready modelling. You will operate at the intersection of finance, analytics, and strategy, translating complex product capabilities and customer data into clear economic impact models that withstand executive scrutiny.

This role is less about leading the room and more about ensuring that when we enter it, our numbers are airtight.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Modelling & Quantification

Build robust return on investment, NPV, payback, and scenario-based financial models to quantify revenue growth, retention impact, cost efficiencies, and productivity gains.

Conduct sensitivity analysis and assumption testing to ensure models remain defensible under CFO-level scrutiny.

Structure value levers clearly and prevent double-counting across impact areas.

Translate marketing, commerce, and experience metrics into financial outcomes (margin impact, lifetime value, cost avoidance).

Develop scalable modelling templates and tools to standardise value calculations across the region.

Value Workshops and Business Case Development

Partner with Value Advisors and Account Teams to convert strategic value hypotheses into quantified economic impact to support Value Workshops and Business case development.

Document assumptions transparently and apply conservative modelling principles to maintain credibility.

Reconcile customer-supplied data with benchmarks and Adobe telemetry to ensure integrity of outputs.

Support renewals and expansion cases with defensible financial analysis.

Prepare executive-ready financial summaries that simplify complex modelling into clear decision-support outputs. 

Be able to explain, communicate and answer questions on the business case or models to customer executives.

Value Realisation Analytics

Track realised versus projected value across use cases, adoption, and Net Dollar Retention (N$R).

Analyse performance data to identify value at risk, underperformance drivers, and incremental growth opportunities.

Support quarterly business reviews with updated financial insights and scenario updates.

Maintain structured measurement frameworks to ensure consistent value tracking across strategic accounts.

Benchmarking & Methodology

Understand and leverage existing Adobe tools to support Value modelling,

Maintain and refine regional industry benchmarks and modelling assumptions.

Incorporate new Adobe product capabilities into financial impact models.

Contribute to the evolution of JAPAC value modelling frameworks, templates, and playbooks.

Support automation and AI-enabled modelling to scale analytical output while maintaining rigor.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Collaborate closely with Value Advisors, Sales, Ultimate Success teams, and Professional Services to ensure alignment between strategy and quantification.

Act as the quantitative authority during value workshops, renewal planning and expansion conversations.

Provide internal coaching on modelling rigor and financial logic.

Help embed value thinking into lifecycle planning and expansion strategies.

What you bring:

5–10+ years of experience in FP&A, Commercial Finance, Deals Advisory, Valuations, Strategy Consulting, Corporate Development, or Value Engineering.

Advanced financial modelling capability (expert Excel skills required; experience with scenario modelling and sensitivity analysis essential).

Strong understanding of SaaS economics, marketing return on investment, retention modelling, and unit economics.

Proven experience building defensible arguments for enterprise technology or digital transformation programs.

High analytical rigor and comfort challenging assumptions.

Ability to translate complex financial analysis into crisp, executive-ready outputs.

Experience supporting executive-level discussions (not necessarily leading them).

Familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud (Customer Experience Orchestration) or similar Martech ecosystems preferred.

Proficiency in Microsoft Suite (especially advanced Excel).

We are hiring a Named Customer Success Manager, to join our Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration (CXO) team - This role will support customers in Southern Germany, with a focus on regions near the Swiss border. To achieve the significant opportunity ahead, Adobe Customer Success needs to lead the post-sales customer experience, driving adoption and value for our customers. In this role, you will serve as an Named Customer Success Manager passionate about helping your accounts achieve their goals for personalization at scale, unifying voices across Adobe for a cohesive plan of action, and quantifying impact along the way. Named CSMs deliver an outstanding experience for Adobe’s top customers, including responsibilities for strategic planning, use case adoption, advocacy and value realization. What You'll Do: 

The Named Customer Success Manager will be responsible for customer-facing leadership to evangelize mutual success plans, engagement strategies, and frameworks for measurable impact. You will use strong executive presence and have a deep understanding of digital marketing, applying diverse sources of information, especially business trends and metrics, towards innovative customer experiences.
