The Opportunity

Adobe’s Creativity & Productivity (C&P) Enterprise is one of the fastest-growing business, enabling millions of individuals, teams, and enterprises to digitize workflows and reimagine productivity. Channel partners are critical to scaling this impact, unlocking new routes to market, and ensuring customers receive maximum value from our solutions.

We are seeking a Director of Channel Strategy to develop and drive the next generation of strategic channel plans for C&P globally. Within our C&P Strategy & Operations Organization, this leader will develop Adobe’s go-to-market partner vision. They will align it with enterprise priorities and ensure the channel ecosystem achieves balanced growth, customer reach, and partner profitability.

What You’ll Do

Design Strategic Channel Plans

Develop multi-year channel strategies tailored to C&P priorities, ensuring alignment with Adobe’s broader Creativity & Productivity strategy.

Segment markets and partners to build differentiated coverage models, balancing global scale with local execution.

Translate market trends, competitive insights, and partner feedback into actionable critical initiatives.

Enable Growth Through Partners

Define partner motions across acquisition, upsell, cross-sell, and retention for enterprise and mid-market segments.

Identify new partner types and routes-to-market (e.g., marketplaces, digital-first, co-sell with hyperscale).

Drive initiatives that improve partner value proposition and elevate Adobe’s position as a vendor of choice.

Operationalize Strategy

Partner with Channel Sales, Partner Programs, Finance, and Marketing to ensure strategy translates into executable plans, incentives, and enablement.

Develop and coordinate frameworks for partner investment, coverage optimization, and prioritization.

Establish benchmarks and dashboards to measure channel performance, program efficiency, and strategic value.

Collaborate & Influence

Serve as the strategic thought partner to senior leadership across C&P and Global GTM.

Build alignment across cross-functional teams and geographies to ensure consistent partner engagement and execution.

Act as an advocate for partners inside Adobe, ensuring their needs are reflected in product, program, and GTM decisions.

What You’ll Bring

12+ years of experience in channel strategy, partner programs, or go-to-market planning, ideally in SaaS, productivity software, or enterprise solutions.

Proven ability to develop and complete strategic channel plans that drive measurable business growth.

Strong understanding of enterprise partner ecosystems (VAR, SI, ISV, MSP, Distribution, Marketplaces).

Expertise in partner economics, coverage models, compensation/incentives, and digital sales motions, ideally in both reseller and agent models.

Exceptional collaboration, communication, and influence skills across executive and cross-functional stakeholders.

Strategic problem solver with a data-driven approach, able to balance long-term vision with operational excellence.

We are seeking a Director (M60) to lead the Multimodal Data Research organization within Applied Science and Machine Learning (ASML). This organization is responsible for scaling, quality, and innovation in multimodal training data—spanning image, video, and audio—that powers Adobe Firefly’s foundational generative and editing models.

The Multimodal Data Research organization sets the data foundation for Firefly’s multimodal intelligence, owning first‑party strategy and execution across ingestion, filtering, captioning, generation and editing‑centric datasets, data‑driven training experiments, and next‑generation data frameworks. By grounding model training in high‑quality, diverse, and workflow‑authentic data, the team directly shapes Firefly’s creative capabilities. This role calls for a technically deep director who can articulate long‑term vision, lead multiple senior teams, and orchestrate execution across a fast‑moving multimodal AI ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

Organizational Leadership & Strategy

Set and own the long‑term vision and roadmap for multimodal data research across image, video, and audio.

Define clear investment priorities across data quality, coverage, scalability, and iteration speed to support Firefly’s foundational and editing‑centric models.

Build and evolve an organization that balances research innovation with operational excellence in data delivery.

Lead multiple teams spanning multimodal data quality and scaling, captioning and prompt rewriting, data frameworks and infrastructure, and systematic training ablations to advance large‑scale pretraining and editing datasets.

Establish org‑wide quality bars, taxonomies, and evaluation signals for multimodal training data.

Partner across Adobe and drive adoption of shared tooling, data frameworks, and best practices to reduce duplication and accelerate iteration.

People Leadership & Talent Development

Lead, mentor, and grow senior managers, staff‑level ICs, and emerging leaders.

Build a culture of technical rigor, ownership, and thoughtful risk‑taking.

Attract and retain top talent in multimodal data, ML systems, and applied research.

What You Need to Succeed

Technical & Domain Expertise

10+ years of experience in machine learning, data systems, or applied research, with significant exposure to large‑scale ML training data.

Deep understanding of how data quality, composition, and labeling affect generative and editing model behavior.

Experience working with multimodal data (image, video, audio) and large‑scale data pipelines.

Strong intuition for balancing research exploration with production constraints.

Leadership & Strategy

Proven experience leading multi‑team organizations in technically complex environments.

Ability to set long‑term vision while driving near‑term execution.

Strong cross‑functional leadership skills, with experience influencing research, product, infrastructure, and executive stakeholders.

Excellent communicator, able to synthesize complex technical and organizational tradeoffs.

Education

Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field preferred.

Adobe is seeking a bold, strategic leader to define and scale our global strategy for the Technology sector. This role spans software, hardware, semiconductor, electronics, cloud and platform companies, Professional Services, and Agency Networks, often with complex B2B, B2C and B2B2C value chains. 

As the Global Industry Strategy Lead, Technology, you will define Adobe’s industry point-of-view (POV) and translate it into a globally aligned, cross-cloud (Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration + Adobe Creativity & Productivity) go-to-market (GTM) strategy. You will partner deeply across Sales, Product Management, Product Marketing, Solution Consulting, Customer Success, and Marketing to unify Adobe’s narrative, accelerate pipeline, and drive repeatable impact across regions. 

 

This role sits within the Digital Strategy Group (DSG) and plays a critical part in Adobe’s Global Industry Strategy team—responsible for shaping Adobe’s industry vision, value propositions, and high-impact strategic motions at scale. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

1. Develop Adobe’s POV for the Future of Technology 

Lead the creation of a differentiated, forward-looking POV that demonstrates how Adobe enables transformation across the entire Technology customer and partner ecosystem. 
This includes: 

· Demonstrating value across product-led growth motions, partner ecosystems, B2B commerce models, cloud & platform engagement, and customer lifecycle experiences 

· Shaping strategic use cases across data, personalization, content supply chain modernization, global marketing operations, and unified measurement 

· Developing reusable global assets: frameworks, POVs, use-case libraries, playbooks, industry demos, and Bill of Materials (BOM) content for sales, DSG, and partners

· Align strategy across sales plays, product requirements, partner motions, and regional needs

· Provide input to product and engineering teams around emerging trends, customer patterns, and required capabilities 

· Collaborate with partner teams to define joint assets, accelerators, and co-sell strategies

· Lead Adobe’s involvement in industry events, executive forums, and roundtables 

· Present compelling, strategic thought leadership to C-suite audiences

The Professional Development Specialist will play a critical role within the Customer Solutions & Innovation Team and is responsible for designing, implementing, and evaluating training programs to enhance employee skills and organizational performance. They assess training needs, create educational materials, facilitate workshops, and measure program effectiveness to drive continuous learning, productivity, career growth, and high-quality customer delivery. The Professional Development Strategist must be a proactive problem-solver with strong customer-first thinking, attention to detail, and an eye for user experience.

What You’ll Do:

Develop Professional Enablement Strategy: Develop and implement professional enablement strategy that aligns with business objectives and addresses both internal and external customer needs.

Needs Assessment: Identify skill gaps and training needs through surveys, interviews, meeting with managers, and leveraging the voice of the customer. 

Curriculum Development: Create and update enablement content, including online courses and training documentation. 

Instruction & Facilitation: Design workshops, onboarding sessions, and select & facilitate instructional sessions of outside professional enablement courses. 

Evaluation & Analysis: Analyze training effectiveness, adjusting programs for performance.

Operational management: Develop intake, design and creation processes. Maintain schedules and status reporting of enablement creation progress. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Delivery, Solution Customer Engagement, Strategy & Readiness, and Global Operations to gain alignment or inputs on enablement when needed.

Voice of the Customer (VoC): Use customer feedback and insights, in addition to research on industry trends and audience behavior, and customer feedback to inform enablement planning and prioritization that directly enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty.

What You’ll Need to Succeed:

Bachelor's degree in Education, Human Resources, Organizational Development, or a related field.

10+ years of proven experience in instructional design, or designing programs at scale, preferably in a SaaS or technology company.

A portfolio demonstrating excellence in professional development strategy, enablement design and creation. Understanding Program Management a plus.

Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a cross-functional, agile team environment.

Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across all levels of the organization.

Experience in a customer-centric or customer solutions environment is highly preferred.

Proficiency in document development tools including PowerPoint, InDesign, Adobe Express.

Experience with technical delivery of the Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration product suite is a plus.

Increased Time to Value

Increased automations in delivery processes

Increased asset reusability

Defined framework for cross training strategy

Progress toward the BDO will be reviewed quarterly and used to guide performance feedback, team alignment, and strategic prioritization.

You will shape how meaning, intent, and abstraction are represented and learned at foundation‑model scale, influencing multiple generations of models and products. This is a highly strategic individual contributor role with broad organizational impact.

What You’ll Do

Foundation Model Data Vision

Define the multi‑year vision for understanding‑centric data that enables unified comprehension and generation.

Establish core principles for semantic representation, supervision, and curriculum at foundation‑model scale.

Identify limitations in existing data paradigms and drive the invention of new approaches.

Semantic Architecture & Alignment

Design canonical semantic abstractions that bridge perception‑level signals with high‑level concepts such as intent, reasoning, and compositional structure.

Lead the evolution of supervision schemas toward rich, model‑interpretable semantic signals.

Guide the use of multimodal and vision‑language models to bootstrap scalable understanding data.

Data Curriculum & Model Behavior

Define understanding‑focused data curricula across model scale and training phases.

Lead ablations to quantify how semantic data choices affect generalization, controllability, and robustness.

Balance organic, synthetic, and model‑generated data to optimize learning efficiency.

Organizational Leadership

Serve as the technical authority for foundation‑model understanding data across Adobe.

Influence research, infrastructure, and product roadmaps through principled, data‑driven guidance.

Mentor senior scientists and architects; set standards for rigor and reproducibility.

What You Need to Succeed

10+ years of experience in ML, data systems, or AI research, including leadership on large‑scale or foundation models.

Demonstrated impact shaping data, learning paradigms, or representations for LLMs or multimodal models.

Deep expertise in semantic representation, reasoning, and abstraction.

Strong intuition for interactions between data, model architecture, and training dynamics.

Ability to influence senior technical and business leaders through clear technical judgment.

Education

Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field strongly preferred.

The Integrated Go-to-Market (IGTM) team advises Adobe’s senior leadership on strategies for improved market success and customer impact across all lines of business and geographies. Our focus is translating strategy into action by aligning teams, programs, and execution across the Enterprise go‑to‑market motion. By improving coordination across functions, IGTM helps the field scale more effectively while reducing friction for customers and internal teams. Today, Adobe is at the forefront of enabling our customers’ digital transformation and new experience-led business models. 

The Opportunity 

As a Senior IGTM Strategist (Sales Strategy & Execution), you will drive cross‑functional alignment across the global Enterprise, partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Partner teams, Pre‑Sales, Professional Services, and Customer Success to translate integrated go‑to‑market strategies into cohesive programs and execution plans. You will help operate the Enterprise GTM system by identifying where execution is breaking down, framing clear problem statements, and mobilizing the right owners to deliver systemic fixes that scale globally. 

 

This role requires strong judgment, comfort navigating ambiguity, and the ability to influence through shared ownership. You will regularly frame decisions for leaders by presenting options, tradeoffs, and a recommended path, and you will escalate GTM risks and breakdowns early with a clear ask and plan to resolve them. 

 

 

What you’ll do 

Diagnose GTM execution breakdowns by synthesizing data and field input into clear problem statements, root-cause hypotheses, and recommended actions. 

Escalate risks and decisions early with concise options and tradeoffs and drive alignment to a decision and a path forward. 

Lead cross-functional workstreams that deliver systemic fixes, and ensure solutions scale across regions 

Translate strategy into repeatable execution mechanisms such as operating rhythms, governance, templates, and playbooks that improve consistency and adoption. 

Clarify roles, dependencies, and success measures across the ecosystem so teams operate as one integrated motion across the customer lifecycle. 

Establish insight-to-action loops that track commitments to completion and confirm that fixes are adopted and improving outcomes over time. 

 

What you need to succeed 

5+ years of enterprise marketing or SaaS experience in Strategy, Sales Operations, Marketing, Consulting, or Pre-Sales 

GTM Experience – Strong GTM experience and understanding of a SaaS customer lifecycle, sales cycles, and the factors that drive sales success. 

Problem Solving – Outstanding problem solving and analytical skills, including comfort developing hypotheses and crafting recommendations focused on the biggest opportunities. 

Workstream Ownership – Experience leading cross-functional workstreams, aligning stakeholders, managing competing priorities, and driving progress through influence rather than authority. 

Collaboration & Communication – Excellent communication skills, including the ability to clearly convey complex ideas verbally and in writing, and to frame decisions for senior leaders. 

Project Management - Strong project management skills and the ability to prioritize and balance multiple initiatives in a dynamic and evolving work environment. 

Desirable but not essential 

MBA or equivalent advanced degree 

Experience designing or operating cross‑functional GTM models across Marketing, Sales, Partners, and Professional Services 

Experience leading companywide launches, transformations, or execution frameworks that require sustained cross functional alignment 

Background in GTM Operations, Revenue Operations, or strategic Enablement roles focused on operating model design, adoption, and execution effectiveness 

Technology sales or management consulting experience

The Senior Marketing Manager for Financial Services & Insurance (FSI) serves as the strategic marketing partner to sales leadership, accountable for driving marketing performance across a highly regulated and complex industry.

This role develops and delivers marketing strategies tailored to the dynamics of banking, insurance, capital markets, and FinTech, balancing regulatory requirements with compelling value propositions for compliance‑sensitive audiences and long, risk‑aware buying cycles.

The focus is on enabling balanced growth and deepening customer engagement. It also involves building trust and accelerating pipeline creation and progression. This applies to both existing customers and new market opportunities.

What you'll Do

Partner closely with FSI sales as a trusted marketing advisor, bringing thoughtful insight into sector dynamics, regulation, and customer needs.

Be accountable for FSI marketing impact, with a clear understanding of pipeline goals, bookings targets, and marketing’s role in revenue growth.

Develop and deliver a cohesive, compliant FSI marketing strategy aligned to global priorities and adapted to regional and customer realities.

Develop extensive knowledge of the industry landscape, including market trends, regulatory change, and evolving customer challenges to inform go‑to‑market strategy.

Identify and support growth opportunities across priority subsectors such as Banking, Insurance, Wealth/Asset Management, Payments, and FinTech.

Lead coordinated marketing execution across campaigns, digital programs, ABM, events, and partner initiatives for your specific industry.

Compose inclusive, compliant messaging and campaigns that resonate with diverse, multi‑stakeholder buying groups.

Foster strong alignment across Sales, BDR, Campaigns, Digital, and Content teams to focus on priority accounts and meaningful customer journeys.

Lead quarterly and half‑year marketing planning for FSI, ensuring alignment with global plays and persona‑based campaigns.

Design and deliver senior‑level engagement programs, including executive roundtables, councils, and regulatory‑focused discussions.

Strengthen the company’s credibility and visibility in the FSI market through thought leadership, professional forums, and partner networks.

Collaborate with Customer Success to build advocacy programs, customer stories, onboarding journeys, and expansion initiatives.

Track, analyse, report and optimize engagement, pipeline creation, progression, and bookings within the FSI segment.

Communicate confidently and transparently with senior leaders, using data and storytelling to guide priorities and continuous improvement.

What you need to succeed

Minimum 2 years' experience in B2B marketing in the tech sector.

Deep expertise in B2B marketing strategy, enterprise demand generation, and ABM—particularly for complex, risk averse buying cycles.

Demonstrated experience of working with diverse departmental groups to deliver marketing initiatives in a matrix style organisation.

Proven capacity to collaborate with sales to deliver against pipeline and revenue targets

Demonstrated ability to translate regulatory and industry complexity into compelling and trustworthy marketing narratives.

Data-driven attitude capable of communicating marketing’s business impact in clear, outcome-focused terms.

Strong analytical skills enabling clear, commercial storytelling through data.

Creative, disciplined mentality, comfortable navigating ambiguity while maintaining regulatory precision.

Proven experience marketing to organizations within the finance and insurance industries.

Executive presence with the ability to influence senior sales leaders, C-suite customers, and cross functional teams.

With Experience Platform, enterprises will be able to use completely coordinated marketing and analytics solutions for driving meaningful customer interactions.
Our engineering team is responsible for building the Adobe Experience Platform. We help thousands of customers collect, manage and synthesize petabytes of data with high fidelity and velocity. We help them make sense of that data, glean insights and run algorithms, so they can deliver delightful experiences in real-time, every time. If building new secure micro-services in the cloud based on open-source technologies at large-scale is something you’re into, let’s share some thoughts, we’d like to meet!

What you’ll do: 

Design and develop distributed, scalable, highly available services

Be involved in all the product development and delivery stages, as part as an agile engineering team working on new products

Transform the business requirements into feature specifications

Research on various technologies useful for the project and keep in touch with the evolution of the industry

Improve your technical and team working skills

Perform on-call activities, on rotation with the rest of the team

Contribute to and promote good software engineering practices across the team

What you need to succeed:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science (or equivalent) and 10+ years of backend software engineering experience.

Very good knowledge in Java technologies and frameworks (J2SE & J2EE) and Java web applications servers

Experience in working with infrastructure, i.e. cloud providers, containers, orchestrators, VM/Bare metal deployments, is a plus.

Experience with observability, i.e. monitoring, logging, tracing, etc.

Have experience with crafting and developing scalable and distributed applications.

Hands-on experience in using AI tools for practical applications to improve productivity and efficiency across diverse work environments.

Experience with Big Data technologies, i.e. Hadoop/HBase/MapReduce, Kafka; operational experience with these it’s a plus.

Scala and Spark knowledge is a plus.

You’ll work with enterprise customers to help them modernise how creative work gets done- from ideation through to production, collaboration, and scale, using Adobe Creative Cloud and Firefly technology.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on Creative Cloud experience, understands the realities of creative and marketing teams, and is curious about how generative AI and evolving workflows can unlock new ways of working for enterprise organisations.
 

What you’ll do

Lead discovery conversations and workshops with enterprise customers to understand creative processes, challenges, and goals

Translate customer needs into clear, compelling solution narratives using Creative Cloud, generative AI capabilities, and end-to-end content workflows

Partner closely with Sales, Specialists, and broader solution teams to support complex enterprise opportunities

Apply deep product expertise to deliver executive-ready presentations and demonstrations that focus on outcomes, value, and practical impact

Help customers move beyond individual tools toward connected creative workflows, including collaboration, review and approval, content reuse, and scale

Stay current on generative AI trends and creative workflow evolution, bringing relevant insights into customer conversations

Contribute to internal storytelling, enablement, and best practices as our creative and AI narrative continues to evolve

Influence Adobe product roadmaps by capturing customer requirements and distilling real-world enterprise feedback.

Represent Adobe at industry events, customer advisory boards, and technical conferences as an expert practitioner.
 

What you will need to succeed

Strong hands-on experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, across design, video, and/or digital content creation

Exceptional discovery and consultative skills, with the ability to lead whiteboarding, ideation, and solution-mapping sessions.

Experience working with or alongside creative, marketing, brand, or content teams, with an understanding of real-world creative workflows

Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas

We’re seeking a Staff Designer to help build the future of Firefly Enterprise and GenStudio. The role focuses on video adaptation workflows for social and marketing use cases as well as support a growing plug-in ecosystem across Adobe and third party tools. 

This is a senior leadership role based in Noida, involving high ownership and global impact. You’ll work closely with teams in design, engineering, product, and research in India and the United States. Together, you will develop intelligent, scalable creative tools used by enterprise customers worldwide. 

This role sits at the intersection of AI-powered creativity, build systems, and platform thinking—where strategy meets hands-on making. 

If you’re excited by building tools for creators, developing human-AI workflows, and influencing design direction across teams and geographies, this could be your next chapter! 

What you’ll do

As a Staff Designer, you will function as both a design leader and an active creator, shaping complex systems while staying close to craft. 

Lead end-to-end development for Firefly Enterprise Engine Studio, with emphasis on Video adaptation workflows for social and outcome-focused use cases.

Scalable, extensible plug-in solutions across Adobe products and third-party platforms.

Partner closely with engineering, product management, and applied research to prototype, test, and refine intelligent tools.

Drive a customer-centric build approach, translating enterprise needs into usable, expressive, and scalable solutions.

Mentor and guide other junior designers on the team—providing craft feedback, career mentoring, and design leadership support.

Collaborate with and influence US-based teams, contributing to shared vision, build strategy, and execution across time zones.

15+ years of experience in product, systems, or interaction composition, with experience building complex tools or platforms.

Strong design craft paired with a systems mindset—you’re comfortable building for scale, extensibility, and automation.

Technical proficiency and comfort collaborating on APIs, plug-in architectures, or platform ecosystems

Think strategically but love getting your hands dirty in build details.

The Opportunity

Join Adobe as a Senior Staff Engineer and play a critical role in building and evolving the engineering platforms that power Adobe products such as Adobe Express. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, site reliability engineering, and AI-powered platform innovation, with a focus on enabling safe, scalable, and efficient software delivery at enterprise scale.

You will work on foundational systems that support multi-tenant, multi-region cloud services used by millions of customers worldwide. As a senior technical leader, you will drive reliability, automation, and AI-enabled engineering productivity, helping shape how Adobe builds, deploys, and operates modern software systems.

What You’ll Do

Design, build, and evolve highly reliable software systems and platforms that support large-scale, distributed services. 

Architect and implement AI-powered automation systems that enhance cloud infrastructure and software delivery workflows, including intelligent orchestration of LLMs, tools, APIs, and internal data sources.

Configure and manage services running on Kubernetes-based platforms, partnering with platform teams on application configuration, deployment, and operational correctness.

Lead the development of GitOps-based workflows, CI/CD systems, and deployment automation to improve consistency, safety, and velocity across engineering teams.

Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code using tools such as Terraform to provision and manage cloud resources on AWS (e.g., CloudFront, S3, and related services).

Apply SRE principles to the design and operation of software systems, emphasizing reliability, scalability, risk management, and operational efficiency through sound engineering practices and automation.

Balance near-term engineering needs with longer-term platform investments, delivering incremental improvements with durable impact.
 

What You Need to Succeed

A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience building and operating distributed, cloud-native systems at scale.

Hands-on and extensive experience working with Kubernetes-based platforms.

Strong understanding and practical use of LLMs and AI systems in production environments.

Proven ability to design reliable, scalable, and secure AI-enabled production workflows that connect models, runtime constraints, and engineering use cases into cohesive architectures.

Strong programming skills in one or more languages commonly used in platform engineering (e.g., Typescript, Go, Java, Python, or similar).

Excellent cross-functional communication skills and the ability to influence architectural direction through technical leadership.
 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience architecting or contributing to AI assistants, copilots, or agentic platforms used in production environments.

Hands-on experience designing agent-based systems, including multi-step reasoning workflows, tool invocation, memory persistence, and state management.

Familiarity with tool-augmented LLM systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures, vector databases, and contextual memory stores.

Contributions to open-source AI frameworks, technical publications, or internal AI platform initiatives.
 

What Sets You Apart

You have strong systems thinking, with the ability to connect distributed architectures, cloud infrastructure, and AI-enabled automation into cohesive, production-ready solutions.

You adopt a pragmatic approach to AI integration, balancing innovation with reliability, security, governance, and operational discipline.

You demonstrate the ability to design intelligent automation systems that measurably improve engineering productivity, delivery velocity, and operational stability.

You have a deep understanding of production system behavior, including scalability limits, failure modes, observability patterns, and risk mitigation strategies.

You hold a track record of influencing architectural direction across engineering teams and mentoring others in reliability, platform design, and modern AI-enabled engineering practices.

Lead and scale technical program management

The opportunity

Frame.io, an Adobe Company, is changing the future of how creative work gets done by helping over 1 million creative professionals seamlessly collaborate from all over the world. We have built a product creatives recognize and love through constant innovation and incredible attention to detail.

We're looking for a Director of Design to lead a core part of our product design organization and drive both vision and execution for how creative professionals collaborate at a pivotal moment. Creative workflows and tools are rapidly evolving with the advent of generative AI and new technologies like Frame.io’s Camera to Cloud. In this role, you'll lead and inspire a team of talented design managers and individual contributors, setting the creative bar for our product experiences while partnering closely with leadership across product, engineering, and research.

This is a role for an accomplished design leader who combines exceptional strategic thinking with a genuine passion for craft. You'll be equally comfortable defining multi-year product vision, developing organizational capability, and regularly rolling up your sleeves to provide hands-on creative direction. You should possess deep expertise in product design, proven ability to build and scale high-performing teams, and an unwavering commitment to design excellence. Your leadership will shape the future of Frame.io, pioneering new experiences that shape how millions of creatives work in the next era of creativity.

What you'll do

Build, mentor, and grow a world-class design team. You'll attract exceptional talent, develop design managers and senior individual contributors, and create a culture and process where designers thrive and do their best work.

Shape strategic direction across Frame.io and Adobe. You'll partner with executive stakeholders to translate business objectives into compelling design vision, identify emerging opportunities in creative collaboration, and ensure our product roadmap reflects deep user understanding and market insight.

Provide creative direction and uphold design excellence. You’ll set and maintain the highest standards for design quality. You'll provide hands-on creative direction on key initiatives, conduct design reviews that elevate the work, and ensure every product experience reflects Frame.io's commitment to extraordinary craft and attention to detail.

Partner closely with product, engineering, research, and marketing leadership. You’ll work cross-functionally to ensure seamless collaboration and aligned execution. You'll advocate for design thinking throughout the organization, influence strategic decisions, and build strong relationships that unlock the team's full potential.

Ensure deep customer empathy drives every design decision. You'll establish frameworks for integrating user research throughout the design process, personally engage with customers to understand their needs, and inspire your team to build products that truly serve creative professionals.

Stay on the bleeding edge of creative technology. The creative collaboration landscape is rapidly evolving with generative AI, new production tools, and shifting creative processes. You'll immerse yourself in these innovations, identify opportunities to shape Frame.io and Adobe’s direction, and provide visionary leadership that keeps us at the forefront of our category.

Serve as the champion and storyteller for your team's work. You'll represent design in executive forums, craft compelling narratives that bring design decisions to life, and build consensus across leadership. Through excellent presentations, clear communication, and strong relationships, you'll ensure your team's contributions are understood and valued, translating design work into business impact.

What you need to succeed

5+ years of design leadership, experience managing managers and leading design organizations, plus 10+ years of hands-on product design experience. You've successfully built and scaled design teams at companies that ship high-quality digital products.

Exceptional creative direction capabilities. You have an outstanding aesthetic sense and ability to provide clear, actionable creative direction. You have impeccable taste, know what great looks like, and can articulate a compelling vision that inspires teams to push beyond good to exceptional.

A desire to stay in the work. While you're an experienced leader, you maintain a strong desire to be close to the work and the details. You thrive when you can provide hands-on creative direction, review designs thoughtfully, and ensure the highest standards of craft are upheld across all touchpoints.

People leadership excellence. Track record of building and developing exceptional design teams. You're a natural coach and mentor who helps designers at all levels grow, establishes the conditions for teams to do their best work, creates psychologically safe environments, and can identify and execute performance management situations when necessary.

Proven ability to think strategically about product design at scale. You understand how to balance long-term vision with near-term execution and translate business objectives into cohesive design strategies. You understand how to balance qualitative and quantitative insights, know when to validate versus explore, and ensure user needs drive design decisions. You also know how to establish processes that provide clarity, predictability, and accountability without creating bureaucracy, to uphold both high quality standards and work velocity.

Excellent storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership. You can distill complex design thinking into compelling narratives, present with confidence to executives, and advocate effectively for design investments and strategic initiatives.

Proven ability to build strong partnerships with product management, engineering, research, and other disciplines. You create alignment through influence rather than authority, navigate ambiguity with grace, and bring out the best in cross-functional teams. You can engage meaningfully with engineering partners about implementation and feasibility.

An outstanding portfolio. A strong, highly crafted portfolio that demonstrates both your evolution as a design leader and your continued commitment to excellence and craft. Your work should showcase thoughtful problem-solving, high-quality execution, and the impact of your creative direction on shipped products.

Why Frame.io

Join a team that's redefining how creative work happens. At Frame.io and Adobe, you'll have the opportunity to impact millions of creative professionals, work alongside exceptional talent, and shape products that people genuinely love. As part of Adobe, you'll have the resources and reach of a global leader combined with the entrepreneurial spirit and design-first culture that makes Frame.io special.

If you're a design leader who combines strategic vision with a passion for craft, who thrives on building great teams and creating exceptional products, we'd love to hear from you.

The Opportunity 

The Digital Strategy & Solutions Group works with Adobe customers across all levels ranging from C-level executives, with a focus on the CIO/CTO, to operational teams to advise on strategies and technology solutions to support customer-experience transformation and digital innovation, diving deep into architecture and identifying prioritized path forward for customers. Our engagements assess a customer’s current state experience ecosystem architecture, define the future-state technical vision Northstar Architecture, assess the gaps between the two, and then provide technical leadership to a sales cycle where we must overcome technical blockers and communicate the business value of a combined solution of Adobe products to customer team members.

The Director of Enterprise Architects, will be managing a team of hard workers who blend technical and business skills to architect solutions for Adobe customers. Helping brands to fully capitalize on the era of digital transformation, so they can deliver personalized and impactful experiences across all devices and channels for their customers through architecture and aligning that to Adobe's solutions. The ability to see, measure, and analyze critical factors such as resources, outcomes, and priorities keeps everyone on the same page, and team members know why their work matters.

Reporting to the head of Enterprise Architecture, this customer-facing leadership role offers a rich opportunity to lead senior and principal architects. This leader will be the primary technical partner for a Sales VP/Industry head and be accountable for technical leadership for that vertical.

What you'll Do 

Act in a sponsorship capacity for deals within assigned patch of business to ensure application of team standard methodologies and procedures while also driving revenue outcomes.

Identify, recruit, hire, onboard, empower, grow, enable, and retain top architect talent.

Prioritize technical workstreams against capacity while driving technical pipeline progression to meet and exceed bookings targets

Maintain operational cadence for reporting and updates that effectively communicates deal status to collaborators on and off the architecture team. Interact directly with individual contributors and leaders in presales, sales, product management, delivery (both Adobe and partner) and engineering.

Live on the cutting edge on Adobe products, industry trends, and competition. Align with Adobe CXO processes and standards to ensure uniformity across CXO product pre-sales.

What you need to succeed 

10+ Years of architecture experience working with one of the following: enterprise architecture, data architecture, or content architecture.

10+ years of people management experience. Software presales or sales experience. Strong executive presence, presentation skills, and documentation skills.

Ability to operate in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment. Where processes and procedures often need to be adjusted along the way.

Familiarity with Adobe products, especially the Adobe Marketing Cloud and Adobe Experience platform.

Ability to partner effectively with customer IT and marketing leaders. Build rapport with salespeople, sales managers, and other presales staff.

Build relationships with Adobe & partner consultants and delivery leaders.

Solid understanding of current technical and architectural trends and concepts across key Adobe Experience functional areas of Data, Content, and Journeys.

Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills. Including conducting research, developing hypotheses, and synthesizing recommendations.

Good interpersonal skills. Ability to work successfully with people at all levels in an organization. Ability to communicate complex ideas efficiently both verbally and in writing.

Proven track record of multi-functionally in a team environment

Passion for new knowledge, resourceful and able to absorb concepts quickly. Enjoy challenges and learning about industry and technology trends

High level of energy, personal drive, and positivity

Open to remote candidates within US who are willing to travel (as required)

The Challenge

Adobe is looking for an Account Director who is responsible for achieving sales targets through the sale of Adobe’s Digital Marketing product lines. As a part of our enterprise sales team, working with Adobe’s largest customers across the Healthcare and Life Sciences industry. This includes the development of long-term relationships with customers as well as crafting strategic account plans. The Account Director will achieve this through software solution selling capabilities and direct, face-to-face contact with the customer. Responsibilities include building relationships at all levels with a focus on c-suite, and effectively navigating the customer's organization. You will guide and assist customers in achieving a successful start with Adobe and help them expand the value realized from our solution. This is a key role at one of the most respected technology companies in Silicon Valley – and the entire US. Successful candidates will be high energy, data-minded, naturally inquisitive, and tech-savvy individual with prior senior level sales experience. Do you value extraordinary benefits, and one of the best places to work in the world?

What you’ll do

Approach the business strategically and set a multi-year north star vision and strategy for your business grounded in value. Proactively identify and achieve path to sales plan.

Be an innovative and resilient problem solver. Able to bring forward and take the lead on solving ambitious and sophisticated problems that allow Adobe to better serve our customers.

Communicate with customers effectively and persuasively to uncover company-viable solutions from their view.

Build strong executive relationships across multiple fields (CIO, CTO, CMO, CDO).

Identify and gain alignment from customer on compelling business issue to be addressed.

Demonstrate industry expertise, thought leadership, grasp of macro-economic environment and be a trusted advisor.

Articulate the Adobe story, unique value proposition and how Adobe’s solutions align with customer’s vision and solve customer’s business issue (e.g. return on investment of product).

Lead, collaborate and orchestrate Adobe's entire Ecosystem and Partners to drive outcomes. Use Adobe's ecosystem to the fullest potential.

Collaborate to drive consensus and action. Owner and driver of the territory and account strategy and how the ecosystem will support.

Manage large, sophisticated sales processes internally involving legal, deal desk, product marketing, product support& engineering and other Adobe customers.

Identify and lead collaboration with external 3rd parties including tech partners and system integrators.

Meet sales quota and run efficient business

Advance and close sales opportunities - through the successful execution of the sales strategy and roadmap.

Build strong account plans at the beginning of the year and lead regular account planning meetings to keep team aligned.

Follow a well-adapted approach to maintaining a rolling 4Q pipeline. Keep pipeline current and quickly qualify opportunities. Collaborate with support organizations including Marketing, Inside sales, Partners and channels to funnel pipeline into your accounts.

Ideal candidate will have:

Minimum 5 to 7+ years with proven track record selling solutions to Marketing, IT, and brands or lines of business in large enterprise organizations;

Ability to work effectively in a team environment, optimally partnering with other Adobe teams including Sales, Support, Engineering, Product & Marketing;

Strong understanding of digital experience technologies and SaaS within the HLS space;

Validated Sales Excellence and creative, problem-solving approach

Adobe is driving strategic growth with global Private Equity (PE), Venture Capital (VC), and Sovereign Wealth (SWF) firms through its new go-to-market – Adobe Private Capital (APC). APC partners with Operating Partners and Portfolio Companies globally to unlock transformative value using Adobe’s integrated technology.

As the Adobe Private Capital Enterprise Architect, you will be the senior technical authority within the APC team. You will work at the intersection of deep technical architecture and value creation, advising PE/VC/SWF firms and their portfolio companies on how to maximise ROI from Adobe solutions and the broader ecosystem. This role demands strong foundational technical capability across Adobe’s full portfolio, cloud architectures, and third-party integrations, while maintaining a relentless focus on business outcomes, value hypotheses, and measurable value realisation for capital allocators and their portfolios.

What you’ll do:

Partner with the APC team and regional field technical teams to translate value hypotheses into robust technical architectures and roadmaps that deliver measurable value creation for portfolio companies

Working with regional field technical teams lead the design of end-to-end solution architectures across Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration, Creativity & Productivity, and the wider ecosystem, including complex integrations with third-party platforms, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), and legacy systems

Conduct technical assessments and North Star architecture reviews for priority portfolio companies, defining current-state, target-state, and transition roadmaps aligned to PE value levers (EBITDA improvement, revenue growth, operational efficiency)

Develop compelling technical cases and business cases that link Adobe capabilities to portfolio company priorities, supporting pipeline acceleration and executive decision-making with Operating Partners and C-level stakeholders

Provide architecture oversight during pre-and post-sales phases, ensuring seamless transition into value realisation, governance model execution, and long-term adoption of Adobe solutions

Collaborate with Adobe product, engineering, and services teams to influence roadmap priorities and deliver customised solutions that address unique PE/VC/SWF requirements

Act as a trusted technical advisor to APC leadership, regional teams, and external stakeholders, delivering thought leadership through workshops, executive briefings, and industry events

Contribute to joint governance models by defining technical milestones, risk mitigation strategies, and performance metrics that track value realisation across portfolio engagements

Stay at the forefront of cloud architecture patterns, integration best practices, and emerging technologies (AI, generative AI, data platforms) to strengthen Adobe’s positioning within private capital value creation playbooks

What you need to succeed:

Adobe is a high-energy, high-performance company! Our APC Enterprise Architect must be a proven technical leader with fantastic communication skills, strong project management discipline, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment within a global matrix.

10+ years of enterprise architecture or senior technical presales experience in SaaS, enterprise software, or digital transformation environments, with proven success in complex, multi-solution engagements

Strong technical depth across Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration and Creativity & Productivity solutions, plus broad knowledge of cloud architectures, API integrations, data platforms, and third-party ecosystem technologies

Demonstrated ability to connect technical architecture decisions directly to business value outcomes, financial impact, and PE/VC-style value creation frameworks

Experience working with Private Equity, Venture Capital, or large enterprise transformation programs is highly advantageous

Outstanding advisory and communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to C-level executives, Operating Partners, and non-technical stakeholders

Strong project and program management skills to drive technical alignment across matrixed teams and ensure on-time delivery of commitments

Analytical and strategic thinker who can develop clear roadmaps, manage objections, and provide compelling thought leadership

Passion for digital innovation and a proactive, collaborative approach in a global, dynamic organisation

Strong communicator: You translate complex AI concepts for both engineers and executives and guide customers through technical decisions aligned to business objectives.

Customer-Centricity: Always prioritizing the customer and their needs and expectations first in everything you do. You are outstanding at contributing to a culture of customer-centricity among your team and your extended ecosystem.

The Transmission Planning Analysis Engineer will be responsible for conducting studies in connection with the 34.5 kV, 69 kV, 138 kV, 230 kV and 345 kV transmission system to ensure the operational reliability, adequacy, and security based on FERC 715. This work includes analysis of and studies for power flow, dynamic-stability, transient-stability, and voltage-stability. 

Job Responsibilities 

Annual NERC TPL-001 Transmission System Planning Performance Assessment using steady-state, short-circuit, and dynamics power systems techniques utilizing a software suite of TARA, PSS®E, ASPEN, and DSA Tools as governed by FERC 715. 

Annual NERC CIP-014 Physical Security assessment modeling realistic and historical physical attacks on transmission equipment to determine if said physical attack could result in instability, uncontrolled separation, or Cascading within an electrical Interconnection utilizing a software suite of TARA, PSS®E, and DSA Tools. 

As requested NERC FAC-002 qualified changes and material modification impact studies to determine if any new or materially modified load (including Large Loads and Data Centers), any new or materially modified generation, or any new or materially modified transmission results in an inability of the Transmission System to meet the performance requirements of FERC 715 using as applicable steady-state, short-circuit, and dynamic power systems techniques utilizing a software suite of TARA, PSS®E, ASPEN, and DSA Tools as governed by FERC 715. 

Evaluate the optimization of the Transmission System and proposed Transmission plans to reduce overall investment driving downward pressure on electric rates utilizing traditional and all new relevant and upcoming technologies such as GETs. 

Participate in stakeholder meetings of, Plan projects within, and Evaluate MISO’s regional Transmission Planning process, the MISO Expansion Transmission Plan (MTEP) to ensure effective, efficient, and thorough evaluation of Transmission Projects ensuring just and reasonable Transmission scope using steady-state, short-circuit, and dynamics power systems techniques utilizing a software suite of TARA, PSS®E, ASPEN, and DSA Tools as governed by FERC 715. 

Participate in stakeholder meetings of, Plan projects within, and Evaluate MISO’s Expedited Project Review (EPR) and Expediate Resource Adequacy Study (ERAS) to ensure effective, efficient, and thorough evaluation of Transmission Projects ensuring just and reasonable Transmission scope using steady-state, short-circuit, and dynamics power systems techniques utilizing a software suite of TARA, PSS®E, ASPEN, and DSA Tools as governed by FERC 715. 

Collaborate amongst Indiana’s five vertically integrated Investor-Owned Utilities and two Generation & Transmission Cooperatives to establish a cost-effective forecasted Transmission Plan that reliably serves existing and new Indiana customers. 

Prepare for and defend against regulatory audits of entities including but not limited to NERC, IURC, FERC, and MISO for adherence to Transmission Tariffs, Distribution Tariff, and NERC compliance. 

Provide the Transmission Operations Control Center assistance in times of emergency such as extreme weather events, emergency repairs, or system restoration to ensure a timely return to energization of AES Indiana’s customers. 

Provide assistance with NERC standards including but not limited to TPL-007, TPL-008, and FAC-014 using steady-state, short-circuit, and dynamics power systems techniques utilizing a software suite of TARA, PSS®E, ASPEN, and DSA Tools as needed. 

Position Requirements: 

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or similar. 

A minimum of 3 years' experience working in the Electric Utility industry 

Problem-solving abilities are essential. 

Highly Desired Skills: 

Proficiency in report writing, analysis, and compliance procedures. 

Detailed understanding of regulatory frameworks (NERC, FERC, PJM/MISO). 

The ability to communicate complex ideas verbally and in writing. 

Proven technical knowledge and understanding of Transmission grid 

Proficiency with PSSE, TARA or similar software

Remote Options: Not Available

This role plays a primary role in supporting, managing, and advancing AES’s VMware Horizon View virtual desktop environment, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and scalability across our global enterprise. Hands-on experience in VMware Horizon View, FSLogix, and App Volumes in an enterprise environment is required for this position.

Beyond virtualization, the role supports end-user computing technologies that span device management systems, end-user hardware, and printers, providing a consistent and secure user experience that meets AES’s global standards for performance, supportability, and data protection.

This position is responsible for endpoint configuration management including PCs, tablets, and phones, as well as application deployment, client virtualization, process development, and printer management.

AES is a Fortune 500 global power company that operates on four continents.

Your Role

As a member of our Global Digital Workplace Experience & Collaborations team, you deliver modern digital experiences with a focus on user satisfaction and reliability. You play a critical role in ensuring that AES employees have an optimized, secure, and high-performing virtual desktop experience—from anywhere, on any device.

Initiative – You are a self-starter who voluntarily chooses to be engaged.

Adaptability – You naturally manage change or conflict with an optimistic and open mind.

Communication Skills – You collaborate and work well across teams, improving productivity and creating synergies.

Resilience – You solve problems, learn from failures, and grow from experiences.

What You’ll Do

As our Digital Workplace Sr. System Engineer, you will:

Serve as the primary technical owner of AES’s VMware Horizon View virtual desktop environment, ensuring stability, performance, and scalability.

Manage and optimize FSLogix profiles and App Volumes for efficient application delivery and user experience.

Support and enhance AES’s virtual infrastructure, collaborating closely with global teams to improve performance and maintain best practices.

Create and maintain software deployment packages, manage automation initiatives, and develop process improvements for scalability and self-service capabilities.

Evaluate software requests and make recommendations aligned with AES business needs and industry standards.

Perform advanced troubleshooting of complex virtual environment and endpoint issues.

Analyze and mitigate vulnerabilities, ensuring compliance with AES’s security and operational policies.

Develop and maintain detailed technical documentation, standards, and procedures.

Provide technical guidance to team members, engage with vendors, and support budget and lifecycle planning for digital workplace technologies.

What You’ll Need

Bachelor’s degree in a related field and/or equivalent technical training or experience.

5+ years’ experience in enterprise systems administration with a strong focus on VMware Horizon View and virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI).

Hands-on expertise with FSLogix and App Volumes in a large-scale production environment (required).

Strong knowledge of:

Microsoft Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy

TCP/IP networking protocols, LAN/WAN

Azure and Remote Desktop Services (RDS)

Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (SCCM) and Intune

Windows 11, SQL Reporting, and PowerShell scripting

Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Teams, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Strong teamwork, adaptability, communication, and problem-solving skills.

AES Clean Energy (AES) is seeking a Transmission Strategy Market Lead for the ERCOT region, and possibly additional markets, to join our Transmission Strategy team. This role is responsible for both transmission planning and nodal production cost modeling.

AES is at the forefront of technical and strategic innovation. This team is central to continuing our industry leadership as one of the largest U.S. Independent Clean Power Producers, across Solar, Wind, and Storage.

This ERCOT Market Lead, Transmission Strategy role, will serve as the principal Transmission Strategy lead for ERCOT, and possibly additional continental US energy markets.

The Transmission Strategy team is responsible for setting a transmission focused market-wide strategy in all Continental U.S. energy markets, and integrating that strategy across AES teams, including Development, Commercial, Execution, and other teams. This strategy will be applied to prioritizing our greenfield efforts, prioritizing our project acquisition efforts, and prioritizing our existing project pipeline. The Transmission Strategy team is also responsible for project specific assessment of network impacts, and deliverability risks and opportunities.

This function is critical through all stages of development, from greenfield prospecting through late-stage interconnection studies and agreement execution. 

The Transmission Strategy team relies on a combination of traditional transmission planning and load flow analysis, while pioneering innovative approaches to anticipate transmission network opportunities and risks. The team relies on a mix of conducting in-house and consultant-supported load flow studies. 

Desired Skills, Expertise, etc. 

Deep relevant experience including transmission planning, market design, interconnection policy, resource adequacy and/or market operations is required. Experience with multiple Regional Transmission Organizations (RTO) and other non-RTO regions is a plus, but not a requirement.

Experience personally running power flow and stability analysis (i.e. powerGEM TARA, Powerworld, GE PSLF, Siemens PSS/E) required. Ideally, demonstrated project management experience including some experience overseeing others to run power flow studies, and experience with contractors running power flow studies is preferred. 

Experience personally running nodal production cost modeling (i.e., PROMOD, UPLAN, GE MAPS, Aurora), and evaluating dispatch trends, curtailment trends and locational marginal pricing trends.. 

Experience with ISO/RTO/TO Transmission Planning, Generation Interconnection, and processes and related stakeholder processes required. Experience with Resource Adequacy processes is a plus.

Experience with reviewing and negotiating Transmission Services Agreements (TSAs) preferred. Experience with assessing strategies for wheeling across balancing authorities, is beneficial. 

Experience with renewable energy development is beneficial. 

Ability to create a positive and productive teamwork environment. 

Ability to communicate effectively in both commercial and technical venues. Ability to present complex technical content in a simplified and useful manner for a non-technical audience. 

Ability to innovate and resolve complex challenges.

Willingness to travel as needed, which is not expected to exceed 10% of the time. 

AI and/or Automation experience is a plus.

Vision for what is needed to achieve success and ability to implement an effective plan of action.

Summary:

As a member of the AES Southland Engineering team, the Reliability Engineer will provide engineering expertise in support of the plant's daily operations and maintenance activities at the AES Southland combined cycle generation sites, and assist with the design and construction of replacement generation for the entire AES Southland fleet.
 

Responsibilities:

Provide technical and business support to Safety, Environmental, Development, Commercial, and O&M teams, as well as individuals in the operating businesses and future development projects, and for daily operations.

Perform asset management strategy implementation, power plant processes and design improvements, capital spending justification, equipment malfunction troubleshooting, failure analysis, annual budget planning, and corrective action recommendations.

Actively collaborate with the maintenance and planning/scheduling groups in support of maintaining complete and accurate records/plans within the computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) related to equipment, specifications data, BOM, failure history, etc.

Assist with the development and implementation of the annual AES Southland engineering plan and budget, that includes factors for work management, long-term maintenance planning, outage preparation and execution, large project preparation and execution, and compliance with NERC and other applicable standards.

Prepare data-driven justification for capital project prioritization and budget planning.

Make informed recommendations in situations where data sets may be incomplete.

Develop and maintain “Key Performance Indicators” for equipment reliability.

Ensure that appropriate Maintenance and Reliability metrics are in place throughout the site, (planned/unplanned work, planning/scheduling metrics, cost metrics, MTBF, replacement asset value, etc.).

Ensure equipment history is maintained and analyzed for future trends

Provide hands-on direct technical accounts of equipment failures and performance degradation. Identify and manage a system of continuous improvement to ensure resolution to chronic “bad actor” equipment.

Apply Root Cause Analysis, Equipment Criticality Ranking, PM/PdM optimization, Defect Elimination, and/or Failure Modes and Effects Analysis techniques as needed

Utilize predictive technologies including – but not limited to – vibration analysis, oil analysis, infrared thermography, ultrasound, and motor current analysis.

Investigate new technologies for reliability improvements.

Prepare design specifications, perform engineering calculations, review technical specifications, and conduct equipment inspections.

Facilitate/support operational event and equipment failure investigations to ensure that the root cause/causal factors have been identified, corrective actions prescribed, and follow-up monitoring is conducted as applicable to determine effectiveness.

Prepare equipment preventative maintenance (PM) tasks, and manage the system for continuous improvement and PM optimization.

Rank the criticality of assets, typically using Reliability Centered Maintenance approaches, and for defining the proactive maintenance approaches that are cost-beneficial to the business.

Create risk mitigation strategies for critical assets.

Develop and maintain digital operator rounds program.

Coordinate the use of other AES engineering resources, technicians, and third-party resources to accomplish the objective of cost-effective Asset Management & Reliability improvements for maintenance and projects.

Manage contractors by developing work authorizations, approving completed work, coordinating invoicing and payments, and scheduling work.

Conduct all activities in accordance with AES standards for safety, health, environment, code of conduct, financial, and other internal policies as applicable.

Qualifications:

BS in Mechanical, Electrical, or Electromechanical Engineering discipline preferred.

5-7 years work experience in a related role, or related field of heavy industrial, process or construction engineering.

Certified Reliability Leader (CRL) and/or Certified Maintenance Reliability Professional (CMRP) preferred

5 or more years of experience implementing RCM, CbM/PdM methods

Self-motivated, independent, capable of performing work with limited instruction. Dependable, thriving in fast-paced, rapidly changing environment with a clear focus on safety, high quality outcomes and business success.

Experience in delivering training, coaching and mentoring using a variety of tools and techniques

Collaborative team player who views the success of the team as their own success.

Experience with project management with the ability to manage several projects simultaneously.

Agility and ability to work under pressure and to change priorities as necessary, interfacing with all levels of management.

Experience developing and managing project plans and budgets.

Experience or ability to quickly build expertise in utility scale power generation systems, including:

Instrumentation and Controls (DCS, HMI, data acquisition systems)

Electrical systems (HV/MV/LV distribution, motors, transformers and generators, electrical protection, switchgear)

Mechanical systems (pumps and fans, heat exchangers including boilers, combustion systems for natural gas, high speed rotating devices, main steel and concrete structures)

Water chemistry control systems (water treatment plant, steam/water quality monitoring)

Emissions control systems (SCR)

Analysis of asset whole lifecycle costing and total cost of ownership

Practical experience developing and optimizing maintenance strategies and plans

Implementation and/or work experience with Quality and Asset Management Systems including ISO 9001, ISO 55001

Experience with multi-discipline projects and the application of system integration techniques across multiple types of assets

Experience in business analysis and/or asset management and/or risk analysis

Thorough understanding of heavy industrial plant procedures; safety, environmental compliance, change management, reliability-centered maintenance, root cause analysis, work execution, process optimization, and continuous improvement.

Knowledge of regulations and requirements for executing new or construction projects in the state of California.

Strong English written and verbal communications skills.

Experience working with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) / Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) systems

Experienced with MS Office, SAP, AutoCAD, Solidworks, or similar engineering design/calculations software.

POSITION: Sr. Interconnection Project Engineer (full time, exempt) 

DEPARTMENT: Interconnection, Grid Integration Group 

REPORTS TO: Manager, Interconnection 

LOCATION: Remote, San Francisco CA, Long Beach CA, Salt Lake City UT, Louisville CO, New York, NY, or Richmond, VA 

 

The Grid Integration group is responsible for siting and interconnecting the AES Clean Energy portfolio to transmission systems across the United States. The group consists of a Transmission Strategy team, Interconnection team, High Voltage Engineering team, and a Generation Modelling and Technical Compliance team. 

 

The primary responsibilities of this role are: strategic analysis of the interconnection procedures, queue and transmission system in a given RTO/ISO to formulate and steer greenfield project siting, and to then prepare and manage interconnection requests through to an Interconnection Agreement with the most favorable terms possible. The Interconnection Project Engineer supports the Interconnection (IC) Regional Lead on progressing projects through the interconnection process and working cross functionally with the broader Development Team to optimize the position throughout the development lifecycle. 

 

The preferred candidate has experience in: the preparation and review of interconnection requests; review and management of PSS/E and/or PSLF models; and participating in the management of solar and wind projects through the generator interconnection processes including negotiation and execution of Generator Interconnection Agreements. Additional responsibilities include monitoring the progress of required system upgrades and identifying creative mitigation solutions when needed within the applicable open access transmission tariff. 

 

Principal Duties and Responsibilities: 

The Interconnection Project Engineer will support and lead when necessary, all interconnection activities through the full life cycle of development and construction of projects. The position will support the IC Regional Lead and other internal stakeholders leading to the successful execution of both new and acquired projects across the United States. Some travel required (~15-20%). 

Support of greenfield development: review transmission system analysis, lead the identification of interconnection agencies and procedures, help lead preparation and filing interconnection requests including leading internal and external parties on preparation of technical materials, provide viability feedback to the IC Regional Lead and other internal stakeholders to support any financial and project approvals needed. 

Interconnection study process: lead and support the review and analysis of utility study reports; help lead tracking and reporting of results throughout process; help lead negotiation and execution of interconnection agreements and engineering and procurement agreements. 

Implementation of portfolio projects: lead assistance of internal groups to complete deliverables required by transmission owners to construct interconnection facilities including integrating schedules of Transmission Owner into project construction schedule. 

Support and lead project due diligence efforts, identify existing and potential red flags for project acquisitions. 

 

Desired Skills and Expertise: 

In depth knowledge reviewing interconnection studies and familiarity with power flow models. Experience running study models a plus. 

Strong ability to analyze power flow and system impact studies for interconnection of utility scale solar, wind, and storage generating facilities. 

In depth knowledge of System Impact Studies (SIS) and other interconnection studies of renewable energy generating facilities in the respective region. 

Experienced understanding of electrical diagrams, preliminary site plans, and preparation of interconnection request packages for submittal. 

Awareness of transmission systems and transmission expansion plans in US. 

Strong knowledge of Open Access Transmission Tariffs and Generator Interconnection Procedures. 

 

Minimum Qualifications: 

BS in Electrical Engineering or related field. 

4+ years work history in renewable or traditional energy development, utility generation development, or transmission planning. Previous employment or experience working at an Electric Utility, or consultants providing services within those footprints is strongly preferred.

AES Clean Energy is recruiting for the position of Manager within the Transmission Strategy department. The Transmission Strategy department is responsible for performing transmission system analysis to steer AES Clean Energy greenfield prospecting efforts and support the interconnection for our large utility-scale project portfolio. This is an outstanding opportunity for individual who is passionate about renewable energy and seeking high-growth work environment. The Transmission Strategy department actively tracks and analyzes transmission systems not just as they exist today, but how they will exist in the future. The department is instrumental in the strategic siting efforts of the entire development platform. The position will be responsible to set up and run a variety of innovative, automated power flow studies using power flow and coding software. As an internal power flow study expert, this position will work with internal Strategic Development team, and external entities including Transmission Owners, ISO/RTO to review, analyze and replicate generator interconnection study results.

The person could be based in one of our EAST region offices or work remotely. Some travel will be required (~10%).

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

In partnership with internal stakeholders, lead to the successful execution of both new and acquired projects across the United States.

Analyze transmission grid to identify new opportunities for interconnecting renewable energy projects (i.e. solar, storage, wind).

Spearhead power flow analysis such as First Contingency Incremental Transfer Capability (FCITC), injection analysis, replicating key market and region deliverability studies.

Ability to set up and conduct automated power flow analysis using Python, or other scripting languages to expedite the analysis process.

Perform injection studies to identify the optimal interconnection locations for the placement of generator resources across the targeted study/focus region.

Actively track and participate in regions Transmission Planning Process, and advocate for AES clean energy portfolio to be included in Long Term Planning process.

Experience personally running nodal production modeling (i.e., PROMOD, UPLAN, GE MAPS, Aurora), and evaluating dispatch trends, curtailment trends and locational marginal pricing trends.

Obtain, update, and maintain regional power flow base cases with changes in resource mix and transmission topology based on ISO/RTO regional plans.

Remain up to date on all relevant new and upcoming technologies and knowledge to model them as per regions generator interconnection study criteria.

Perform network upgrade cost estimate allocation for the proposed projects, based upon applicable tariff.

Verify and challenge study results. Perform multiple scenario sensitivity analysis based on future queue projections and retirements.

Perform study review and provide technical insight and decision on acquisition generator projects. 

Strong knowledge of market efficiency analysis and identifying least congestion transmission points in the grid for delivery of power for PPA.

Understand and gain proficiency in Transmission Providers’ tariff, business practices, interconnection standards, interconnection study practices, cost allocation methodologies, transmission planning standards, and transmission system performance evaluation criteria. Possess an understanding of regional transmission plans and operational practices.

Minimum Qualifications:

BS in Electrical Engineering or related field.

5 years of working experience in renewable or traditional energy development, or transmission planning with an emphasis on generator interconnection studies.

Proficiency in power flow software (TARA, PSS/E).

Ability to automate generator interconnection studies on an interconnection wide basis.

Extensive knowledge of PJM Regional Transmission Expansion Plan (RTEP), Long Term Transmission Planning Process and modeling methodology.

Extensive knowledge of PJM Generator Interconnection study methodology.

Desired Skills and Expertise:

MS in Electrical Engineering or related field.

Familiarity with transmission systems and expansion plans, and generator interconnection study methodologies in MISO, NYISO and other affected systems.

Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize and manage several projects simultaneously to meet project schedules.

EMT power system modeling or similar experience strongly preferred; Experience with large load modeling (data centers, industrial facilities) and microgrids is a plus

Primary subject matter expert for AES Clean Energy substation automation controller installations and troubleshooting
